# The Intention of the Blessings

The secret is "sweet to the Severities" <note>original: "מתוק לגבורות" — a kabbalistic concept where harsh judgments (Gevurot) are sweetened or tempered by mercy</note>. Likewise, the word for "rooster" <note>original: "שכו"י" - Sekhvi</note> has the numerical value of "cup" <note>original: "כוס" - Kos, both equaling 86</note>. 

The spelling of the name Gabriel <note>The angel associated with the attribute of Strength/Judgment</note> corresponds to the "hidden Severities" of the "Mother" <term>Binah<gloss>the Sefirah of Understanding, often called the "Higher Mother"</gloss></term>, as is known to the initiates.

**When one opens their eyes, they should say: "Blessed is He who opens the eyes of the blind."**

<margin>
The reason for this is based on the secret of the "Vow" <note>original: "ק"ו" - numerical value 106</note> regarding the Law of the Lord... it indicates a great matter: that a person must thank their Creator in accordance with the specific benefit He has performed for them. For just as the higher nature involves the opening of a person's eyes after being asleep—during which time they were effectively blind, even if not literally so—as it says, "And the eyes of both of them were opened" <note>Genesis 3:7</note>, so too must one intend through this the secret of the Higher Holiness and the Divine Gaze. This involves the flow from the "Spelling with Yods" <note>The Divine Name expanded as Y-V-D, H-Y, V-V, H-Y</note> to the "Spelling with Alephs" and "Spelling with Hehs" <note>Different levels of divine energy represented by different expansions of the four-letter Name</note>. All of this is the secret of the "Attribute of Day," for nature follows the flow of the Male principle. However, at night, the "Attribute of Night" is mentioned, and nature flows from the filling of the Yods itself to the filling of the Hehs... Therefore, one must remove and withdraw the "External Names" <note>The *Klipot* or shells that surround holiness</note>... as you can see in the intention for sleep, where "slumber upon the eyelids" corresponds to the spelling with Alephs, which resembles the shape of eyelids. Through this blessing, He restores the "pupil of the eye" <note>original: "בת עין" - literally 'daughter of the eye'</note>... and behold, the Names known as *Seg* and *Mah* clothe themselves in the "blind," for the primary opening of the eyes comes from the "Kindnesses" <term>Chasadim<gloss>the expansive, giving divine energies</gloss></term>. Now that the Light has returned to its place, we say "He who opens the eyes of the blind."
</margin>

Through the power of these divine flows, the "two eyes" are formed. This is why we recite this blessing: because we have become wise through the "Opening of the Blind." This refers to those two spiritual "eyes" which were truly blind [during sleep] and have now been vitalized by the divine flows drawn down to them.

**When one stretches their limbs, they should say: "Blessed is He who releases the bound."**

<margin>
Behold, in the *Ra'aya Meheimna* <note>The "Faithful Shepherd," a section of the Zohar</note>, it is known that the night is a time when the lights are only present in a diminished state. This is because the "Attribute of Life"—meaning the mental faculties—withdraws and returns to the secret of the "deep sleep." These lights are "bound" or imprisoned within the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah<gloss>the feminine aspect of the Divine that dwells within the world</gloss></term> until midnight. After midnight, when the Divine Gaze returns... the *Shekhinah* (associated with the Name *Seg*) has the power to give birth to "New Mentalities" for the sake of the Microprosopus <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>the "Small Face" or emotional attributes of the Divine</gloss></term>... This is why we bless "He who releases the bound," for Zion is the point where the beginning occurs, and the mental lights emerge outward.
</margin>

**When one sits up, they should say: "Blessed is He who straightens the bent."**

<margin>
Now that the mental lights have emerged from the "Foundation of Understanding" in the secret of the night, we see that previously, these lights were like a fetus in the womb—doubled over, with its head between its knees. Now, they spread out into the "Ten Sefirot" <term>Sefirot<gloss>the ten channels of divine light through which God governs the world</gloss></term> and stand upright in the secret of a "Stature" <term>Partzuf<gloss>a complete divine configuration or "persona"</gloss></term>. This is why we bless "He who straightens the bent." This is the secret of the phrase "Whoever straightens, straightens through the Name," for there are five Names of God (the five mentalities) that cause this uprightness and spreading out.
</margin>

**When one gets dressed, they should say: "Blessed is He who clothes the naked."**

The Ari <note>Rabbi Isaac Luria, 1534–1572, the preeminent kabbalist of Safed</note>, of blessed memory, taught: After the "Stature" <note>The spiritual structure of the soul/divinity</note> is established, it requires "garments." These are for the Male and Female divine aspects, so that the "External Ones" <term>Klipot<gloss>the "husks" or forces of impurity</gloss></term> do not take hold of the radiance of their "bodies." For it is known that the dwelling place of the "Husks" is in the middle ground, between the Inner Light of the Female and her Surrounding Light. Now, there is a fear that the External Forces will latch onto the Inner Light of the Female which is close to them, for they do not have the power to gaze upon or suckle from the Surrounding Light. Therefore, the intention...

# The Intention of the Blessings

Therefore, we recite this blessing, for there is no person who does not have a portion in the Soul <term>Neshamah<gloss>a higher level of the soul, associated with the intellect and the world of Beriyah</gloss></term> of the first man <note>Adam HaRishon</note>, even if he has not yet merited to attain it himself.

And the text says **"pure"** <note>original: "טהורה" (Tehorah)</note> corresponding to the Soul of <term>Binah<gloss>Understanding; the third Sefirah</gloss></term> which comes from the "windows" <note>divine apertures of light</note>. 
**"You created it"** <note>original: "אתה בראתה" (Atah Beratah)</note> corresponds to the Soul of the World of <term>Beriyah<gloss>Creation</gloss></term>. 
**"You formed it"** <note>original: "ואתה יצרת'" (V'Atah Yatzartah)</note> corresponds to the Spirit <term>Ruach<gloss>the middle soul level, associated with emotion</gloss></term> of the World of <term>Yetzirah<gloss>Formation</gloss></term>. 
**"You breathed it"** <note>original: "ואתה נפחתה" (V'Atah Nefachtah)</note> corresponds to the Soul <term>Nefesh<gloss>the lowest soul level</gloss></term> of the World of <term>Asiyah<gloss>Action</gloss></term>. 
**"And You guard it within me"** corresponds to the help of Heaven so that the "External Forces" <term>Chitzonim<gloss>demonic forces or "shells" that feed on holiness</gloss></term> do not gain dominion over it. 

Thus, when you say **"the soul that You gave [me],"** it includes the four aforementioned aspects, the totality of which is simply called "Soul" <note>Neshamah</note>. And the Soul of <term>Malchut<gloss>Kingship; the lowest Sefirah</gloss></term>—as is known, its name is "The Throne"—goes up as "Feminine Waters" <term>Mayin Nukvin<gloss>spiritual energy raised from below to trigger a divine union</gloss></term> every night in the secret of a "deposit" <note>referring to the soul being entrusted to God during sleep</note>. And this is: **"And You are destined to take it from me."**

Afterward, in the morning, He returns it in the secret of **"They are new every morning, great is Your faithfulness"** <note>Lamentations 3:23</note>. This means: **"And to return it to me"** <note>a phrase from the blessing</note>—for in the Ultimate Future, it will be just as it is now when one wakes: the entire soul returns to the body in a state of perfection. 

Now, it is possible that at the time the soul ascends in the secret of the "Feminine Waters," it might remain above and not return to the body another time. Therefore, one says: **"As long as the soul is within me, I give thanks before You,"** for she is <term>Chokhmah<gloss>Wisdom</gloss></term> and <term>Binah<gloss>Understanding</gloss></term> within the Throne of **"the Lord my God."** 

**"And the God of my fathers"**—these are the "Arms" of the Divine <note>Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet of Zeir Anpin</note>. 
**"Master of all deeds"**—these are the six directions <note>the six Sefirot of Zeir Anpin</note> which are called the "Six Days of Creation." 
**"Lord of all souls"**—for the source of souls is in the "K" of the Divine Name. 
**"Blessed are You, Lord"**—these are Wisdom and Understanding which are blessed through the "Small Face" <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>the central personification of the Sefirot</gloss></term>. 
**"Who restores souls"**—through the Kingship of the World of Emanation <note>Malchut of Atzilut</note>, they are magnified until they reach the Understanding of the World of Action <note>Binah of Asiyah</note>, and from there the souls descend to "dead bodies" <note>the sleeping body is considered 1/60th dead</note> to revive them every morning, as mentioned, just as it will be in the Future to Come, with the help of God.

In the number of the "Small Name" <note>a Gematria method</note>, the "kneading" of the name **E-L-I** exists in the ten middle vessels of the "Small Face" <note>Zeir Anpin</note> of the World of Action during the "Act of the Soul" that is written about.

**He gave** <note>original: "נתן" (Natan)</note> to the Rooster: From here, for life, one must say the blessings in this order: **"Who sets the bound free"** <note>Matir Asurim</note> corresponding to the "Victory and Glory" <note>Netzach and Hod</note> of the World of Action. Afterward, **"Who formed man"** <note>Asher Yatzar</note> corresponding to the "Wisdom" <note>Chokhmah</note> of the World of Action. Afterward, **"My God, the soul"** <note>Elohai Neshamah</note> corresponding to the "Understanding" <note>Binah</note> of the World of Action. Afterward, the eight blessings corresponding to the central six Sefirot of the World of Action—behold, ten Sefirot as mentioned. This is the opposite of the opinion of the **Ramaz** <note>Rabbi Moshe Zacuto, 17th-century Kabbalist</note> who placed the "Elder" blessings afterward. Likewise, there are 14 words in this blessing <note>Asher Natan LaSechvi Binah</note> corresponding to the 14 worlds of Understanding. Also, with its 50 letters, it equals 74, which corresponds to the verse of the *Shema* with its ten letters.

**The intention** of the blessing: You already know that from midnight onwards, the Judgments are covered in the secret of the "Youth and the Maiden," as explained in our discussion of the secret of the "Woman who spreads out" after midnight through the entire height of the Small Face <note>Zeir Anpin</note>; see there. And 376 is the numerical value of "Full" <note>M-L-A</note> but also **Gabriel** <note>G-B-R-I-E-L</note>, who is the Foundation of Kingship <note>Yesod of Malchut</note>, who is called "Man" <term>Gever<gloss>related to Gevurah/Strength</gloss></term> because of the Severities <term>Gevurot<gloss>judgments or harsh energies</gloss></term> within him. 

At midnight, Understanding <note>Binah</note> shines into the Foundation of Kingship by stretching her "hands" down into the Foundation of Kingship, creating a "vessel" within her in the secret of: **"The sanctuary, O Lord, Your hands have established"** <note>Exodus 15:17</note>. This means: "The sanctuary of the Lord" is the Foundation of Kingship, and "Your hands established it" refers to the higher "hands" of Understanding. At that time, the night contains a great sweetness <note>original: "קח"רה" - possibly a scribal error or abbreviation for "Matikut," sweetness/softening</note> through the softening of the Severities in her Foundation. 

Before this softening, the 100 Severities were in the secret of **"Intoxicating Wine,"** for then, before the softening, the "External Forces" <note>shells/demons</note> were clinging to them; therefore it is "Intoxicating Wine." But at midnight, they are softened by the "hands" of Understanding, and then the "Shells" <term>Klippot<gloss>evil layers</gloss></term> are pushed away into the "Hollow of the Great Abyss." Then, the 100 Severities are in the secret of **"Gladdening Wine,"** for they raise joy from Understanding in the secret of the union to receive the "Masculine Waters." 

This is the intention of the blessing: **"Who gives the rooster <note>Sechvi</note> understanding <note>Binah</note>."** That is to say: Who is it that gives to the *Sechvi* (the Foundation of Kingship)? It is *Binah* (Understanding), whose very stature is "softening." And what is its "Understanding"? **"To distinguish between day and night."** This means she gives the "Understanding" to distinguish between the "Day"—which is the softening of the Severities in the secret of Night—and the "Night"—which are the Severities without softening, which exist before midnight in the secret of Night. This is done through the power of the Foundation which is called "Recognizable Binah," to distinguish and know between the "Intoxicating Wine" and the "Gladdening Wine." This is the explanation.

# The Intention of the Blessings

In the secret of the one who contemplates giving life to the **garments of skin** <note>original: "כתנות עור" (Kotnot Or) – referring to the garments God made for Adam and Eve in Genesis 3:21; in Kabbalah, these represent our physical bodies or coarser spiritual layers</note>, following the example of "and He bought them" between them, as it is said of the eight witnesses and as he drew them upon themselves and the **uprightness of the serpent**. And so it was also bad for Adam and Eve when they sinned and "knew that they were naked" in every sense • And this is found in the planting of his measure, mixed with his **purple garment** <note>original: "פורפורא" (Porpura) – a royal purple robe representing divine dignity</note>, as mentioned in the *Zohar*, portion *Bereshit*, page 88, side B • But Heaven forbid that the thought should rob him of the strength of the **Garment** <note>original: "הלבש" (Ha-Levush)</note>, which is free to be forgotten by his people. This is the secret of the Glory, the secret of "You neglected the Rock who begot you" <note>Deuteronomy 32:18</note> etc. When a person ruins his intention, his spirit's appointment falls etc. before it is changed by the hand of the **Kingdom** <term>Malchut<gloss>The lowest Sephirah, representing the physical world and the feminine aspect of the Divine</gloss></term>. Woe to the mind of the warrior! And for whoever is to come at all, it writes for him a **holy garment**, but for whoever has a **blemished garment**, his power was engraved with his signet, writing for him power. Therefore, when you bless "**Who clothes the naked**," you should intend toward this **Kingdom** <note>Malchut</note>, which acts for those whose desire is completely upon Her kingdom. And corresponding to those who have a blemished garment, who are troubled and darkened and strengthened by it, we therefore say "**Who gives strength to the weary**." This is the opposite of what the *Beit Yosef* <note>Rabbi Yosef Karo, author of the Shulchan Aruch</note> ruled in writing, stating that even though there is a fine basis to recite this blessing according to the Midrash, since it is not mentioned in the Talmud, how can an ordinary person have the authority to establish it? [End of his words]. But look here in the "Words of Living God" <note>original: "מל"ל" (Mi-Leil/Millel)</note>, since he wrote it to be said, he agreed to say it based on the "Remnant of the Holy Spirit" <note>referring to the teachings of the ARI, Isaac Luria</note> as our Sages of blessed memory said: "And may He enlighten our eyes in the light of His Torah" •

---

## When [putting on] shoes, one should say: "Blessed... Who directs the steps of man." <note>The transcription says "המבין" (Who understands), but the blessing is "המכין" (Who prepares/directs). The text explains the "understanding" or "discerning" of these steps.</note>

This is explained according to what the Rabbi [Isaac Luria] of blessed memory left us regarding the tenth portion. Know that the **Voice** <note>the spiritual sound or vibration</note> is not fully clarified until the time of **nursing** <term>Yanika<gloss>A developmental stage in the spiritual worlds where a Divine persona receives nourishment but is not yet fully mature</gloss></term>. The reason for "Voice" is that besides the **Foundation** <term>Yesod<gloss>The Sephirah of connection and procreation</gloss></term>, it is the numerical value of "Voice" <note>The Hebrew word 'Kol' (קול) equals 136, as does 'Yesod' (יסוד) with its filling letters in certain systems</note>, and it is also the "thigh" of the Voice, except for the "extra" part. It is to prevent the life of the **Shells** <term>Klippot<gloss>Forces of impurity that feed off holiness</gloss></term> in the secret of the "thigh of Jacob." And it is also silent, the Voice is always quiet, and bound with it is the document of **nursing** <note>Yanika</note>. They were always outside the "extra" part, and both of them were two halves of a body, as is known—that both of them are shortened together. Regarding this, it is said "with the thorn comes the cabbage," and therefore it is not complete or fully clarified until the time of nursing. When we are small at the time of birth, every addition is in the "external legs" to stand upon his toil. Through nursing, his legs are strengthened little by little, and afterward, he stands on his feet • all of them for his good • And behold, it is mentioned that at night, during the time of lying down, a concealment occurs, leaving only the "inner intellects" of the **Smallness of the Mother** <note>original: "מוחין פנימיים דקטנות של אימא" – a state of diminished spiritual consciousness</note> • but they do not sweeten [the judgments] at all in the secret of "twice in the day" and during the night from the purity. For in the crown of "Blessed," it should be linked to him as a category of **Intellects** <term>Mohin<gloss>Higher mental/spiritual states</gloss></term> in order to be sustained, for the Intellects are the vitality and sustenance of the purity • Behold, at the time of the departure of the Intellects at night, then the power of his legs comes [out], for from them is the life of the **External Forces** <note>Chitzonim</note> as is known, and there is no power in the legs to stand upon his toil • But after the rest, when the Intellects are returned to the "house between them" and return to fix the legs little by little, we therefore bless "**Who directs the steps of man**," for these are the **Intellects of Nursing** that spread through the "Smallness" <note>Katnut</note>; they discern and fix the legs so that he can stand upright •

## When descending [from the bed] to the ground, one should say: "Blessed... Who spreads the earth upon the waters."

Behold, after the persona of the **World of Formation** <note>Yetzirah</note> was fixed like the persona of the **Feminine** <term>Nukba<gloss>The feminine aspect of the divine persona</gloss></term> of Formation, it is known that her restoration is through the "sweetening of the Waters" of the **Severities** <term>Gevurot<gloss>Divine judgments or constraints</gloss></term>. For thus it is written regarding the second day of the work of Creation, there were "Water," which is Severity. And this is "Who spreads the earth upon the waters," meaning He spreads the persona of the Feminine upon the "Five Waters," which are the **Five Severities**, through which her persona is fixed • We can also say that the spreading of the persona of the Feminine makes her persona through five times the value of "Water," which rises to the value of "Death" <note>original: "מו"ת" (Mavet)</note>... inside the making of Man, "Let us make Man in our image, after our likeness" <note>Genesis 1:26</note>. See in the aforementioned discourse at the end of the first chapter, for the "Earth" is in front of her • We can also say regarding his descent [to the ground], and because of this, it is customary to say "Who spreads the earth" with the language of "stamping your feet" <note>Ezekiel 6:11</note>, for by the striking of the foot, he spreads the mat beneath him. The reason and intention of the Voice is that through the legs, via the "Smallness" <note>Katnut</note> of the "Small Face" <note>Zeir Anpin</note>, the entire persona of the Feminine is made to see, as is known •

# The Intention of the Blessings

The intention must be to clothe the aspect of "entry" as explained in the *Nefesh* <note>The "Nefesh" or "Vital Soul" is the lowest level of the soul, associated with physical action and the Sephirah of Malchut</note> and the *Holy City* <note>original: "עיר קדש" (Ir Kodesh) — a reference to a specific Kabbalistic work or the concept of the Divine structure</note> from the hidden and merciful depths. And behold, there was a seal "under his holy wings," implying that the Sages of Blessed Memory are like "sons of kings." The explanation of this "garment" is based on what is known: the points of the **unification of the "Smallness"** <term>Katnut<gloss>A state of constricted consciousness or spiritual immaturity</gloss></term>, their vessels clothe the **Intellects** <term>Mochin<gloss>Higher mental states or divine "brains" that descend into the lower Sephirot</term> of the "City" and enter within the "head" of the **Zeir Anpin** <term>Z"A<gloss>The "Small Face" or masculine aspect of the Divine, representing the six emotive Sephirot</gloss></term> as these vessels are known to spread. However, the garment is most understood as the "skin" of the aspect that enters with the Intellects into the *Zeir Anpin*. Yet, it remains opposite it on the outside of **Z"ON** <term>Z"ON<gloss>Zeir Anpin and Nukva — the combined masculine and feminine divine persona</gloss></term> and becomes a garment for them. This garment is the aspect of the **Supernal Hashmal** <note>original: "חשמל" (Hashmal) — a mystical "electrum" or glowing energy field described in Ezekiel's vision; in Kabbalah, it serves as a protective layer between the holy and the profane</note> of the **Binah** <term>Binah<gloss>Understanding — the third Sephirah and the "Divine Mother"</gloss></term>. Through this, the **External Forces** <term>Klippot<gloss>Literally "husks" or "shells" — the forces of impurity or evil that seek to drain holiness</gloss></term> have no power to suckle [spiritual energy] because it is very thick. The External Forces cannot suckle from that which is either extremely thick or extremely thin and refined, but only from the intermediate. Therefore, they do not suckle from the **Surrounding Light** <term>Ohr Makif<gloss>The divine light that is too great to be internalized and thus surrounds the person/vessel</gloss></term> of the Intellect, which also surrounds them, because it is a very great and pure light. Similarly, they cannot suckle from the "matter" that is inside the Husks because of its extreme thickness. But in the state of "Smallness," when they lack [garments] from the *Binah*, it is as if Z"ON are naked and lacking completion. At that time, they [the Husks] suckle from the internal light of the **Intention**. They also suckle from the *Zeir Anpin*, not directly from him but through the mediation of the **Shekhinah** <note>The Divine Presence, the feminine aspect of God</note>, for she is closest to them. When her "garments" are removed, this protective garment departs, and thus the "Two Eagles" <note>A metaphor for specific destructive spiritual forces</note> have the power to suckle strongly. However, even though the "matter" (which is entirely composed of the "doubled" aspects mentioned in the marriage contracts by our Sages) departs, the aspect of the garments remains. Therefore, if they were to suckle from there, their suckling would be dangerously large. But in the morning, when the Intellects are sent with this garment inside the *Zeir Anpin*, we therefore bless: **"Who clothes the naked."**

And behold, the word for **Garment** <note>original: "מלבוש" (Malbush)</note> has the numerical value <note>Gematria: M(40)+L(30)+B(2)+V(6)+S(300) = 378</note> of 378. These are the secret of the **378 Supernal Lights** that exist within the Supernal Faces, as mentioned in the *Tree of Life* <note>The primary text of Lurianic Kabbalah</note> page 133b. There it is explained that in every "Face" there is the name **EL** <note>God's name associated with Chesed/Kindness</note> which, when spelled out in full, equals 185. Likewise in the second Face, totaling [approximately] 378. <note>The author is calculating the various permutations of the Divine Name EL (Aleph-Lamed) to reach the numerical value of the word "Garment"</note> This is the garment of the soul... and they explained in the *Zohar*, portion *Lech Lecha*, that the name **Eloah** means "unto the Lord" (*El Ha-Shem*). The explanation of the matter is that the "Garment," which comes from the name **EL** as mentioned, is like a screen for the Z"ON, and even though it is a garment of *Binah*, it clothes Z"ON as mentioned.

## Customs of the Ari, of Blessed Memory
### Regarding the Order of Dressing
->The Garment of His Kingship<-

During prayers and every time one dresses, one must be careful to spread out the two edges of the wings <note>corners</note> of his garment, to the right and left, with his right hand. Afterward, he should put it on and arrange the right "wing" of the garment with his right hand, and then hang the left side of the garment to go behind him over his shoulder. Afterward, he shall put on the coat, placing his right hand into the right sleeve of the garment, and then clothe his left hand. He should always intend that the **Intellect** is included in the right hand and then the left garment, just as in the matter of putting on shoes. One should not put on two garments at once, as some do on weekdays <unclear>and during meals</unclear> so <unclear>regular</unclear>, but rather put on each and every one by itself. One who does otherwise "sins against his covering." The reason for this is: know that the garment of a human comes from **Holiness**. However, through the sins a person commits, he causes the Husks <term>Klippot</term> to clothe themselves and strengthen themselves within his garment. Furthermore, the aspect of the garments is that of the **Surrounding Light** on the outside. As is known, there is an **Internal Light** created within the body, and the garment clothes and protects the body. After that, there are the Surrounding Lights that stand outside the garments. Indeed, for every single garment, there is one Surrounding Light. How so? The garment pushes away the Husks just as the Surrounding Light does; it is as if the Husk cannot exist within that Name, which is why it stands outside as a "Surrounding" aspect, and the Husk cannot suckle from it. It follows that one who wears two garments at once does not give space for the Surrounding Light to enter and pass between each garment. Because of this, the Husk is not pushed away from the garments, and then "impurity covers" out of fear of the Husks. Therefore, one must be careful that a person does not put on two garments at once.

# The Intention of the Blessings
**Reference: 81 2 I h 2**

Wrap yourself, "He who wraps Himself in light!" <note>Reference to Psalm 104:2; in Kabbalah, this refers to the Sephirah of Keter (Crown) manifesting as the "inner light."</note> For the name of the **Crown** <term>Keter<gloss>The highest and most hidden Sephirah, representing Divine Will</gloss></term> is the **Beauty of the Mother** <note>original: "ת"ת דלימא" (Tif'eret de-Imma) — refers to the emotional attributes of the Divine as they are shaped by the higher "Mother" intellect (Binah).</note>, and this is the **Beauty** <term>Tiferet<gloss>The central Sephirah, associated with harmony and the "Small Face" (Zeir Anpin)</gloss></term> that sustains the prayer of the Lord. And after the **Prayer of Dew** <note>The "Tal" (Dew) prayer refers to the mystical flow of abundance from the higher realms to the lower ones.</note> is opened, the numerical value of 100 rises...

> **Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the Universe, who has not made me a gentile.**

> **Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the Universe, who has not made me a slave.**

> **Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the Universe, who has not made me a woman.**

**Natan** <note>Likely referring to a specific student or commentator in the Lurianic circle.</note> explains as follows: Know that since man is made of dust and ash, there are types of sins that cause him to be overturned <note>meaning to be spiritually transformed or demoted in the celestial hierarchy</note> and to exist at the extreme edge. Another matter is the "place of the horse," which is the matter of the chariot <note>original: "מטכב" (Merkavah) — the Divine Chariot, but here used to describe the vehicle or shell of a soul.</note>... corresponding to the attribute of death and anger at the edge. 

So too, there are types of sins that cause him to be overturned and to become a **gentile**. The matter is that one who acts <unclear>illegible</unclear> and at the time he kneels on his knees to step with it, he is acting to create a "golem" <note>An unformed or soulless shell</note> for the "Destroyer" who brings hidden thoughts with it. For "one sin drags another sin in its wake," and the holiness that is removed to the gentile side ruins the "foundation" <term>Yesod<gloss>The Sephirah of the covenant and procreation</gloss></term> which was announced in the three worlds. Therefore, he is subsequently reincarnated into the body of a gentile, which corresponds to that attribute.

So too, there are types of sins that cause him to be overturned and to become a **slave**. This refers to one who is humbled to the point of serving "great ones" who are close to him; through the servitude he performs for them, he is nullified in the servitude of the Blessed Holy One. He does not pray, he does not lay **Tefillin** <term>Phylacteries<gloss>Small leather boxes containing Torah verses worn during morning prayers</gloss></term>, he is nullified from the study of Torah and the recitation of the **Shema** <note>The central declaration of Jewish faith</note>, and he is nullified from many commandments of the Sabbath. Because of this, he is subsequently reincarnated into the flesh of a Canaanite <note>In Jewish law, a "Canaanite slave" is a specific legal and spiritual category.</note>. Therefore, every person who is of the holy seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and who desires to see himself as the Blessed Holy One created him—in a good reincarnation—should look at the goodness of his preparation. He is worthy to give praise and thanks that God helped him, as our Sages of Blessed Memory said: "He who comes to be purified is helped." Thus, God watches over the righteous and seeks to save him, and "The Lord will not leave him in his hand" <note>Psalm 37:33</note> so that he does not stumble into those three aforementioned sins.

One must bring himself into those three "impregnations" <term>Ibburim<gloss>A Kabbalistic concept where a soul-spark from another person enters a living body temporarily</gloss></term> of the gentile, slave, and woman. Therefore, one does not only recite this blessing once in his life, but every single day. For every day, various sins are "before his face," and he must ensure he does not stumble in them, Heaven forbid.

---

As mentioned, this is a "complete vessel" <note>original: "כלי שלם" (Keli Shalem)</note>... and therefore these three blessings must be a "remembrance between his eyes" <note>A metaphor for constant awareness, referencing the placement of Tefillin.</note>. 

Furthermore, it is possible to explain that even during one's life, it is possible for a person to be "impregnated" <note>original: "להתעבר" (Lehit'aber) — This refers to a secondary soul-aspect entering the person based on their actions.</note> with the spirit of a gentile, a slave, or a woman. For every night, his soul ascends on high to give a judgment and accounting before its Maker. Behold, according to his deeds, he is judged. Sometimes they give him, Heaven forbid, a soul in the secret of "impregnation" of a gentile, or a slave, or a woman. 

And it is known that even one who is prepared to learn and occupy himself with the Torah is not exempt until his soul returns to his nostrils, as it is written: "Withdraw from the man whose breath is in his nostrils" <note>Isaiah 2:22</note>. This continues until he prays and merits the blessing: "**Blessed is the Lord who is blessed for ever and ever.**" Then the soul returns to his body.

Because of this, there are 100 words <note>This likely refers to the "100 Daily Blessings" or a specific count in a prayer sequence.</note> corresponding to the five levels of the soul: **Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah, Chayah, Yechidah** <note>The five-fold hierarchy of the soul from physical to divine essence.</note>. And behold, now when he rises from his bed, while his soul is still "opposite him" <note>meaning, not yet fully integrated into the physical body after sleep</note>—before it enters his body—he should bless these three blessings. 

One should not do as some people do, who arrange these blessings after the formal prayer. Rather, one must focus his intention in his blessing: just as a slave does not enter his body, so may no thought of the "foreign side" enter him. And he should pray that the "gentile soul" <note>The base or unrefined impulse</note> does not enter him. If he has made a "seal" <note>A spiritual commitment or mark of holiness</note> this day, as explained previously, it will be torn away from him and he will no longer return to stumbling. Through this, the soul in his nostrils, which was prepared for him, spreads into the Divine body. 

However, after the powers have already spread into his body at the time of the prayer, what benefit is it to bless these three blessings after the prayer? Even though, according to the plain meaning (*Peshat*), it does not matter, a God-fearing person will be careful and bless them in their proper time, before the prayer, for the reason mentioned above.

**When he reaches his face, he should say: "Blessed is He who removes the bonds of sleep from my eyes and slumber from my eyelids."**

**The ARI, of blessed memory** <note>Isaac Luria (1534–1572), the father of Lurianic Kabbalah.</note> wrote that every night the "City" returns in the secret of the Name **Y-H** (Yod-Heh). This is the secret of the "Truth of Life." The explanation is that when we sleep, we are like a "dream," and there is no vitality except for that portion which is made in the image it had during the time of Exile. This is the portion of the "Intention for the Kingship" <term>Malchut<gloss>The lowest Sephirah, representing the Shekhinah or Divine Presence in the world</gloss></term>...

# The Intention of the Blessings

And behold, [the numerical value is] 136, and take 370, 130... and so on.
It is said that the **Feminine of the Small Face** <term>Nukva de-Zeir Anpin<gloss>The feminine aspect of the Divine (associated with the Shekhinah) as it relates to the emotional-active attributes (Zeir Anpin)</gloss></term> has already begun to look out upon her world with a voice, and she can withstand the renewal. Therefore, one must build her from below, even beneath the feet, so that the **External Forces** <term>Chitzonim<gloss>In Kabbalah, these are the "husks" or "shells" of impurity that seek to latch onto holiness and drain its vitality</gloss></term> do not desire her feet, as in the secret of the verse: "I have washed my feet" <note>Song of Songs 5:3; used here to describe the protection of the lower extremities of the Divine persona from spiritual "clinging."</note>. 130 and so on.

Know that the **Chashmal** <term>Chashmal<gloss>A term from Ezekiel’s vision (translated as "electrum" or "amber"), here referring to a specific spiritual aura or protective energy</gloss></term> and the **Cover** <note>original: "הסוכר" (Ha-Socher)</note> serve as a garment for the Divine Pair <note>Zeir Anpin and Nukva</note> entirely from all sides, even beneath their feet. The surrounding aspect on the sides of the body is the "Garments." Therefore, when you put on your garments, you should direct your intention to this aspect of the sides, which is called the "Garmenting" of the Divine Pair, during the blessing: **"...who clothes the naked."**

The aspect that is below, beneath the feet, consists of the "Shoes." Therefore, when you put on your shoes, you should intend that this lowest aspect is called the "Shoes" <term>Min'alim<gloss>Literally "locks" or "shoes"; in Kabbalah, they represent the final boundary that "locks" the light in and keeps the "hushks" out</gloss></term> within the Divine Pair. These [shoes] originate from the aspect of **Understanding** <term>Binah<gloss>The "Divine Mother" Sephirah, which provides the structures and "containers" for the lower realms</gloss></term> which provides for the Divine Pair.

Furthermore, you should direct your intention toward the necessity of the rectification mentioned in the blessing for shoes, which is created from the power of the "glass" <note>possibly referring to the clarity or transparency of the lower light</note>. Additionally, intend toward what I wrote above: that the **Chashmal** is that which is drawn down from **Binah** to be a "garment" for her child <note>Zeir Anpin</note>, so that she wraps him in her outermost garment.

As you already know, there are three names for **Binah**: [represented by the Hebrew letters] Y-H-W-H with the filling of the letter *Yod* <note>The Name of God expanded through its letter-sounds to reach a numerical value of 72, associated with Mercy</note>... [the text here discusses complex permutations of Divine names and their numerical relationships to the levels of the soul and the garments].

Regarding the matter of the "King" mentioned in the Talmud <note>Talmud, Tractate Shabbat 152a: "A person who has shoes on his feet is like a king."</note> in the context of shoes: the secret is that certainly, at first, the "Master" is drawn into the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The "Divine Son" or masculine persona consisting of the six emotional Sephirot</gloss></term> and spreads out further until it "locks" <note>a pun on the word for shoe, *Mina'al*, and the word for lock, *Na'al*</note> the Feminine aspect.

Behold, Male and Female are blessed as Right and Left. Therefore, it is appropriate to put on the right [shoe] first. However, since the primary intention of these shoes is to prevent the "External Forces" from drawing life from her, it is proper to first put on the shoe that [corresponds to] the planet of his luck <note>meaning the weaker or more vulnerable side requiring protection</note>. Thus, our Sages of blessed memory <note>original: "רז"ל" (Ratzal)</note> enacted a compromise: first put on the right shoe, but do not tie it [until the left is on], as mentioned above.

(In my humble opinion, this is what Rabbi Yochanan said regarding **Tefillin** <term>Tefillin<gloss>Phylacteries; ritual leather boxes containing Torah verses worn on the head and arm</gloss></term>: just as one places the Tefillin on the arm first, so too the shoe... because at first, the Feminine aspect of the Small Face receives her Tefillin, which is the secret of her holiness... as in the secret of "Set me as a seal upon your heart" <note>Song of Songs 8:6</note>. Afterward, the Feminine is received by the Small Face, and he draws his own holiness down to her from above... and then it enters into his foot, and then...)

---
<column-break/>
...it is performed by the three "Tefillin of the Head." Afterward, it would have been appropriate to put on the left [shoe] first. This is because since the light is received from the "Lower Tefillin," that is her specific portion. But after the branches of the "Surrounding Lights" <term>Makkifim<gloss>Spiritual lights that are too intense to be internalized and instead surround the person</gloss></term> within the Tefillin are received by the Small Face, he becomes "warmed" in the secret of the **Priestly Blessing**. Then he gives to the Feminine aspect their portion. Thus, it was actually appropriate to put on the right first. Therefore, one who fears Heaven should act according to the compromise mentioned above.

2. One should say when putting [the belt/girdle] on: **"Blessed be... the Light of Israel with strength."** <note>The standard blessing is "אוזר ישראל בגבורה" (Who girds Israel with strength). The transcription says "אור" (Light). This may be a scribal variant or a specific mystical interpretation of 'Light' as the source of 'Strength.'</note>

The explanation is that you should divide it—meaning into the "Lamp of the Menorah" <note>original: "טינר מנורה"</note>... The intention is that the Feminine aspect, who is currently "locked" <note>protected/contained</note>, should be elevated to **Binah** (Understanding), which she nursed from in the place of her "Entry" <note>the place of spiritual union</note>, which is his **Tiferet** (Beauty) from above. This is "The Light of Israel," referring to the aforementioned **Small Face** (Zeir Anpin).

(As I have written elsewhere regarding the Crown of the **Kingship** <term>Malchut<gloss>The lowest Sephirah, representing the actualized Sovereignty of God</gloss></term>... the reason she reaches that far is because the Kingship descends... One third of the letter *Heh* rises to the Crown of the Small Face, and one third of the letter *Heh* to the Crown of the Feminine of the Small Face. Through this, you will understand the secret of the 8th day... for she is the Crown of the Divine Pair... the two Kings [the Sun and Moon/Male and Female] use a single Crown... for from this lower third, two Crowns were made for the Divine Pair together...)

If you "examine the end in the beginning," you will see that the Crown of the **Kingship** returns to its single source, and thus two Crowns were made.

2. When spreading a cloth <note>the *Sudra* or head-covering</note> over his head, he should say: **"Blessed are You... who crowns Israel with beauty."**

The explanation: After the Feminine aspect of the Small Face has rectified her Crown in the lower third of the **Beauty** (Tiferet) of the Divine Pair, then the Small Face also crowns himself with his own Crown from the two lower thirds of **Beauty**. For the Crown of the Small Face is not complete until the Crown of the Feminine aspect is complete. And this is the meaning of "spreading a cloth over his head"—the secret of adding an "Additional Light," which is the secret of the **Surrounding Light** <term>Or Makkif<gloss>Refers to Divine energy that is too transcendent to enter the 'vessels' of the soul and stays surrounding it</gloss></term>. This is formed from the lower thirds of Beauty for the purpose of spiritual union, as explained in the discourse on the Haggadah. And this is the explanation for: **"...who crowns..."**

# The Intention of the Blessings

**And for grace and for mercy:** The explanation is that the "constellation" <term>Mazal<gloss>In this context, it refers to a specific spiritual flow or "drip" from the higher realms</gloss></term> of the sign is like eyes (as it is written: "He wandered and looked into the foundation of the eyes"). Similarly, the intention of the phrase **"grant us grace, kindness, and mercy in Your eyes"** refers to the seventy <note>The Hebrew letter Ayin, meaning eye, also has the numerical value of 70.</note> "chosen ones" in the Palace of Merit, through whom the attribute of mercy is awakened for us. Likewise, the phrase **"in the eyes of all who see us"** refers to the angels who roam throughout the world; they are called "eyes," as in the verse: "The eyes of the Lord roam throughout the earth" <note>Zechariah 4:10</note>.

Furthermore, the intention of **"grant us grace, kindness, and mercy in Your eyes"** is because during the night, the world is in the mystery of "Sleep" <note>In Kabbalah, night is a time when the higher spiritual faculties are withdrawn, leaving only "Severities."</note>, during which there were only **Severities** <term>Gevurot<gloss>Divine attributes of judgment and restraint</gloss></term>. But from the morning onward, the **Kindnesses** <term>Chasadim<gloss>Divine attributes of expansion, love, and giving</gloss></term> are present within it, and then He "opens His eyes." We therefore pray that we should be perceived "in His eyes" at that time.

Note that **"all who see us"** are the "Eyes of the Earth," which are constant. This is the mystery of the "Open Eye" <note>Referencing the *Ayin Pekicha*, the ever-open eye of the highest Divine level (Atika Kadisha) that knows no sleep or judgment.</note>, and it is the mystery of the "Gaze"—that He should gaze upon us with grace, kindness, and mercy. We ask for **"good kindnesses"** because at night, He only influences us with Severities, but now that it is morning, we pray that He influences us with good kindnesses from those two Eyes and the "Open Eye." 

This is the secret of "Good Kindnesses" [which has the numerical value of] three times the name **SaG** <term>SaG<gloss>A specific expansion of the Tetragrammaton (Y-H-V-H) equaling 63, associated with the Sephirah of Binah (Understanding) and the world of Creation</gloss></term>. This is the mystery of "He who abandons rebuke finds hidden love," for three times 63 represents the three brains <note>Chokhmah, Binah, and Da'at</note> that are revealed and shine through the two eyes. The third aspect shines from the "Open Eye," for there it is only one eye, as there is no "left side" in the Ancient One <note>Atika; the highest realm where there is only pure mercy and no judgment/left side.</note>.

**"Blessed are You, Lord, who bestows good kindnesses to His people Israel."** The explanation is that the word **Bestows** <note>original: "Gomel"</note> contains two simple Tetragrammatons <note>Names of God (Y-H-V-H)</note>. "Good kindnesses" are two Tetragrammatons of the name **SaG**. Thus, there are six Names in total. For in the "Inner" aspect there are three names of SaG, and in the "Surrounding" aspect there are three simple names. This is the mystery of: **"to His people Israel,"** which equals the same value <note>The numerical value of "To His people Israel" (Le'amo Yisrael) relates to the combination of these Divine Names</note>. This is an "Opening" that resembles the "Closing" <note>Referring to the structure of the blessing</note>. Therefore, one answers **Amen** with great concentration.

**May it be Your will, Lord my God and God of my fathers, that You save me today and every day from the brazen-faced and from brazenness; from an evil man, from an evil inclination, from an evil companion, from an evil neighbor, from an evil mishap, from the evil eye, and from the evil tongue; from a harsh judgment and from a harsh opponent, whether he is a member of the Covenant or whether he is not a member of the Covenant.**

### Nathan
The reason one must say this version is that these twelve <note>The prayer lists twelve specific evils to be saved from.</note> correspond to the twelve "Husks" <term>Klipot<gloss>Spiritual shells of impurity</gloss></term>. These are the "Twelve from me, incense" <note>A cryptic reference to the 12 ingredients of the incense or the 12 boundaries</note>. These twelve are "Dead ones" <note>The Klipot are often called "Dead" because they are severed from the source of Life</note> because they come from the "Breaking of the Vessels" (the Kings who died) <note>Refers to the pre-cosmic catastrophe in Lurianic Kabbalah where the vessels could not hold the light and shattered, creating the sparks of evil</note>, as it is written: "And he reigned... and he died." We pray that the Holy One, Blessed be He, saves us from them and "kills" them so that they have no power to harm us, in the mystery of "He will swallow up death forever" <note>Isaiah 25:8</note>.

**Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who has sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us to occupy ourselves with the words of Torah. And please, Lord our God, make the words of Your Torah pleasant in our mouths and in the mouths of Your people, the House of Israel; and may we, our offspring, and the offspring of our offspring all be knowers of Your Name and students of Your Torah for its own sake. Blessed are You, Lord, who teaches Torah to His people Israel.**

**Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who chose us from all the nations and gave us His Torah. Blessed are You, Lord, Giver of the Torah.**

# Customs
**135:** Nevertheless, regarding the Morning Torah Blessing, when one is occupied with its rectification, one should answer **Amen** between the phrase "the words of Torah" and "And make [them] pleasant..." because the legal authorities rule that these are two separate blessings. Even though the second part begins with the letter *Vav* (meaning "And"), they are still two blessings. Therefore, one should say Amen after the first part. This is also the opinion of the Knesset HaGedolah and the **Ramaq** <note>Rabbi Moshe Cordovero (1522–1570), a leading Kabbalist in Safed</note> of blessed memory in his prayer commentary.

### It appears to me
I will explain why it says **"to occupy ourselves"** <note>original: "La'asok"</note> with the words of Torah. For in the "Occupations" of the world, business and trade are in our hands to do. So too, we work to create a "Connection" <term>Chibur<gloss>The mystical union between Divine attributes</gloss></term> between the **Written Torah** (associated with the male aspect, Zeir Anpin) and the **Oral Torah** (associated with the female aspect, Nukva). This is the meaning of "to occupy" (as in "to do business with"). This "Connection" of the two Torahs is achieved through our study. 

As for **"And make [them] pleasant,"** the letter *Vav* ("And") refers to the mystery of the "Fifty Gates of Understanding" mentioned in the book *Etz Chaim* <note>The "Tree of Life," the primary text of Lurianic Kabbalah</note>. This is because sometimes **Zeir Anpin** is "Face to Face" <note>A state of perfect Divine balance and union</note> with **Nukva**, and she is then equal to his height. At that time, she receives the "Three times Three" <note>The nine sub-sephirot</note> as explained in the *Gaze of the Eyes*. From there she receives her sustenance and is "sweetened" <note>A term for the mitigation of harsh judgments</note> within the category of "Israel."

# The Intention of the Blessings

In the mystery of **Sovereignty** <term>Malchut<gloss>The final Sefirah, representing the manifest world and the Divine Presence</gloss></term> and the **Elder**, the explanation of the "lines of life" refers to the Attribute of Life. When one’s eyelids are closed in the slumber of sleep, he is unable to gaze upon the Sovereignty to be unified with her. It is also explained that the "Higher Power" is doubled in his eyes <note>original: "כפלה בעיניו"</note> in the mystery of the "missing eye" or "shut eye." The Holy One, blessed be He, is the mystery of the voice that is hidden, which is the absence of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at<gloss>The Sefirah of integration and conscious awareness</gloss></term>. Therefore, the "Husks" <term>Kelipot<gloss>The "shells" or spiritual forces of impurity that conceal the divine light</gloss></term> hover over the eyelids in the secret of the "closing of the eyelids." 

Indeed, this entire mystery of the "Smallness" <term>Katnut<gloss>A state of diminished spiritual consciousness</gloss></term> lasts until midnight. After midnight, the light returns. All of this is accomplished through the movement of the prayers. Therefore, the "Damagers" and "Judgments" <term>Gevurot<gloss>Divine attributes of severity and judgment</gloss></term> that rule during the night are pushed away. This is as it is written: "And God called the light Day" <note>Genesis 1:5</note>, meaning the light of the "seventy days." And "the darkness He called Night," meaning the darkening of the face of the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The central six Sefirot, often personified as the "Son" or the "Holy One, blessed be He"</gloss></term> by the power of the Night, which is the secret of the Judgments. Therefore, when one reaches the blessing **"Blessed is He who removes [sleep]..."**, he must intend to remove the six Judgments from the human face, and through this, the light of the Divine Face increases.

The name of Seventy <note>referring to the numerical value of the letter Ayin (Eye)</note> is intended to influence the **Small Face** with new **Mentalities** <term>Mohin<gloss>Higher cognitive/spiritual faculties that descend into the lower Sefirot</gloss></term>. These are the six names mentioned here... which is the **Knowledge** that includes the attributes of **Kindness** <term>Chasadim<gloss>Divine attributes of love and expansion</gloss></term> and **Severity** within them. **Knowledge** itself is called Jacob. 

**That You make us regular in Your Torah:** The reason the text uses the language of "regularity" <note>the Hebrew word *targilenu* shares a root with *raglayim*, meaning "feet"</note> is because the "Mentalities" or "Illuminations" of the Infinite reach down to the "Feet" <note>the lowest levels of the spiritual structure</note> of the **Small Face**. Thus, "make us regular" hints at these "Feet."

**And make us cling to Your commandments:** This refers to the **Feminine Attribute** <term>Nukva<gloss>The female counterpart to Zeir Anpin, associated with the Sefirah of Malchut</gloss></term> who is always clinging to His "signs" (the commandments). This is the secret of the verse "and you shall cling to Him" <note>Deuteronomy 10:20</note>. We pray that You distance us from anything that stands between the inner light and the surrounding light of the **Feminine Attribute**. We pray that You distance us from sin so that we may always be joined with the Holy Name.

The matter of "May it be Your will" in its mystical sense refers to the "Higher Will" that flows from the source. **"From before You"** <note>original: "מלפניך"</note>: This refers to the "Inner Face," meaning the innermost essence that is protected from the "External Ones" <note>the Kelipot</note>. Therefore we say, **"Do not bring us into the hands of sin"** <note>Chet</note>, which refers to the mystery of the Male [adversary], **"nor into the hands of transgression"** <note>Averah</note>, which refers to the mystery of the Female [adversary]. The mystery of the "Transgression" is linked to the "Liver," as mentioned in the Zohar, portion *Pinchas*.

**"And distance us from the Evil Inclination"** <note>Yetzer HaRa</note>: This refers to the "Stormy Wind" that enters a person to stir them toward evil. **"And make us cling to the Good Inclination"** <note>Yetzer HaTov</note>: This refers to the secret that "one who comes to be purified is assisted." This assistance often comes through the soul of a righteous person <note>Tzaddik</note> who guides the person toward moral instruction. We pray that this guidance never departs from us due to sin, but that "Your Will" remains with us always. (**And grant us grace and kindness...**)

# The Intention of the Blessings

Deeply inward. Regarding the first three <note>referring to the first three blessings or the first three Sefirot</note>, the intention is the letter *Shin* [ש] in its three-fold expansions <note>original: "ש' בג' מילואיה" - a complex Kabbalistic method of spelling out a letter to reveal hidden numerical values</note>. Through these, the "rims" of the thirty-two <term>Paths of Wisdom<gloss>The 32 paths through which the universe was created according to the Sefer Yetzirah</gloss></term> are blessed by the one hundred [100] themselves. One adds the consciousness of thirty-seven [37] and the secret of the "Voice" to the mouth. Regarding the "movements," there is the silence of the "Acquisitions" and those who answer "forty-three" [43] and also the "Lament of the Five," the voice of "forty" [40] and the voice against "one hundred fifteen" [115]. These are hidden within us, which are the thirty-seven [37] from the "rising of the sons of the inner face" <note>likely referring to the internal aspects of the Sefirah of Foundation</note>. The secret of the "Voice" is the two expansions of the "second," which are forty-six [46] and thirty-seven [37]. In the movements of the "mixtures," which are the "vanities" and the rims of the "three hundred" [300], the secret of the Voice is found in the three attributes of judgment. This Voice calls to the "Daughter of the Synagogues" <term>Knesset Yisrael<gloss>The spiritual archetype of the Community of Israel, identified with the Sefirah of Malchut</gloss></term>. And here, in the "Blackness" of the king, from the secret of the "two hundred and sixty" [260], the "Dawn of Kindness" <term>Chesed<gloss>The attribute of Divine Mercy and expansion</gloss></term> is awakened. These are meant to give birth to the "Name of Understanding" <term>Binah<gloss>The Sefirah of Divine Intellect and the "Mother" who gives birth to the lower emotions</gloss></term>, which the Sages called the "Awakening." 

However, when one merits the "Ox of the Torah" <note>original: "שור התורה" - a reference to the strength and root of the Torah</note>, which comes from the **Foundation** <term>Yesod<gloss>The Sefirah that channels all higher energies into the manifest world</gloss></term> of the "Daughter," reaching the secret of **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah<gloss>The flash of divine intuition and the "Father" principle</gloss></term>, there is a unification of Understanding in the "Juice" <note>original: "בעסיס" - likely a reference to the "Spiced Wine" of the higher realms</note>. This is the Name "one hundred and six" [106] which brings down the flow to the Name of the "Three." For the "Ox of the Names" is moved and takes them into the building of the "one hundred and sixty" [160]. Regarding the "Blackness," it is prepared for the "Lamps" <note>original: "ללס"י" - likely an abbreviation for "Luminaries of the Radiant Glow"</note>. And regarding "the words of Your Torah," the meaning is that we draw the Torah—which is the Foundation—to also go to the "Name of the One Hundred," which is **Understanding** [Binah] in the secret of "one hundred and twenty-six" [126]. This is the meaning of "Blessed are You, O Lord... who teaches Torah to His people Israel." This means: Blessed is the Lord, for we have merited that the "Higher Sprinkler" <note>original: "מרקיל העליון"</note> has extended the abundance to us from the "Two Foundations" to the **Higher Wisdom**, flowing with power. They are called "Teachers." When this is completed and exists in the "Juice" of a single **Persona** <term>Partzuf<gloss>A "Face" or configuration of Divine attributes that allows for interaction between the Sefirot</gloss></term>, it is the Foundation alone that stands as the "Torah for the People." This refers to the "Six Directions" <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The six emotional Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</gloss></term>. Similarly, it flows to Israel below, who receive the "five hundred" [500] in the secret of **Moses**. As our Sages of blessed memory said: "Moses, you have spoken well," for the Foundation of Wisdom contains the power of Moses within its secret. From the "Dawn," they connect the abundance of the body of the Foundation; therefore, it is also called by the name "Moses." And so we can say the meaning of **Kindness** [Chesed] is that one who merited to learn Torah for the sake of the Name of the Lord [Y-H-V-H], the letter *He* [ה]—which is the "Daughter"—bestows downward into the "World of Action" <term>Asiyah<gloss>The lowest of the four spiritual worlds, our physical reality</gloss></term> the entirety of the Torah. This is the secret of "The Teacher," meaning the Lord [Y-H-V-H] is the Teacher of Torah to His people Israel.

**Blessed** is our God, who chose us from all the nations. With the "Holy Crown" that the Name wrote by His will. This is unlike the "Straight Path" of Esau the Wicked, who only receives from the "Crust" <term>Kelipah<gloss>The outer shell of impurity</gloss></term> of the Foundation of the "Daughter" to bring it down to the "Foreign God." But the "Inwardness" of the Foundation of the "Daughter" itself is "And He rested for Jacob" <note>referring to the spiritual rest and inheritance of Jacob/Israel</note>. Now, the "Esau of Above" is the head of all the "Outer Sons." This is why He "Chose us" (that is, Jacob) "from all the nations" (from Esau, who is the head of all nations). "And gave us the sign of His Torah"—meaning the Inwardness of the Foundation of the "Daughter" in which the Torah is written was given to us, and not to Esau. For to Esau, He only gave the "Edges" of the Foundation. As the Rav <note>Rabbi Isaac Luria, the Arizal</note>, of blessed memory, said: "The Torah of the cup is for us, through Moses," for Moses is the aspect of the Foundation of the "Daughter" that spreads through the body. This is well known. This is the meaning of "Kindness" [Chesed] which supports the language of "The sign of His Torah," which is the level of attainment of Jacob. In it, the lights of the Foundation are gathered and received from the Foundation of the "Daughter" that points outward, and in the "Juice" <gloss>the essence</gloss> of the Persona of Jacob. "Blessed are You, O Lord, Giver of the Torah." The meaning is: Blessed is the Lord, who is the secret of the "Filling" of the Foundation of Jacob and Leah. Through these "Fillings," Wisdom is simplified downward to Israel. He is the "Giver of the Torah"—the letter *He* [ה] of "Giver" is Jacob, who gives the Torah to the letter *He* [ה], which is the "Daughter." Through both of them, the abundance of the Torah descends into the world.

# The Intention of the Blessings

It has been explained that the "Ashur" <note>likely referring to a specific spiritual placement or the "steps" of the soul</note> takes its place from our Sovereignty <term>Malchut<gloss>The lowest of the ten Sefirot, representing the physical world and the feminine recipient of Divine light</gloss></term> within the strength of the "Father" and "Mother" of the worlds <term>Abba and Imma<gloss>The archetypal male and female creative principles in Kabbalah, associated with Wisdom and Understanding</gloss></term>. And these are the two great lights of the Lord; a "great voice" from the 360 <note>a numerical value associated with the solar year or a specific Divine name</note>, and no harm came from it—this ends his quote. From here, the aspect of **Leah** <note>the "upper" feminine manifestation, often associated with thought and the hidden world</note> flees into the intention of the *Kriat Shema* [the "Hear O Israel" prayer], for the "Voice of the Torah" is always the "Foundation" <term>Yesod<gloss>The Sefirah of Foundation, which acts as the channel or "procreative" organ for Divine energy</gloss></term> of the Father, as is written concerning the ten Sefirot.

Furthermore, regarding the intention for **Purim**, he wrote that when the "Brains" <term>Mochin<gloss>Higher consciousness or divine intellect</gloss></term> are within the "Small Face" <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The central six Sefirot, often personified as the "Son" or the "Groom" in the Divine wedding</gloss></term>, the Foundation of the Father concludes exactly where the Foundation of the Small Face concludes, and it is clothed within it. However, currently, since the "Garments" of the "Grandfather of Israel" and "Reason" <term>Israel Saba and Tevunah<gloss>Lower aspects of Wisdom and Understanding that interact directly with the lower worlds</gloss></term> are within **Rachel** <note>the "lower" feminine manifestation, associated with the revealed world and speech</note>, her Foundation is a "short voice" and not long and extended like the male Foundation. For when the garments enter her, the Foundation of the Father reveals itself and extends outside of her Foundation; it is not clothed within her Foundation but is revealed entirely below. This ends his quote.

Now, it is known that the Foundation of the Small Face is called "Script" <note>original: "כתב" (Ktav)</note>, as it is written: "All creatures depend on it," until the "Good Script" <note>likely referring to the Written Torah</note> decides between them. Therefore, when the Foundation of the Father—which is called **Torah**—is clothed within the Foundation of the Small Face—which is called **Script**—this is called the **Written Torah**.

Likewise, when the Foundation of the "Grandfather of Israel" (which is also "Torah") is clothed within the female aspect, **Rachel**, and the Foundation does not extend outside of the female Foundation—and the female Foundation is called "Mouth" <note>original: "פה" (Pe)</note>—therefore, the Foundation of the Grandfather is also called the **Oral Torah**. The meaning is that the "Secret" is revealed upon the "Mouth" in order to provide influence to the female aspect.

And so, when one joins the Foundation of the Small Face with the Foundation of the female aspect, it is called the "Union of the Written Torah with the Oral Torah." All of this is so that the Written Torah may provide influence to the Oral Torah. Understand this great secret.

And this is what is meant by: "May the words of Your Torah be in our mouth and in the mouths of Your people, the House of Israel."
- **"In our mouth"**: This refers to the "Voice" within the "Mouth" of the Foundation of the Small Face, which is the **Written Torah**.
- **"In the mouths of Your people"**: The word "Mouths" [Hebrew: *Pifiyot*] has the numerical value of the Foundation of Sovereignty. This means the Foundation of the "Grandfather of Israel" is clothed within the Foundation of Sovereignty, and from there it is revealed outward and called the **Oral Torah**, as mentioned. And it is inside the Foundation of the Female...

---

...He is the one mentioned to all the nations and Israel, "And let us and our offspring... be knowers of Your Name." This refers to the souls hidden within the "House of Israel." This is because the female Foundation is the "House," meant for the Foundation of Israel to enter into it; this is the secret of the "Union."

If it should be that the "Two Constellations" <note>original: "מזלות" (Mazalot) - referring to the two flows of Divine influence</note> are always joined together and always stand "face to face," then the souls of the great righteous ones would be able to facilitate this union always above, as it is written: "They shall not depart from your mouth, nor from the mouth of your children, nor from the mouth of your children's children" (Isaiah 59:21). Then we and our children and the children of our children would all be "knowers of Your Name, our King." And one must first know the secret of the union of **Rachel**.

Regarding the phrase "Your Torah is in her mouth," it is written: "From the secret of one who engages in Torah for its own sake [Lishmah], he merits words of understanding." The word **Lishmah** [לשמה] is composed of the letter *Lamed* [ל] and the Name [שמה]. The intention is to draw the Torah toward the "Face of These" <note>original: "אל"ה" - a name for the revealed aspects of the Divine</note>. For as you know, the Torah comes from the Foundations of the Holy One, Blessed be He.

And **Rachel** merits receiving only from the Foundation of Understanding <term>Binah<gloss>The Sefirah of "Motherhood" and analytical reasoning</gloss></term>, and she is a "Queen" because **Jacob** <note>the personification of the central Sefirah, Tiferet</note> takes them for her. However, above, Jacob only stands opposite **Leah**. Therefore, all those generations that were worthy of coming to Jacob but could not come, live entirely above, covered by the Foundation of Wisdom [Chochmah] which is written of the "Mother." Therefore, they all reveal themselves to Leah.

If one engages in Torah "for its own sake" [Lishmah], the meaning is to draw from the Foundation of Wisdom to Leah. Through this, the "Great Judgments" of Leah are sweetened, for it is known that harsh judgments exist there; therefore, the reward is great. All of this intention is achieved through the letter *Dalet* [ד]. This is the meaning of "Lishmah"—the *Lamed* and the *Shem*.

In this manner, we now need to draw light to every "Persona" <term>Partzuf<gloss>A structural configuration of Sefirot that functions as a distinct "personality" or "face" of the Divine</gloss></term> in the Soul. For the Persona of Leah stands entirely opposite the "Covered Foundation of Wisdom."
All of these are three aspects within the three lower ones... and their rest is not good. And behold, in her "First Three" [Sefirot], one must intend to draw the secret of the "Name" [Hem] in her three "Fillings" <term>Miluyim<gloss>A method of calculating the value of a Divine Name by spelling out each of its letters</gloss></term>:
- **In Wisdom (Chochmah)**: The *He* [ה] with a *Yod* [י].
- **In Understanding (Binah)**: The *He* [ה] with an *Aleph* [א].
- **In Knowledge (Da'at)**: The *He* [ה] with a *He* [ה].

Afterward, in the three middle ones, the secret of the letter *Vav* [ו] which is the "Voice" with a *Yod*... as mentioned. And in the three lower ones, it is the secret of the "Bride" of Understanding:
- Five times *He* with *Yod* in the "Daughters" [Benot].
- Five times *He* with *Aleph* in the "Double Aleph."
- Five times *He* with *He* (numerical value).

All of this is from the Foundation of Wisdom. And whoever covers every aspect needs to rectify the *He*...

<meta>This page continues the technical exploration of "Kavannot" (mystical intentions), shifting from the structural placement of the Divine Personae to the developmental stages of the soul—specifically "Nursing" (Yenika) and "Maturity" (Gadlut)—and how these stages are reflected in the words of the daily blessings.</meta>

# The Intention of the Blessings

The interpretation is that one "nurses" from it through the mystery of **Nursing** <term>Yenika<gloss>A developmental stage in Kabbalah where the lower spiritual levels receive sustenance from the higher "Mother" level, like a child</gloss></term>. For when the spiritual structure is like an infant—possessing only the "Six Extremities" <term>Vav Ktzavot<gloss>The six emotional attributes of the soul: Kindness, Strength, Beauty, Victory, Splendor, and Foundation</gloss></term>—it nurses from the "breasts" of its mother so that its higher faculties may grow. These faculties ascend to the level of **Understanding** <term>Binah<gloss>The third Sefirah, associated with the Divine Mother and the source of the "flow" that sustains the lower worlds</gloss></term> to nurse. Afterward, they descend and provide the Divine flow to the "Small Face" and its "Feminine counterpart" <term>Z"on<gloss>An acronym for Zeir Anpin and Nukva, the male and female aspects of the Divine that interact with our world</gloss></term> and to all the worlds. This concludes the words of the sage, may his memory be a blessing. <note>original: עכ"ל ז"ל</note> <margin>Note here: Regarding the "arms," they represent the House of Judgment during the stage of Nursing; but during the stage of Maturity, they are called "Arms."</margin>

And when these mentioned attributes are blessed for their own sake, or return to their source in **Understanding** to receive the Divine flow in order to bring it down, then **Understanding** is called **"King."** This is because through her, the flow is channeled, and "Her kingdom rules over all" <note>a reference to Psalm 103:19</note>—meaning the kingdom and the tithes. If they did not have this flow initially, they would not be able to return to their root to receive more flow and bring it down through the Divine Name <note>represented by the number 26, the value of the name YHVH</note>. Then they would return empty-handed, for these attributes are the mystery of the "Inner Face." <gloss>This is the mystery of the inner aspect of the Foundation of Understanding.</gloss> 

Otherwise, they do not ascend to the Supernal Source, which is **Understanding**, in its proper manner. For the entire structure of the **World of Emanation** <term>Atzilut<gloss>The highest of the four worlds, where the Divine light is most pure</gloss></term> would have nothing to receive if it did not ascend there to receive the flow. Therefore, everything is placed there. <gloss>For the "vessels" of the Small Face never ascend; if they did, the world would be destroyed, God forbid. Rather, it is the "Brains" or higher consciousness that constantly ascend and descend for the Small Face alone.</gloss> Through this, the World of Emanation ascends. Therefore, we say the word "**Who**" <note>original: אשר (Asher)</note> as a hidden path in the "Two Mantles" <note>likely a reference to the Idra Rabba, a section of the Zohar</note>. This ascent reaches the final point of **Understanding** in the **World of Formation** <term>Yetzirah<gloss>The third world, associated with the emotions and the angels</gloss></term>, specifically at the "Point of Zion" in the realm of **Sovereignty** [Malchut]. The attributes do not all ascend, but only as far as the level of **Foundation** [Yesod], and not above it.

That which ascends is the mystery of the rectification of the Supernal **Small Face** [Zeir Anpin] within it, and it is called **"Who"** (*Asher*), just as the **Foundation** below is called **"Who"** (*Asher*). <note>This is a linguistic play on the word "Asher" (who/which) and "Ashrei" (happy/fortunate), often linked to the Sefirah of Yesod</note>. This is not the case for the Name of God [YHVH]. Thus, they are the name *Ehyeh* <note>original: אהי"ה - "I Will Be"</note>, which has the numerical value of 21, combined with the word for "Tent" <note>original: אה"ל (Ohel)</note>. Through this, the Supernal Knowledge [Da'at] is clothed within it. <gloss>For the "Supernal" refers to the Divine Name of 52 [Ban] which ascends to the Point of Zion; they raise it from the Name, and then His name becomes "King of the Universe" within her, which is the Point of Zion... and the "Foundation of the Ancient of Days" [Yesod de-Atik] joins in union and enters her at the Point of Zion.</gloss> 

This is the meaning of **"King of the Universe"** <note>original: מלך העולם (Melekh Ha-Olam)</note>. From the "Foundation," oil and oil-pressed liquids emerge because it contains the qualities of Kindness and Strength. The "Strengths" of the higher level are the "Kindnesses" of the Mother. But the "Strengths" of the Mother together with the Foundation are called "Inebriating Wine," as is known. "He shall provide the delicacies of the King" <note>Genesis 49:20</note> refers to the **Foundation**. <gloss>Meaning the Foundation of the Long Face [Arich Anpin], which is described as the Foundation of the Mother. When they gather to produce the flow at the Point of Zion, the flow emerging from the Foundation equals the numerical value of "Delicacies of the King," which refers to the Foundations within the Point of Zion of Understanding.</gloss>

With this, two contradictory statements in the *Idra Rabba* and *Idra Zuta* <note>central sections of the Zohar</note> can be reconciled. The word "**Who**" (*Asher*) is the light of the "Holy of Holies." These two are the light in the Point of Zion within **Understanding**, which is called "The World to Come." The mystery of the "Supernal Knowledge" within it has the numerical value of **"Holy"** (*Kodesh*), for Supernal Knowledge is the Sanctification, drawn from **Wisdom** [Chokmah]. The "World to Come" consists of the three highest Sefirot, just as **Sovereignty** [Malchut] is the numerical value of the "Commandments of the King."

This is the meaning of **"Who sanctified us with His commandments"** <note>original: אשר קדשנו במצותיו (Asher kiddeshanu be-mitzvotav)</note>. Our intention should be to draw this holiness and sweetness all the way down to the "Lower Holiness," which is the **Foundation** of the **Small Face**. The "Lower Sweetness" is in the **Feminine** [Nukva/Malchut]. This is why the word "His commandments" refers to two: the upper rest and the lower rest. <gloss>Similarly, the word "His commandments" points to the union of the Foundation and the hidden Bride in Sovereignty.</gloss>

All of this applies to the **Blessings over Commandments** (*Mitzvot*), for through the commandment, one has the power to draw flow from the **World of Emanation**. However, in the **Blessings over Pleasures** [Henin], we do not say "Who sanctified us" or mention "holiness" or "rest." This is because once the attributes were blessed and returned to bring down the sustenance of food, they did not bring the flow from the mystery of the "World to Come" (the central point of Understanding), but only from **Understanding** itself as it relates to **Knowledge** [Da'at]. <gloss>This refers to the "Third Knowledge" of the Small Face which spreads through the body, as known from the Idra.</gloss>

Therefore, we say: **"Creator of the fruit of the ground."** This is the mystery of **Understanding** as it exists in Thought within the three Sefirot of the **World of Creation** [Beriyah]. This indicates that the Name descends to the **World of Formation** [Yetzirah]. The "**Fruit**" refers to the "Tiferet" (Beauty/The Son) containing the Foundation; it is the "Fruit of the Righteous" <note>referring to the Foundation of Isaac Luria's teachings</note>. The "**Vine**," the "**Tree**," and the "**Ground**" are all in the mystery of the **World of Action** [Asiyah], meaning in **Sovereignty** [Malchut]. For within her, they manifest as the vine, the tree, the ground, and the fragrances. Our intention is to receive these through the World of Action.

These have the numerical value of **Amen** (91). There are three letters in the word Amen <note>A-M-N</note>, and therefore one must direct their intention with each letter toward the aforementioned Names.
