<meta>This page continues the discussion on the "Kavannot" (mystical intentions) of blessings, specifically focusing on how the words of the blessing formula (Blessed, You, Lord, Our God) correspond to the emanations of the Divine Sefirot and the flow of light from the higher realms to the lower worlds.</meta>

-># The Intention of the Blessings<-

Immediately, the Divine flow is birthed from the **World of Emanation** <term>Atzilut<gloss>The highest of the four worlds in Kabbalah, representing pure divine light and proximity to the Creator</gloss></term> <unclear>to its depths</unclear>. This is why the word **"Blessed"** <note>original: "Baruch"</note> hints at **Understanding** <term>Binah<gloss>The third Sefirah, associated with the Divine Mother and the source of intellectual differentiation</gloss></term>, through the mystery of the **"Point of Zion"** within her. Within this point, the **Supreme Knowledge** <term>Da'at Elyon<gloss>The hidden bridge between the higher intellect and the lower emotional attributes</gloss></term> was sealed, of which it is written: "the bird of prey knows it not" <note>quoting Job 28:7</note>. This is the mystery of "His dwelling is in many waters" and "Your footsteps were not known" <note>quoting Psalm 77:19</note>. This is also according to the verse "And You are holy," in which he placed <unclear>a hidden shoe</unclear> and <unclear>killed/good</unclear>. "And You" adds like miracles.

The explanation is that although the **Foundation of the Father** <term>Yesod d'Abba<gloss>The creative, reproductive force of the highest wisdom (Chokhmah)</gloss></term> broke through via the mystery—as is known—and entered into the "Point of Zion" of the **Mother** <term>Imma<gloss>The Sefirah of Binah</gloss></term> to repair her aspect of **Strength** <term>Gevurah<gloss>The attribute of judgment and restraint</gloss></term>, he remained <unclear>hidden</unclear> within her. However, the path reaches until the level of the Father, and therefore the "Ascent of the Feminine Waters" <term>Mayim Nukvin<gloss>The spiritual initiative or longing that rises from the lower worlds to trigger a divine response</gloss></term> is named after him, for he is the cause that makes the **Feminine Aspect** <term>Nukva<gloss>The female persona of the Divine, often associated with the Shekhinah or the community of Israel</gloss></term> ascend. Understand this well.

Furthermore, although the Foundation of the Father is hidden and concealed there always, and is not revealed up there except during the time they are "clothed" within the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The 'Son' or the personification of the six emotional Sefirot from Kindness to Foundation</gloss></term>, the **Foundation of Understanding** <term>Yesod d'Binah<gloss>The 'womb' or channel through which the Mother's light flows</gloss></term> only reaches the stature of the chest and below. Below that, they nurse from the "sheath" which is the Foundation of the Father, and it is included within and revealed there. However, regarding the Father, they are forever hidden and concealed within the **Five Attributes** <note>original: ה'י</note> of Understanding, because their light is very great, and the Small Face cannot receive them. He must clothe them within their sheath—the **Five Attributes** of Understanding—and through them, he receives the light. This is the meaning of "Your footsteps were not known," etc., meaning that the footsteps—which are the attributes of the Father—were never revealed to the Small Face as a seal.

Returning to the words of the Rabbi: it appears that it should not be difficult in your eyes that we say **"Blessed"** <margin>Section Va’etchanan, 288</margin> hints at **Understanding** based on what is said in the **Zohar** <term>Zohar<gloss>The foundational text of Jewish mysticism</gloss></term> in the portion of *Va’etchanan*, page 288: "The life-repair of the World to Come is called 'Blessed'." This is the point where the Supreme Point is united with the male, and his chest is "Blessed." This hints that Understanding is called "Blessed" because of the mystery of the **Supreme Knowledge** that connects with her through a thin <unclear>path</unclear> of Understanding from the letter **Yod**, which is **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah<gloss>The second Sefirah, representing the flash of intuitive insight</gloss></term>. Just as "Blessed" is the Foundation for Understanding, like the Point of Zion within her, they are included in the word "Blessed."

The "Brain of Wisdom" is <unclear>fixed</unclear> in the letter **Lamed** of "Blessed" <note>original: ברוך</note> to be the "beginning of Wisdom," and this follows the mystery of the Supreme Holiness, the Foundation for Wisdom. The simple letter **Dalet** is the mystery of the **Crown** <term>Keter<gloss>The highest Sefirah, representing Divine Will and the Infinite</gloss></term>, for it is written "the bird of prey knows it not"—this is the **Fiftieth Gate** <term>Sha'ar HaHamishim<gloss>The ultimate level of Understanding (Binah) that is nearly impossible for humans to grasp</gloss></term>, and this is the Supreme Crown as mentioned in the *Tikkunim* <note>the Tikkunei Zohar</note>, because from it is mixed the supreme, hidden drop.

---

Which is the **Crown of the Foundation** <term>Ataret HaYesod<gloss>The tip or 'corona' of the creative attribute, where the light is concentrated before being transmitted</gloss></term> for Wisdom, to receive the Supreme Crown, for there the "drop" is nursed. You could also say it refers to the Foundation of the Small Face, where the **Kingship** <term>Malkhut<gloss>The final Sefirah, representing the physical world and the realization of divine potential</gloss></term> is within the Foundation for Wisdom. The Supreme Crown is his foundation in the external foundation. Therefore, the Foundation of Understanding is called "Blessed" after the abundance of blessings it receives from the Crowns of the Foundations. All is included in the word **"Blessed"** <note>original: ברוך</note>. It is like the word "Blessed" in the <unclear>blessing of its patron</unclear>—the "House of Two," the Higher and Lower Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah<gloss>The indwelling presence of God in the world</gloss></term>.

**"You"** <note>original: Atah</note> is **Kindness** <term>Chesed<gloss>The Sefirah of love, expansive grace, and benevolence</gloss></term>. For after the Divine flow begins from Understanding to Wisdom and is revealed in a place of fullness, it is no longer revealed further down in the place of lack. As mentioned above, this is Wisdom which is made from the "Vessel of Kindness." For there is the illumination of the place of revelation. Therefore, it is called "You," as it says: "You are a priest forever" <note>Psalm 110:4</note>, as mentioned in the Zohar. From there, the flow is birthed to the **Beauty** <term>Tiferet<gloss>The central Sefirah, representing harmony, balance, and the heart of the Small Face</gloss></term>. This is the Knowledge <term>Da'at</term> of the Small Face, the Foundation that connects the "Two Brains."

Afterward, **"Our God"** <note>original: Eloheinu</note> is the mystery of **Strength** <term>Gevurah<gloss>Judgment or Power</gloss></term> included within the Right Side <note>the side of Mercy</note>. Because it is found on two sides, it is called "Our God." It is on two sides: the Right and <unclear>the Left</unclear>. Therefore, it is Judgment. Altogether, there are 19 letters <unclear>in it</unclear>, representing 20 from the left side of Judgment for Understanding and from the side of Beauty which is Mercy. When you repair the secret of the Right side which is Mercy, it includes the mystery of Judgment from the Left. And further, that which is Judgment on the Left includes the Mercy of the Right. Thus, the "Hair of the Left" is included in the Right, and the Right rules. This is as the **Faithful Shepherd** <note>Ra'aya Meheimna, a section of the Zohar</note> says in the portion of *Ekev*, page 279.

The reason for this is the mystery of the Divine flow descending from above to bless the **Attributes** <term>Middot<gloss>The seven lower Sefirot that define the Divine interaction with the world</gloss></term> for their own sake, and not to provide for others. Therefore, this flow only reaches as far as the "Arms." As the Rabbi, of blessed memory, wrote: these are the attributes of Kindness, Strength, and Beauty of the Small Face. This is the mystery of the "Point of Zion" during the time of prayer and the Standing Prayer <term>Amidah<gloss>The central silent prayer of Jewish liturgy</gloss></term>—she has no sustenance of her own, and her Palace stands in place of the souls. They are the "puddles" of the Upper Emanation, and this was his intention—that the Feminine aspect is with them...

# The Gate of the Fringes

<image-desc>A large, rectangular ornamental woodcut border featuring intricate foliate patterns and scrolls. Inside the frame, the title "The Gate of the Fringes" is printed in large, bold square Hebrew characters.</image-desc>

->## The Mystery of the Fringe Threads of the Small<-
->## Prayer Shawl and Their Making<-

**The Ari** <term>Ari<gloss>Rabbi Isaac Luria (1534–1572), the father of contemporary Kabbalah</gloss></term>, of blessed memory, wrote that one must construct the Small Prayer Shawl <term>Tallit Katan<gloss>A fringed garment worn under the shirt daily to fulfill the commandment of Tzitzit</gloss></term> specifically according to the opinion of the Gaon <note>Likely referring to the Vilna Gaon or a specific Geonic tradition regarding the positioning of the fringes</note> and not like the Large Prayer Shawl. This is the reason for the distinction between the attachment and the link, such as the two [letters] **Y-W** <note>Yod and Vav, letters of the Divine Name</note> on each of the four corners of the shawl. One should intend that the "Armed Shell" <note>The *Kelippah*, or forces of spiritual impurity</note> is written and bound; one passes through there and returns to enter through the hole of the corner, then folds it and draws it out through the hem like a warp thread. Both ends of the threads should hang from the side of **Kindness** <term>Chesed<gloss>The Sefirah representing expansion, love, and the right side of the divine configuration</gloss></term> of the corner, and there should be two knots, which one then wraps around as in a Large Prayer Shawl. And as the "branch" of the Small Prayer Shawl lies, it rests upon the corner on the side of Kindness and is not aimed toward the edges of the corner like the Large Prayer Shawl (which is different), for this depends on the thought already mentioned twice regarding the place of the "surrounding hole" of the One. Then the knots sink into its body and emerge from it and are revealed, and it is possible they will proceed with a blessing so that everything rises from the Upper Side.

->## The Mystery of the Fringe Threads of the Large<-
->## Prayer Shawl and Their Making<-

**One** must make eight threads in each of the four corners of the shawl. One should intend for the ends of the eight threads to be over four folds, and their ends should be equal—all eight threads. Then, one wraps with the eighth thread out of the four on the fringes of the Large Prayer Shawl, and let it be a third of "braid" <term>Gedil<gloss>The upper, bound/wrapped part of the fringe</gloss></term> and he shall place it simply with the fifth knot that he ties to its body, so that he may always wrap all the links with it. [This follows] the sign of the thirty threads <note>The Hebrew letter Lamed equals 30</note> from the thirty [names/attributes] of the Holy One, Blessed be He, so that his prayers shall always be like a staff of threads with a knot corresponding to it. And behold, the braid is made such that one ties two threads, one on top of the other, and afterward wraps and enfolds the links.

Every three wraps constitute one link <term>Hulya<gloss>A "link" or segment of the fringe wraps; traditionally, a fringe must have at least seven to thirteen such segments</gloss></term>. Then one returns and ties two knots, one on top of the other, and returns to wrap the links. One does this until four times, totaling eight knots and four sets of links. The first link of the eight from the edge of the corner begins with seven wraps; the second with eight wraps; the third with eleven wraps; and the fourth with thirteen wraps. The total sum corresponds to the numerical value of **"The Lord is One"** <note>In Gematria, the name Y-H-V-H (26) + Echad (13) = 39</note>. One must not add at all to the number of wraps, for it is a "kindness for the commoners." One should tie the ends of the hanging fringe threads so that their braiding does not unravel. (And this is the custom of the *Beit Yosef* in the name of the *Rokeach*, Chapter 11, Section 11).

->## The Mystery of the 39 Wraps<-

Thirty-nine, no more and no less, because they correspond to the numerical value of the Name **Y-H-V-H** <note>The Tetragrammaton</note> in its simple form, its "filling," and the "filling of its filling" <term>Milluy<gloss>A Kabbalistic method of calculating the value of a name by spelling out the names of its letters</gloss></term> totaling 39. For the corner itself, from which the fringes emerge, is the "Face of the Lord," and its numerical value is... <note>The text here uses difficult-to-decipher shorthand regarding the word "Kanaf" (Corner)</note>. Likewise, it corresponds to the 39 letters found in the four "fillings" [of the Name], thus the total is 39.

->## The Mystery of One-Third Braid and Two-Thirds Loose Fringe<-

The reason is that the fringes resemble the Sefirah of **Kingship** <term>Malchut<gloss>The lowest Sefirah, representing the physical world and the feminine aspect of the Divine</gloss></term>. She draws her sustenance from the **Crown, Wisdom, and Understanding** <term>CH-B-T<gloss>Chokhmah, Binah, and Tiferet</gloss></term> of the "Small Face" <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The emotional-active Sefirot, often personified as the "Son" or "Groom" in Kabbalah</gloss></term> from behind the "Upper Shawl" at the place of the hole. Therefore, the Large Prayer Shawl corresponds to the Upper Shawl of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet<gloss>The central Sefirah, harmonizing Kindness and Strength</gloss></term>, and the two-thirds of the "branch" (loose fringe) correspond to the two lower thirds of the "Lower Shawl," which is the aspect of Kingship.

->## The Mystery of 5 Knots, 4 Spaces, and 8 Threads<-

Know that the aspect of Kingship does not possess anything of her own except the Name Y-H-V-H in its simple four-letter form. She lacks the first "filling" which provides for her... and the five knots correspond to the five [levels]... which become her Name in the filling of the letter *He*. And this is also the secret of what is written "with the beauty of the dwelling." Also, there are five knots and four spaces in each and every corner, because the five knots are the five "Kindnesses" that flow from the **Foundation** <term>Yesod<gloss>The Sefirah of connection and procreation</gloss></term> of the Small Face, which is called **Kindness**, for it contains the *Shuruk* vowel in its greatness. These enter into the Foundation of Kingship and include the four spaces, which are the four letters of the Name Y-H-V-H that she possessed previously. And the reason for the 39 letters is...

<header>The Intentions of the Blessings</header>

# The Intentions of the Blessings

These are the letters: The letter **Aleph** [א] represents the vitality of the **Crown** <term>Keter<gloss>The highest of the ten Sefirot, representing Divine Will</gloss></term> of the "One" <note>original: "Aleph," the first letter and numerical value of 1</note>, and a portion of the **Mem** [מ] represents the **Foundation** <term>Yesod<gloss>The ninth Sefirah, representing the channel of transmission and procreation</gloss></term> for the joining of the letter **Zayin** [ז] <note>The text here discusses the mystical shape and combination of letters that form the word 'Amen'</note> at the place of the exchanges, the "two thighs." Thus it is said that the Foundation is the sum of these mysteries, for the length of the Foundation is not as the length of the [letter] **Heh** [ה]. Therefore, from the seven Sefirot comes the mystery of the Foundation over the entire measure of the **Holy of Holies** <term>Kodesh Kodashim<gloss>The inner sanctum, referring here to a high spiritual level</gloss></term>. Their completion is the middle line, which carves the "Seven" like a serpent between the thirty living beings, or the seven of them. All are in the middle line for the Seven, but the **Wisdom** <term>Chokmah<gloss>The second Sefirah, representing intuitive flash and the seed of thought</gloss></term> begins only from the **Beauty** <term>Tiferet<gloss>The central Sefirah of the heart and harmony</gloss></term> and below. From there downwards, the "Recipient" — who is **Rachel** <term>Rachel<gloss>In Kabbalah, the lower aspect of the feminine Divine Presence (Nukvah), representing the manifest world</gloss></term>, the Bride — receives. From there and below, they are joined together in a cycle.

It is well known what is written in the **Tikunim** <term>Tikunei Zohar<gloss>A classic Kabbalistic text composed of seventy commentaries on the first word of the Torah</gloss></term> regarding "their hands were spread out," for they do not pray except from the "lyre" of the arms and legs. The Holy One, blessed be He, is like a beam, because there is no measure of power in the arms and legs like that of the "Small Face" <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The 'Small Face' or Microprosopus, composed of the six Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</gloss></term>. Therefore, it is impossible for these arms and legs to be joined, since they are an addition received from Rachel of the Small Face, except from that point and below. Her entire persona is only within the legs of the Small Face; thus, it is impossible for them to be joined at all in the line of the "Seven" in the measure from the Beauty and below. There they are unified and accepted as a complete light. There, the Name is unified as the combined Name **Y-A-H-D-W-N-H-Y** <note>original: יאהדונהי; a mystical interlacing of the four-letter Name of God (YHWH) and the Name of Lordship (ADNI)</note>. This is like the bread from the celestial realms. Therefore, these vitalities are joined only through the "Amen," for there alone is the voice of their union, and not in any other place.

The matter of joining them together in the "Amen" is as follows: The letter **Aleph** [א] is the secret of the **Crown** of the Small Face. There they are joined as one. For from the side of the "Face," they are the two arms, and from the side of the "Back," they are the shoulders. Then, the **Mem** [מ] is the Foundation; from the front, it is the Foundation of the Small Face, and from the back, it is the **Knowledge** <term>Da'at<gloss>The Sefirah of integration and internalizing wisdom</gloss></term> of the feminine. The letter **Zayin** [ז] <note>Used here to represent the final Nun [ן] of Amen</note> is the secret of the "Sword" that takes the back. It is known that from the mouth of the "Head" to the Foundation, the Crown of all sucks a great light. This light is drawn straight down between the legs. This light issues from the mouth of the Foundation of the "Head," which is within the Foundation of the Small Face. This is a complete night from the mouth of the Foundation of the Bread, but only there. Also, everything drawn from there is from the mouth of the Foundation of his eyes. Its essence is from the "Kindness," for it has no other revelation except the "Face" against it. This "Kindness" serves **Jacob** <term>Yaakov<gloss>Representing the internal, higher aspect of the Small Face</gloss></term>. Behold, the Crown for Jacob is the Crown of the Small Face, and the Knowledge of Jacob is in the Foundation of the Small Face. And all the rest of the body follows that path...

---

...excessively, and it reaches until the Foundation. There, by the power of that "breath" <note>original: "hevel," meaning breath or vapor, used here mystically</note> facing it in every aspect, the body of Jacob is made. This recipient is like the "Small Face" himself in all his ways. This is the secret of the "Hand of the Lord," as mentioned in its place. However, the light also issues from the "breath" of the Small Face himself, from the aspects of **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term> and **Severity** <term>Gevurah</term> of **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> that are contained within him. This too has a beginning and an end. It is received from this "breath" of the Small Face himself, which is from the side of Understanding. From there, the "breath" of Rachel is formed, and her body is made facing him. But regarding Rachel, there is no length to the arms and legs, for they are short and have a mark upon them. But the union of the Small Face is "breath," and the body of Rachel has nothing to lean upon except the power of the "breath" that issues from him. Thus, the mystery of the "Amen" is clarified: it is this "breath" which is the literal breath of the Small Face, specifically within the Name **Y-H-W-H**. Facing it is the body of the feminine, the Name **A-D-N-I**. These were three paths in three places. Therefore, in the first aspect, you should intend the combined Name **Y-A-H-D-W-N-H-Y** and the intention of **Y-H-W-H**. So too with the letter **Zayin** [ז]. This is like the verse "And he went" concerning the secret of "Amen": a deep head for the whole. The meaning is that the time has come, for the "deep head" is the mouth of the Foundation of the "Long Face" <term>Arich Anpin<gloss>The 'Long Face' or Macroprosopus, representing the higher Divine Will</gloss></term> which opens within the Crown of the Small Face. Therefore, the letter **Aleph** [א] is there facing the "Crown of the Back," which is the light of Understanding called "the hidden world," issuing from the mouth of the Foundation, but only in the **Beauty** of the Small Face. This is the secret of the [letter] **Aleph** that is within the Name **Y-H-W-H**. And there is the "Mem," for there is the opening of the mouth of the Foundation called "engraved." The **Mem** [מ] is "open" <note>Referring to the shape of the Hebrew letter</note> at the beginning of the word, and this is the Foundation of the Small Face. Facing it from behind is the "closed" **Mem** [ם], which is the "closed Knowledge" of the feminine. The **Nun** [ן] is "straight" or "bent." "Straight" faces the "breath" of the Foundation of the Small Face, which is straight and upright. In it are contained three [powers]. The body of the feminine from the back is called "bent." This, then, is the matter of the intention of "Amen." However, the [ultimate] intention is to bring down the supernal light from Understanding, the "Higher World," down through the three places of the arms and the Foundation.

## Now that we have written the order of the blessings, each in its proper place, one must then put on the Large Prayer Shawl. Therefore, we shall now begin, with the help of Heaven, the laws of the Fringes.

<meta>This page continues the technical and mystical explanation of ritual measurements, specifically moving from the spiritual mechanics of the Sefirot (Divine emanations) to the physical requirements of the Tzitzit (ritual fringes). It explores how the "Severities" are "sweetened" by "Kindnesses" through specific physical measurements of the fingers.</meta>

<header>Guarded Matzah</header>
<sig>Gimel 2 3</sig>

In the Divine, these are the Sefirot of **Kindness, Severity, Beauty, Victory, Splendor, and Foundation** <term>CHAGAT NEHI<gloss>An acronym for the six emotional attributes of the Divine: Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet, Netzach, Hod, and Yesod</gloss></term>. The entirety of this follows the mystery of the **Kindnesses** <term>Hasadim<gloss>The expansive, giving light of the Divine</gloss></term> as they ascend from the **Foundation** <term>Yesod<gloss>The Sefirah of connection and transmission</gloss></term> and upward to enlarge the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The personification of the six emotional Sefirot, often compared to the 'Son' or 'Groom' in Kabbalah</gloss></term> to seven levels through the "sweetening" of the **Severities** <term>Gevurot<gloss>The restrictive, judging forces that require tempering by Kindness</gloss></term> located there. There is no doubt that the "Severity within Severity" is the source of all existences, and the process of sweetening proceeds through the **Kindness, Severity, and Beauty** <term>CHAGAT<gloss>Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet</gloss></term> within those Severities. This is entirely sweetened because the action of the Kindnesses sweetens the **Beauty** <term>Tiferet<gloss>The central Sefirah of balance</gloss></term> a second time; thus, Beauty is found to be sweetened twice, as discussed in the study of the creation of the **Universal Vessel** <note>original: "Kug"a" - likely a reference to a specific Kabbalistic diagram or concept</note>. Therefore, all of them possess the power of sweetening.

It is found that when the Severities received their governance, the **Thumb** <term>Gudal<gloss>In Kabbalah, the thumb represents the most potent aspect of the Severities</gloss></term> was only half-sweetened. This is because it acts as a mediator. Since it is an aspect of Severity, its other half—which joins the seven—remains without sweetening, as it is distant from the Kindnesses at the time of their ascent. The "Kindness within Severity" was already sweetened at the beginning, leaving only half of it sweetened. Therefore, when we seek to know the measure of the sweetening of the Severities, we must measure specifically by the **Thumb**, which is the "knot" (joint) of the Severities, because it mediates between them all. This is the mystery: "less than the joint of the thumb is not considered." In the thumb, there are two segments, and the "two of the thumb" constitutes one joint, corresponding to the half that is sweetened. Therefore, the Sages commanded that the **fringes** <note>original: "Ha-nigit," a variation or error for Tzitzit</note> be placed only above the thumb joint and below the width of three fingers. Even though these three fingers represent **Kindness, Severity, and Beauty**, all are considered "fingers" following the lead of the index finger, which is the "Severity within Severity," for they all originate as Severities.

### The reason we measure the three fingers by their width, one on top of the other, while the thumb joint is measured by its vertical length.

The matter is as follows: The Severities descend first from the **Foundation**, and afterward, the three "Revealed Kindnesses" descend to sweeten them. When they descend, they descend one by one, and not in their standing order. Although the Severities themselves stand in their established order, the Kindnesses descend upon them one atop the other. Therefore, the measure of the three fingers is by the width, one on top of the other, representing their sweetening through the process of descent. However, during the process of ascent, they all rise through the **Middle Line** <term>Kav HaEmtza'i<gloss>The path of balance between the Right and Left spiritual poles</gloss></term>. They reach neither the "Understanding" of the right line nor the "Kindness" of the left line. The reason is that since they do not spread out in their established order, they do not illuminate the aspect of the Severities of **Understanding** <term>Binah<gloss>The third Sefirah, the 'Mother'</gloss></term>. This is another stage of the process of ascent.

The light of the ascending Kindnesses is diminished, and therefore they only ascend through the Middle Line. But once they reach the three upper Severities that have not yet been sweetened, they spread out in their established order to sweeten them. Thus, we find that nothing is sweetened twice during both ascent and descent except for **Beauty** <term>Tiferet<gloss>The heart center</gloss></term> alone. It is also found that in the ascent, they rise one on top of the other through the Middle Line in a straight, vertical fashion. They do not rise from Foundation to Understanding, and from Understanding to Beauty, and from Beauty to the upper three—though it might seem so now. It would have been appropriate to measure them one on top of the other, but because they rise vertically through the Middle Line, the thumb is held upright. We measure the thumb joint and the fingers as they rise through the Middle Line, rather than through the "Lot" <note>original: "Goral," perhaps a scribal error for "Gidul" (growth) or a specific reference to the Right side</note> which is Kindness. We have already explained the reason: we take the mediator, which is the joint, as mentioned above.

### The difference between the Blue Fringes and the White Fringes that we practice now.

-> After the Destruction of the Temple <-

-> One must know the traditions to be upheld <-

For the aspect of the **External Levels** <term>Z"K<gloss>Likely Zivugim Kadishin (Holy Unions) or related to Zeir Anpin</gloss></term> which are clothed in the lower worlds of **Creation, Formation, and Action** <term>BY"A<gloss>Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah</gloss></term> from the "Mother," two types of fringes descend. One consists of four fringes originating from the **Wisdom of the Mother** <term>Chokmah d'Imma<gloss>The intuitive capacity within the Divine Mother</gloss></term>, which acts as "Understanding to the Father," as the Sages of blessed memory said. This is the mystery of the fringes used while the Holy Temple still stood. At that time, all the fringes were made of **White** wool, and the eighth string was the **Blue** <term>Tekhelet<gloss>The biblical blue dye made from the Chilazon snail</gloss></term> over all the corners. But after the Destruction, four fringes descend from the "Seven Lower Attributes of the Mother's Understanding," and they consist of eight strings that are all white, with no Blue at all.

### The mystery of the two Blue Fringes.

Behold, the **Mentalities** <term>Mohin<gloss>Divine 'brains' or intellectual energies</gloss></term> that descend from the "Wisdom of the Mother," which is clothed in the "Understanding of the Father" as mentioned, were all from four Mentalities. These are the four names of **Y-H-V** <note>The Tetragrammaton Y-H-V-H minus the last letter</note> expanded through the methods of **72, 63, 45, and 52** <term>Av, Sag, Mah, Ban<gloss>The four systems of expanding the Hebrew letters of the Name of God, each totaling a different numerical value</gloss></term>. Know that within the internal "Mentalities" <term>Mohin<gloss>Divine intellectual energies that sustain a persona</gloss></term> there are three levels: the Mentalities of **Gestation** <note>original: עיבור</note>, of **Nursing** <note>original: יניקה</note>, and of **Maturity** <note>original: גדלות</note>. It is already known that the Mentalities of Gestation and Nursing are associated with the names of **Elohim** <note>the name of God associated with Judgment</note>, but the Mentalities of Maturity are the names of **Y-H-V-H** <note>the Tetragrammaton, associated with Mercy</note>.

And behold, from these three types of Mentalities, three types of **Hair** <note>original: שערות</note> emerge. The "Hair" of the Mentalities of Maturity, and the "Filaments" <term>Nimin<gloss>Fine, thin hairs or strands</gloss></term> which are more numerous than the Mentalities of Nursing, and the "Spikes" <term>Kotzin<gloss>Short, stiff hairs, literally 'thorns'</gloss></term> that are stronger, from the Mentalities of Gestation. And because the Mentalities of Maturity are the names of **Y-H-V-H** filled out to the values of 72, 63, 45, and 52 <note>Kabbalistic expansions of the Name</note>, where every Name has ten letters, therefore the hair is called **S-E-A-R** <note>original: שער; Hair</note>... and also because it corresponds to the first *Yud* <note>the letter י</note> among them.

And behold, the Spikes that emerge from the Mentalities of Gestation precede this, before the full lighting; they grow little by little until the arrival of the Mentalities of Maturity. This corresponds to the secret in the Skull... reaching down to the head of the **Female Persona** <note>original: נוקבא; the feminine aspect of the Divine</note>... these are generally called by the nickname (meaning: that which the Master wrote to calculate with the intention of 400... because the Spikes are for the hair and they whiten from the side of Kindness. However, the Filaments appear later during the time of "Nursing," and therefore they are not as large or as clear as the Spikes from the time of Gestation. They only spread as far as the head of **Leah** <note>The higher feminine persona</note> opposite the throat of the "Small Face," for there the head of Leah begins. These Filaments are shorter hairs, and they grow within the hairs of the... called Spikes.

They emerge last from the Mentalities of Maturity, and therefore they are shorter than all of them. These do not spread out, but rather they stand on the Skull of the head of the "Small Face" itself for its own sake. Therefore, these hairs that emerge from the Mentalities of Maturity are not bent and drawn downwards; rather, they stand upright on the Skull to serve as the aspect of "Surrounding Light" <term>Or Makif<gloss>Divine light that is too sublime to be internalized and thus 'surrounds' the persona</gloss></term> for the head of the "Small Face" itself. If they were bent and their power descended below upon the Skull, they would not illuminate the Skull of the "Small Face" itself. But the Spikes and the Filaments, which are there to illuminate the heads of **Leah** and **Rachel** <note>the two feminine personae</note>, are therefore bent and descend and are drawn downwards to the heads of Leah and Rachel. Therefore... a "Spike" is for the hair alone, and it illuminates the Mentalities of the Female Persona, and this is even more so as their power goes outward...

## The Secret of the Required Size for a "Great Tallit"

The rule is that a "small one" <note>likely referring to a child or a smaller version of the garment</note> must be able to cover his head and most of his body with it. What is the secret of the **Tallit** <term>Tallit<gloss>The Jewish prayer shawl, usually made of wool or silk, with ritual fringes attached to its four corners</gloss></term>, and why is it called by that name?

It is known that the [holy] place hints at a secret: there are two types of "Surrounding Light" <term>Ohr Makif<gloss>In Kabbalistic thought, "Surrounding Light" is divine energy that is too intense to be internalized by the soul, so it encompasses the person from the outside</gloss></term>.
1. The first is the **Outer and Upper Surrounding Light**, the highest of all, which never enters inside the vessel due to its intensity. It surrounds the entirety of the "Light" from the outside.
2. The second is a **Smaller Surrounding Light**. After it enters the inner secret within the "Light," it returns, breaks through, and rises out from the "Inner Mentalities" <term>Mohin<gloss>The intellectual or "mental" levels of the divine persona</gloss></term>, manifesting above in the form of "Human Hair" and "Beards." There, the Surrounding Light provides a sign for the three "Head" faculties, which is the place of the brain.

Thus, we find that whatever exists in the innermost part—the three Inner Mentalities—exists in the exact same way on the outside as the returning "Surrounding Light," which becomes the "Hair of the Head." Consequently, the light surrounding the hair is an inner surround... and these are the aspect of the **Tzitzit** (fringes) of the Tallit, as will be explained later.

However, the **Tallit itself** is a Surrounding Light that is above them; it is a more external, older, and greater light. It surrounds the entire collective light. Because this "inner" surrounding light (the fringes) is swallowed up and hidden within the "Great Surrounding Light" (the Tallit itself), and because the light of the Tallit is a very great light—so vast that it cannot be grasped by us—there is no inherent "holiness" [attached] to the Tallit cloth itself <note>This refers to the legal distinction where the fringes are "objects of a commandment" while the cloth is "an accessory to a commandment"</note>. Nevertheless, in its root above, its light is very great.

Therefore, the two names... are not recognized or revealed except in the "Fringes" of the Tallit at the four corners, which come from the Mind. From there onward, the aspect of the "Tallit" ceases.
Another reason: every Surrounding Light is situated exactly above the Inner Mentalities. And just as the voices are not revealed from within...

...the place, and to diminish a handbreadth <term>Tefach<gloss>A traditional unit of measure, roughly the width of a fist</gloss></term>, which is the end and conclusion of the "Foundation" <term>Yesod<gloss>The Sefirah representing the channel of transmission and the procreative faculty</gloss></term> of the **Lesser Face** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The "Small Face" or Divine Persona composed of the six emotional attributes, often personified as a young man or the Groom</gloss></term> clothed within. This is also why the **Tzitzit** are not revealed except down below, at the place where the lights are revealed.

Now, although the "Hair" is the surround for the entire expansion of the *Zeir Anpin*, nevertheless, until one reaches the level called "Tallit," the hair there cannot be grasped in its fullness; it is merely a general recognition. The numerical value <term>Gematria<gloss>A system of assigning numerical values to Hebrew letters to find deeper connections between words</gloss></term> of "Tallit" [טלית] is connected to the "Great Repair," as the master explained.

# Tzemach Shapira
### [Page 21]

**"Let your garments always be white..."** <note>Ecclesiastes 9:8</note> and before me in the book of *Sully* <note>Likely referring to a specific manuscript or a commentary on King Solomon's works</note>—this refers to the **Tzitzit** <term>Tzitzit<gloss>The ritual fringes commanded in the Torah to be worn on four-cornered garments</gloss></term>, for their revealed whiteness is symbolic. Sometimes the **Tallit Katan** <term>Tallit Katan<gloss>A "small shawl" or fringed garment worn daily under the shirt</gloss></term> consists of various colors. His words are as follows: "Every instance of the expression 'in His garment' <note>original: במתנו; referring to the Divine</note> refers to wrapping oneself in a white shawl, which is a sign of forgiveness and atonement. For just as white signifies a stripping away of impurities, so white signifies forgiveness and mercy." Thus far his words.

Furthermore, one must be careful that it is of the required size. The rule is: any child who is nine or ten years old <note>original: שתעס; likely an abbreviation for nine (תשע) or ten (עשר)</note> must be able to cover his head and the majority of his body with it. An adult should not be ashamed to go out in it, as noted in *Pirchei Yitzchak*. Many people err in this, making "small shawls" that are too small and thus reciting a blessing in vain. This also results in a desecration of the Sabbath, because if the garment lacks the minimum size to be considered a legal garment for fringes, the fringes are merely a "burden" being carried [in a public domain where carrying is forbidden]. Therefore, one who fears the word of the Lord will be careful to make it as large as possible; for if it is longer and wider, God will not be strict with him.

Additionally, one must ensure that the **Tallit Katan** is made specifically of sheep's wool, so that the commandment of the fringes remains a Torah-level obligation <note>original: מדאורייתא; according to many authorities, only wool and linen are biblically required to have fringes; other materials are rabbinic</note>. For if it is made of scattered or combed wool, or the "covered" wool of the gentiles, such as *muslieret* or *galmolist* <note>original: מוסליירט וג'למו ליסט; likely types of processed wool or imported fabrics like muslin</note>, it is not subject to the fringes by Torah law. If it is made of linen, it is forbidden to attach fringes to it, lest one come to sew it with wool <note>original: ורמי ותפור סוס; refers to the prohibition of Shatnez, mixing wool and linen</note>, for wool joined with linen relates to the "Upper Rachel" <note>A Kabbalistic persona representing a specific divine configuration</note> and the foundation of her "foot" which must be protected.

If the wool is from sheep, it is known that all "hairs" indicate an attachment to the "outer" forces. However, there is a hint that the "hairs" of the Upper Faces are as pure as sheep's wool. Therefore, they must be white, as the Teacher [Isaac Luria] <note>original: הרב זל; refers to the Ari, the famous 16th-century Kabbalist</note> wrote: "His garment was as white as snow" <note>Daniel 7:9</note>. The number of the fringes is eight; therefore the wool must be white as snow.

Know also that the concept of the **Tallit Gadol** <term>Tallit Gadol<gloss>The "Large Shawl" worn specifically during morning prayers</gloss></term> corresponds to the "outer" aspect of the lower three sections of the World of Formation <note>original: יצירה; Yetzirah, the second of the four spiritual worlds in Kabbalah</note>. Therefore, one must wear it over all other garments, on the outside. But the **Tallit Katan** corresponds to the "inner" aspect of those same three sections of the World of Formation; therefore, one must wear it below, beneath all the garments. This is contrary to the opinion of some Kabbalists who place it above their clothes, which is a great flaw. One should instead place it beneath all the garments, directly over the silk shirt.

Now, the **Tallit Katan** is a concept related to the angel **Metatron** <term>Metatron<gloss>In Jewish mysticism, the highest of the angels and the "Prince of the Presence"</gloss></term>, who "wraps himself in his shawl," as mentioned in the Zohar (Portion Pinchas). And in the Talmud (Tractate Shabbat, chapter "With what [may a beast go out]"), it says that whoever is diligent in the fringes will merit to have servants in the future. The matter is this: the mouth <note>original: פה</note> of this world equals the numerical value of "Jerusalem" [500]. There are five hundred, which is the letter *He* [ה] alone. The numerical value of **Metatron** is equivalent to that of a "servant" [314], and therefore servants will serve him, totaling the number of the "small portion." Thus far his words.

(And in my humble opinion, I wrote: how is it possible that Rabbi Isaac [Luria] would disagree with our Talmud, which states that in the future, ten men from every language of the nations will take hold of the corner of a Jewish man's garment? This would total 2,800 servants for every Jew! <note>Based on Zechariah 8:23: 10 men x 70 nations x 4 corners = 2,800</note>. Perhaps there was a transcription error in the writings of the Ari. Thus, it should be said that the secret of the fringes is that one merits 2,500 servants in the future. The reason for the **Tallit Katan** is found in **Metatron**, the Prince of the Presence, who is "two thousand minus one." If there is one defending angel out of a thousand, that is Metatron. This aligns with the "small souls" of the World of Formation, where there are permutations of "mouths" that total 1,500 as mentioned. Thus, we have 2,500 in the soul of Metatron himself. I wrote all this to reconcile the Kabbalistic words of Isaac Luria with our Talmud.)

# Why are Women and Children Exempt?

Regarding fringes, it would seem appropriate to suggest that a child should wear them, since the entire essence of the fringes is to provide nourishment to the state of "Smallness" <term>Katnut<gloss>A Kabbalistic term for an immature spiritual state</gloss></term>. However, this is answered by what is explained in the "Gate of Inquiry": his life-force grows and reaches downward from the "Head of the Firmament" until it is covered by the "Brains of Greatness" <term>Mochin de-Gadlut<gloss>A mature spiritual state characterized by expanded divine consciousness</gloss></term>. Only then do the "sparks" descend below and become revealed from the "hole" and downward. But before there are "Brains of Greatness," the fringes do not manifest in the aspect of the "Smallness of Fire." Therefore, a minor is not legally obligated to wrap himself in fringes.

(I have written in my humble opinion regarding the "Inquiry" on the Lulav and Hanukkah: A minor who knows how to wrap himself is obligated in fringes. The intention is that there are "male souls" who possess "Brains of Greatness" even during their "Smallness" <note>Meaning some children are spiritually precocious</note>, as is written in the book of the *Plain Commentators*. There, he will acquire the holy lights and possess "Knowledge" in the mornings. Therefore, the Sages said: "A child who knows how to wrap himself," because he has already grown and established his names to access the secret of the holy "Smallness.")

# Matzat Shmurim
### [Page 21]

Until the ten emanations enter the "Field," eight levels rise to the top of the three <note>referring to the three intellectual faculties: Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge</note> upon the head of the **Zeir Anpin** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The "Small Face" or "Microprosopus," a central divine persona in Kabbalah representing the emotive qualities of God</gloss></term> at the place of the hair opposite his forehead. This draws a surrounding light into the mental faculties of the **Zeir Anpin** and casts the "husk" <note>original: קליפה (Klipah); the forces of impurity or spiritual debris</note> outward. This thread that rises to the top of the head of the Male is called a "son" <note>original: נין (Nin)</note>, a term for remembrance, and it spreads over the head of the **Zeir Anpin**. To remember this, the thread at the top of the head of the **Zeir Anpin** is itself called **Tzitzit** <term>Tzitzit<gloss>Ritual fringes</gloss></term>, a feminine term, because it extends and is consumed at the head of the **Nukva** <term>Nukva<gloss>The Feminine Principle or the "Female" aspect of the Divine</gloss></term>, and it also becomes the fringes of the **Nukva**. This concludes his words.

(And to me, a commoner, <margin>I say:</margin> what they said regarding the **Zeir Anpin** in the feminine tongue is because the fringe is nothing other than a "branch" <note>original: ענף (Anaf)</note>. Although there are three types of hair, the fringe is specifically the "thorns" that spread out like a single branch, where all five fringes <note>original: ה' ציציות; this may refer to the five knots or a specific grouping of threads</note> are connected together in one source. It is called a "branch" because it spreads downward over the head of the **Nukva**, "beautiful in vista, the joy of the whole earth" <note>Psalm 48:3</note>. In Tractate Rosh Hashanah, in the chapter 'They saw him in the court,' they call a bride <note>original: לכלה</note> by the name "Beautiful Vista" <note>original: יפה נוף (Yafeh Nof)</note>. The intention is that this branch from the head of the Male is an addition to the Bride, and all her beauty comes from this thread called a "branch." Therefore, she is called by the name of the Bride's crown, a complete beauty. For the Matriarch Rachel was "beautiful in form and beautiful in appearance." Thus, the fringe is nothing but a branch of the power of the upper source. But the intentions and the hairs themselves are not called fringes. Now he brings support for our understanding that these added mental states from the "small state" <note>original: קטנות (Katnut); the immature or constricted state of divine consciousness</note> are divided into three parts... <note>The text here enters a complex numerical calculation involving the names of God in various expansions</note> ...this is the secret of the simple 'A' of the fringe. But regarding what he wrote about needing to spread the fringe over it, we will explain later, God willing, in the name of his great teacher from Safed, may his memory be for a blessing. Furthermore, <margin>the editor notes:</margin> regarding the section on the fringes, "And it shall be for you for a fringe," there are sixty fringes corresponding to the sixty warriors of King Solomon, even though the aspect before him is in the secret of "smallness." This is called "Small," and it is the secret of the Angel Metatron. The **Tallit Katan** <term>Tallit Katan<gloss>The "Small Prayer Shawl" worn under the daily shirt</gloss></term> never departs from him. And this is the secret of the small fringe: why it is named so and what its essence is.)

## Know
That for the **Tallit Katan**, one must wrap the five levels of the "Smallness" within it. The reason is that during the state of gestation <note>original: עיבור (Ibur)</note> within **Binah** <term>Binah<gloss>Understanding, the Divine Mother persona</gloss></term>, it consists only of the lower extremities. In that state, it has no head and no arms, but is only a single simple body like the head of a fetus. Therefore, the **Tallit Katan** does not require the ritual wrapping of the head and arms <note>unlike the large prayer shawl worn during formal prayer</note>.

(Nevertheless, the **Ari z"l** <note>Rabbi Isaac Luria, the foundational 16th-century Kabbalist</note> used to write that he would wear the **Tallit Katan** by first wrapping it over his head and then pulling it down onto his body as he dressed. This was his specific intention.)

But one must understand the reason for saying that the **Tallit Katan** belongs to the World of Formation <note>original: יצירה (Yetzirah)</note>. We see that the **Tallit Katan** is only for wrapping. The matter is this: whenever a person elevates any "surrounding light" <note>original: אור מקיף (Or Makif)</note> from **Binah** which spreads to the four corners, there are two aspects. After the time of "smallness," when the **Zeir Anpin** was in the secret of gestation within her, he had mental faculties in the aspect of "three included in three," and she encompassed him. This is called the **Tallit Katan**, which protects him during his time of "smallness." This corresponds to the World of Action <note>original: עשיה (Asiyah)</note> even though it is only for wrapping. If so, the **Tallit Katan** is in the World of Formation, for it had a status there while in the womb. But the light he brings now is the **Tallit Gadol** <term>Tallit Gadol<gloss>The "Large Prayer Shawl" worn during morning prayers</gloss></term>. Therefore, when a person is inside his home, he only needs to wear the **Tallit Katan**, which represents the state of gestation within **Binah**. However, when coming to the Synagogue—which is the place of **Binah** and the aspect of Sovereignty—this entry follows the washing of hands and represents the honor of the "Great State" <note>original: גדלות (Gadlut); mature divine consciousness</note>. This is the aspect of the **Tallit Gadol**. Because this secret is simple and remains with the person even at night, for he returns to the secret of gestation within **Binah**—as the "Great Mentalities" depart at night—it is proper for a pious person not to remove the **Tallit Katan** from himself at any time, even while he is sleeping, except when entering the bathhouse. This is the meaning of the teaching that "Rabbi Akiva washed himself naked in the bathhouse," but not while sleeping, for he would have his **Tallit Katan** on him.

<margin>The editor, R. Sh. says:</margin> In the chapter 'Ha-Techelet,' regarding the version of the blessing for the fringe, the intention is that since the aspect of the **Tallit Katan** does not depart from the **Zeir Anpin** even during the time of "sleep" <note>original: דורמיטא (Dormita); a Kabbalistic term for a state of divine withdrawal</note>, we are therefore always obligated in the fringe. Understand this well. Furthermore, it seems to me it is good to tie the fringes of the **Tallit Katan** with white, as it says: "At all times let [your garments] be..."

# Matzat Shmurim
### [Page 22]

The interpretation of the **Blue Thread** <note>original: "Tekhelet"</note> is known to refer to the sinews. Similarly, the "braid" <note>original: "Gedillim"</note> of the body grows and enlarges as an ornament. The "enclosure" <note>original: "Kozert"</note> is like a fifth of the shearings, and the entirety of the governance is a garment like a stalk that grows in the name of the "Greatness" <note>original: "Migdal"</note>. Thus, the **Tzitzit** <term>Tzitzit<gloss>The ritual fringes worn on four-cornered garments, intended to remind the wearer of the commandments</gloss></term> etc., as the Sages taught, are at the end of all the years, etc. Like a crown, it leaves a place for a simple discharge. This follows the numerical value of **Tzitzit** <note>In Hebrew Gematria, Tzitzit (ציצית) equals 600. Combined with 8 threads and 5 knots, it totals 613, the number of commandments</note>. It is known that there are 30 "surroundings" which are the thirteen strands of the **Tzitzit**, and they are the four **Tzitzit** on the four corners. Since these lights of the sinews pass through the "sixty secrets" to the external nations, therefore the very end of the process is to draw blood <note>original: "Le-hakiz," a play on words between 'surrounding' (Hekif) and bloodletting</note>, which corresponds to the numerical value of "K.K.K." <note>A mystical cipher for divine names</note>. This represents the holiness of the blessing, which ultimately allows one to understand the "Complete Foundation" <note>original: "Yesod Shalem"</note>. This is the meaning of the verse: "From the wing of the earth we have heard songs, glory to the Righteous One" <note>original: "Mikenaf Ha'Aretz Zemirot Shamanu Tzevi LaTzadik" (Isaiah 24:16)</note>, as mentioned in the **Ra'aya Mehemna** <term>Ra'aya Mehemna<gloss>A later layer of the Zohar, the foundational work of Jewish mysticism, focusing on the mystical reasons for the commandments</gloss></term> in the portion of *Shelach*, page 178, side A.

Understand that just as from the **Supernal Knowledge** <note>original: "Da'at Elyon"</note>—which is the "Tongue" of which it is written that the "Mouth" flows from it in the aspect of the "Reed"—it looks out and clothes all the lower extremities in the aspect of the "Foundation" <note>original: "Yesod"</note>. I have supported this by saying that the "All" <note>original: "Ha-Kol"</note> looks out and covers, and they are in the aspect of the "garments of the **Tzitzit**." It is also possible to say that the "Pocket" <note>original: "Kis"</note> is known to come from the three primary mental faculties of the Divine Father and Mother <note>original: "Abba ve-Imma"</note>, which according to the secret of the four loops and the "coins of the Alephs" <note>referring to the shapes of Hebrew letters in mystical diagrams</note>, and the lower "Nun" letters to understand. However, in the wisdom of the Holy One, it is not neglected; it has an interior and a city, like a complete "Face" <note>original: "Partzuf"</note>. It has the names of the garment in the "Wing" and the "Alephs" in the back, to understand the Foundation. If so, it is found that the four mental faculties take from the beginning of the clothing of the Divine Father and Mother which shine, and they are the four "interpretations" to understand, and they are the secret of the **Four Corners** of the **Tallit** <term>Tallit<gloss>A Jewish prayer shawl with fringes on its four corners</gloss></term>.

Regarding the primary "loops," they do not reach that understanding except through the Foundation. Nevertheless, when passing through, they all take a portion from there. Therefore, all their lengths are in the aspect of "K.K.K.," which is the place of understanding, and in the "Kissi" <note>my throne</note> for the Queen. They are called **Tzitzit** after the lights themselves, which are the aspect of the fringes mentioned above. There is also an aspect of "others" who take the pair of trousers, which are in the aspect of "strength," and they are also the aspect of **Tzitzit**. For four times "to understand" equals the numerical value of "K.K.K." and they correspond to the **Tzitzit**. And behold, after they are sealed on the outside, even though she is called another from the strength of understanding, nevertheless her garments are in the soul only as mentioned. For it is known that in the collective of the "Four Brains" <note>original: "Mochin"</note> of the Father and Mother, they are the names of God <note>original: "72, 63, 45, and 52," referring to the different expansions of the Tetragrammaton</note>. And the collective of the four brains of Father and Mother are the four interpretations of the letters *Aleph*, *Vav*, and *Dalet*. And if so, these four brains can copy the aspect of—

---

—the **Tzitzit**, which are not the mental faculties of the "Back" <note>original: "Achurayim"</note> as mentioned above. These are Divine Names <note>original: "Elohim"</note>, and they correspond to the "overflowing" <note>original: "Yitro"</note>. When you remove from them the 17 "deep letters"—which are the "open letters" that remain—the remainder is the numerical value of **Tzitzit**. Thus, there are many aspects to the name **Tzitzit**.

It appears to me, **Natan Nata** <note>The author, Nathan Nata Shapira</note>, that corresponding to the three intentions mentioned before, one should take the secret of **Tzitzit**, which are the aspect of the "Five" as mentioned. And like the aspect of the "K.K.K.," and in the third aspect of the four fillings of the Divine Name. Correspondingly, within the Torah, the word **Tzitzit** is written in the portion of **Tzitzit**. And one must be very careful with every word of **Tzitzit** to meditate on the "Five" of the groups. Behold, all three of the aforementioned intentions are in one "opening." And there is outside another aspect of **Tzitzit**, which is the "Thorn" <note>the tip of a letter or hair</note>. The "Lock of Hair" <note>original: "Kvutzat Ha-Sa'ar"</note> in the line is the aspect of **Tzitzit**, and they correspond to the four **Tzitzit** of the **Tallit**. For the "groups" join with the "fringes" and they all become one ascent.

Regarding the square aspect of the "Thorn" of the **Tallit**, it is said in the portion of *Ki Tetzei*: "You shall make yourself **twisted cords** <note>original: "Gedillim"</note> on the four corners of your garment with which you cover yourself" <note>Deuteronomy 22:12</note>. The reason is because it is not clear in the "Black Thorn" that it is the number of the **Tzitzit**, therefore it is expressed in the language of "braids" <note>Gedillim</note> and did not say "you shall make Tzitzit." This is why it says "with which you cover yourself," for the "Thorn" or "Lock of Hair" covers the head and most of the body. We also maintain that the source causes a "Surrounding Light" <note>original: "Makkif"</note> in the secret of the **Tefillin** <term>Tefillin<gloss>Phylacteries; leather boxes containing Torah verses worn during prayer</gloss></term>, which is the garment of the Divine Male. Therefore, the "Thorn" is also called the language of "covering of the Tzitzit." This is why it says "with which you cover **him**" <note>original: "ba-H," a play on the Hebrew letter 'He' which equals 5</note>—specifically "H" <note>5</note> for the wings of the Divine Male, which is the "Thorn" in the business of the surrounding light.

And why is the prohibition "you shall not sow your vineyard with diverse seeds" <note>original: "Kila'im"</note> placed next to the verse "and that you seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which you use to go astray" in the portion of **Tzitzit**? 

The reason is that one who is careful with the commandment of **Tzitzit** is as if he is saved from the temptation of the **Evil Inclination** <note>original: "Yetzer Ha-Ra"</note> which entices a person to follow promiscuity. As our Sages of blessed memory said in the chapter *Ha-Tekhelet* <note>Talmud, Menachot 44a</note> regarding the story of the pious man who went to the cities of the sea to visit a famous courtesan, and his four **Tzitzit** came and slapped him across the face, and he immediately slipped away and sat upon the ground. Because every aspect of the "Inner Light" comes from the secret of Understanding <note>Binah</note>, which is in the place of the "Upper Remembrance." In that "Foundation," there is a "tongue of those" who seek to suckle from there in the place of "strangers." Therefore, whoever is careful with the thirty-two threads of the **Tzitzit**—which surround the thirty-two paths of wisdom—reaches the "Foundation of Understanding." It is as if one who defiles his covenant with his own impure foundation would cling to a "stranger," but through this commandment, he is protected.

# The Commandment of Tzitzit
<meta>Catchword: Properly</meta>

One must be meticulous regarding the commandment of **Understanding** <note>original: "Binah," the third Sefirah, associated with the divine Mother and the source of the fringes</note> to precisely follow its reasons and secrets. It is like a leaf or a sprout, similar to **Wisdom** <note>original: "Hokhmah," the second Sefirah</note> in its middle. From her labor, it does not clarify through our actions here and there; rather, it emerges in the morning to clothe the "inner midsts" from the power of **Understanding**. Therefore, it is necessary for these "inner midsts" to be modeled after **Wisdom**, to provide a "seal" within the inner parts like a mother’s womb. The secret of this is the number 116 <note>The Hebrew letters for "Tower" (Migdal) equal 116</note>, which comprises the four names of **Y-H-V** <note>The Tetragrammaton, representing Wisdom</note> which are included in Wisdom, along with the four names of **E-H-Y-E** <note>The divine name "I Shall Be," representing Understanding</note> which are included in Understanding. Together they come to the numerical value of "Years of Life." This is the secret of the verse: "And they shall add to you years of life" <note>Proverbs 3:2</note>, because they connect to the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The "Small Face" or Divine Son in Kabbalah, representing the six emotional attributes of the divine</gloss></term> in the aspect of a King in his palace. After that comes the **Tefillin** <term>Tefillin<gloss>Phylacteries; leather boxes containing Torah verses worn during prayer</gloss></term>, and these are the "two brains" <note>intellectual emanations</note> that are the secret of the union with the Mother in the holiness of "Years of Life," for the light dwells in the holiness of "Life," which is the secret of the brain of **Knowledge** <note>original: "Da'at"</note>. It is known that all the lights of the "brains" emerge openly within the four directions from the "chest" and above, which is the "Foundation of the Mother" <note>original: "Yesod de-Imma"</note>. During the time all lights pass through it and emerge from it into the inner four directions openly, this "Foundation of the Mother" takes 116 lights for itself. This is the secret of the "Tower" <note>original: "Migdal"</note> in the aspect of the **Foundation** <note>original: "Yesod"</note>, and the rest of the lights of the brains emerge outside openly.

Note that this is not always so, but rather from the power of the "Foundation" in the count of the "inner midsts" and the "Tower," for all of this is also in the aspect of the **Surrounding Light** <note>original: "Or Makif"</note>, which are the "hairs" mentioned earlier. Do not err, for we are speaking here of the aspect of the "inner midsts."

<meta>This page continues the discussion on the relative holiness of ritual objects. It specifically compares the spiritual roots of Tefillin and the Tallit/Tzitzit, delving into the Zohar's distinction between "accessories of a commandment" and "accessories of holiness." It then moves into a mystical explanation of why the fringe threads must be separated, using the metaphor of "Aramean locks" to discuss the containment of external spiritual forces (Klipot).</meta>

# The Commandment of Safeguards
<note>original: "Mitzvat Shemurim"</note>

**Right Column:**
The spiritual actions associated with the Tallit are considered more significant than those of the **Tefillin** <term>Tefillin<gloss>Phylacteries; leather boxes containing Torah verses worn during prayer</gloss></term>. This is because the secret of what follows the **Sefirah** <term>Sefirah<gloss>One of the ten divine emanations or attributes in Kabbalah through which the Infinite reveals itself</gloss></term> is specifically for the needs of the **Sanctuary** <note>original: "Mikdash"</note>, as mentioned previously. However, the Tefillin are for the needs of the **Foundation** <term>Yesod<gloss>The Sefirah representing the channel of divine life-force and procreative energy</gloss></term>. Therefore, the laws regarding the Tefillin are more restrictive than those of the Tallit.

Through this, we can resolve the statement found in the **Zohar** <term>Zohar<gloss>The foundational work of Jewish mysticism</gloss></term>, portion *Shelach Lecha*, page 172b, which says: "From where do we learn that accessories of a commandment may be discarded?" It concludes that accessories of a commandment, such as the **Sukkah** <note>The ritual booth for the Feast of Tabernacles</note> and the **Sanctuary**, may be discarded. But if you say that the **Lulav** <note>Palm branch</note> and the **Willow** are also accessories of holiness, which are similar to the garments of the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The "Small Face," representing the six emotional attributes of the Divine</gloss></term>, then why are they discarded and not hidden away like other accessories of holiness?

The Zohar resolves this by explaining that there is a distinction even among "accessories of holiness" themselves. Some accessories of holiness—such as the scrolls and the writing—represent the "Sign of Holiness" itself. Therefore, they are not discarded but must be placed in a **Genizah** <term>Genizah<gloss>A storage area for worn-out sacred Hebrew texts that are forbidden to be thrown away</gloss></term>. However, all accessories of holiness that do not contain the "Sign of Holiness" (the written Name of God), even though they are holy accessories, may be discarded. The same rule applies to the difference between the accessories of the commandment themselves. For example, the Tefillin of **Jacob** <note>representing a specific divine level</note>, which were the "enclosure of **Rachel**" <note>representing the Shekhinah or Divine Presence</note>, since they are signified by the writing of the "Sign of Holiness," they must also be hidden away.

->**One should check the fringes before wrapping himself in the Tallit, so as not to recite a blessing in vain.**<-

In the Gemara <note>The Talmud</note>, in the chapter "The Blue Thread" <note>Menachot 41b</note>, **Abaye** <note>A famous 4th-century Babylonian sage</note> said: "One must separate the fringes like the **Aramean locks**." <note>original: "kunitah de-armuta"</note> The explanation is that one must separate the fringe threads that hang from the garment, specifically at the point where they are bundled from above and separated below. 

<column-break/>

**Left Column:**
Since the "External Forces" <term>Chitzonim<gloss>In Kabbalah, the "external ones" or forces of impurity that exist outside the realm of holiness</gloss></term> only possess the aspect of the **Nefesh** <note>The lowest level of the soul, associated with instinct</note>, it is also necessary that they only possess the "Intellect of Smallness" <term>Katnut<gloss>A state of "Smallness" or spiritual immaturity</gloss></term>. Indeed, all the nourishment of these external forces comes from this "Intellect of Smallness," as is known. Since they lack this "Intellect," they only possess the aspect of the "bundles." These bundles grow like "locks of hair" to indicate that the external forces try to imitate the holy structure so they can draw nourishment from it. This is based on the principle that "God made one opposite the other" <note>Ecclesiastes 7:14</note>. Just as in holiness, the intention of the bundles of the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The emotional divine attributes</gloss></term> is to provide for his beloved, so it is with the "External Forces." They are always trying to mimic the four fringes, creating two for the male and two for the female of the side of impurity.

For the secret of the fringes is the "Luck of Connection," and they want to join together. This is why **Abaye** said one must separate them like "Aramean locks," for the external forces do not have the "Repair of the Locks of Hair." They are always separating them. This is why it is said of them: "They have been scattered like the wind." They have no "Repair" (Tikkun) because their source is the malevolent male side. 

This is also why it is written in the portion of *Mishpatim* <note>Exodus 21-24</note> that the reason for this is because the "Encompassing Light" <term>Or Makif<gloss>The transcendent divine light that surrounds all worlds but is too great to be internalized</gloss></term> of the external forces is only on the outside. Therefore, the Encompassing Light cannot penetrate to the inner fringes except through the "Shell" <term>Klipa<gloss>A spiritual "husk" that traps holiness</gloss></term>. 

In holiness, however, all four fringes are inside the **Small Face**. There is a famous story about a man who was meticulous about the commandment of fringes, and they always stood "before him." Once, he was about to commit a sin, and the four fringes slapped him across his face to prevent him from that transgression. <note>This refers to the story in the Talmud (Menachot 44a) of a student who was saved from an immoral act with a harlot when his fringes miraculously struck him.</note>

Regarding what is said in the chapter "The Blue Thread": **Rav Nachman** said that fringes made by a Gentile for a Tallit are invalid, as it is written: "Speak to the Children of Israel and they shall make for themselves fringes" <note>Numbers 15:38</note>. It says "Children of Israel" and they shall make them—and not a Gentile. The intention is that the primary "Repair" of the fringes exists within holiness... even though the external forces have their own imitation of bundles, they cannot perform the "Secret of the Fringes" correctly. Therefore, fringes made by a Gentile are invalid because they lack this spiritual repair. Thus, anyone who is careful in this commandment to separate...

It uses the metaphor of "Aramean locks" to explain how separating the fringe threads protects against the mimicking forces of impurity (Klipot).</summary>

<meta>This page continues the mystical exploration of ritual garments, specifically transitioning from the general sanctity of the Tallit to the specific numerical and symbolic requirements of the Tzitzit (fringes). It maintains the theme of distinguishing between internal spiritual "brains" or intellects and external "surrounding lights."</meta>

# The Commandment of Safeguards
<note>original: "Mitzvat Shemurim"</note>

It is said that every force that opposes a person stems from "rust" <note>original: "Chala," a term used here for spiritual impurity or dross</note>, because it lacks the thirty-two <note>The Hebrew letters Lamed-Beit (ל"ב) equal 32, representing the 32 paths of wisdom and the 32 threads of the fringes</note> threads of the **Tzitzit** <term>Tzitzit<gloss>Ritual fringes attached to the corners of a four-cornered garment</gloss></term>, which protect the person. This is hinted at in the verse "and it shall be a *Tzitzit* for you" <note>Numbers 15:39</note>, where the word for "it shall be" is written missing the letter *Vav*, indicating a specific numerical alignment with the **Divine Name** and the concept of "Filling" <note>original: "Milui," a Kabbalistic method of calculating the value of a word by spelling out the names of its letters</note>. This is the secret of the verse: "Do not explore after your heart" — referring to the initial thought of sin — "and after your eyes" — referring to the actual sight of sin. The "Eye" <note>original: "Ayin"</note> has the same numerical value as the "Filling" of the name of God, which acts as a shield.

There is also another reason based on the fact that within the **Foundation of the Mother** <term>Yesod de-Ima<gloss>The channel through which the divine attribute of "Understanding" flows to the lower worlds</gloss></term> there are ten "Existences" consisting of five Kindnesses and five Severities. These total the numerical value of the word for "Fringes." Therefore, one who is careful with the commandment of *Tzitzit* will not be led astray by his heart or his eyes. This is why our Sages said that the four corners of the *Tzitzit* are indispensable to one another; they represent a single commandment. If one thread is missing or broken, the spiritual integrity is compromised. This is the secret of the verse "and they shall make for themselves *Tzitzit* on the corners of their garments" <note>Numbers 15:38</note>, which corresponds to the protection of the "Wings of the Eagles." 

You should also know that the **Tallit** <term>Tallit<gloss>A Jewish prayer shawl worn during morning prayers</gloss></term> has a numerical value of 449, which relates to the power to remove the "Husks" <note>original: "Klipot," the shells or forces of impurity</note> from a person. The blue thread <term>Techelet<gloss>A specific blue dye used for one thread of the fringes, traditionally derived from a sea creature called the Chilazon</gloss></term> represents the highest level of wisdom. Therefore, one must wrap himself in the *Tzitzit* to draw down this wisdom. In the times when the blue dye was available, it was mixed with the white threads. Today, we focus our intention on the white threads as if they contain that hidden light. 

The **Talmud** <note>Tractate Menachot, Chapter "Ha-Techelet"</note> asks: "Why is the punishment for neglecting the white threads greater than the punishment for neglecting the blue?" The reason is that the white threads represent the "Intellect of Wisdom" that is more accessible to us, while the blue represents a distant "Surrounding Light" that was only fully revealed in the Sanctuary. Because the white is closer to our spiritual grasp, failing to wear it is a greater personal defect. One who is not careful with these fringes causes a "withdrawal of the divine intellect." Therefore, the punishment for neglecting the white is greater, as it is a more direct rejection of the available light.

### The Secret of why the Fringes must be White

**The Reason** is that even though the "hairs" of the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin<gloss>The "Small Face" or Microprosopus, representing the emotional attributes of God in the world of Emanation</gloss></term> are described as "black as a raven" <note>Song of Songs 5:11</note>, this refers to a state of strict judgment. From the "Head" of the Small Face down to the "Chest," the lights are hidden and appear dark or "black." However, at the lower part of the Small Face, where the **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term> is revealed, all the lights of the "Kindnesses" emerge and clothe the hair, making it appear white. Because the *Tzitzit* are connected to this lower revelation where mercy and kindness prevail, the threads must be white. From that point downwards, all the "hairs" (the spiritual flows) become white. Understand this.

### It appears to me <note>An author's personal insight, often abbreviated as Nirdeh Li (נלע"ר)</note> that when you write the word "White" <note>Lavan</note> in its "filled" form <note>Lamed-Mem-Dalet, Beit-Yod-Tav, Nun-Vav-Nun</note>, the numerical value equals "Tzitzit." This proves that the fringes must be white because their very essence is derived from the "Whiteness" of divine mercy.

### Accessories of a Commandment are Discarded, but Accessories of Holiness must be Hidden

**The Meaning** of this rule is that accessories used for a commandment <note>original: "Tashmishei Mitzvah"</note> may be thrown away after use, but accessories of holiness <note>original: "Tashmishei Kedushah"</note> must be placed in a **Genizah** <term>Genizah<gloss>A storage area for worn-out sacred texts and objects that cannot be discarded in the trash</gloss></term>. The secret behind this is the "Surrounding Light" of the higher worlds. This light is so great that we cannot fully grasp its holiness in a physical object like a *Tallit*. Therefore, a *Tallit* is an "accessory of a commandment" and may be discarded. But **Tefillin** <term>Tefillin<gloss>Phylacteries; leather boxes containing scrolls of the Torah worn on the arm and head</gloss></term> are "accessories of holiness" because they represent a more concentrated and internal divine light that stays with the object. The *Tzitzit* are a "Surrounding Light" that is broad and encompasses everything, whereas the *Tefillin* are a smaller, more focused "Surrounding Light" that adheres to the person’s intellect.

### The Order of Wrapping the Tallit like the Ishmaelites

# Laws of the Ritual Fringes
<note>Hebrew: Hilkhot Tzitzit</note>

One must cover the phylacteries <term>Tephillin<gloss>sacred leather boxes containing Torah scrolls, worn on the head and arm</gloss></term> the entire time they are placed on the head, and they should be wrapped in white. The hand-phylactery corresponds to the "Kingdom" <note>Malkhut</note> of Emanation. One needs to sit, as it says, "and the Ancient of Days sat." "His garment was as white as snow" <note>Daniel 7:9</note>, which refers to the glory of the prayer shawl belonging to "Understanding" <note>Binah</note>. "And the hair of his head like pure wool" <note>Daniel 7:9</note>, these are against the inner aspect of "Understanding" <note>Binah</note>.
