# Laws of Tefillin

Writing the Name <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter name of God: Y-H-V-H</note> with this intention, according to the explanation of the **Zohar** <note>The foundational work of Jewish mysticism (Kabbalah)</note>, is essential; without it, the writing does not possess the sanctity of Tefillin, and it is forbidden to recite a blessing over them, as this would constitute a "blessing in vain." This is mentioned in the Torah portion of *Vayikra*, page 13, side b: "He who wishes to write the Holy Name... and so it is required for every person to be careful with the Holy Name, to write the Holy Name in this manner and not otherwise; for if it is not done correctly, it is not called the Holy Name... it is better for such a person had he not been created." This ends the quote. Therefore, we shall explain the matter of writing the Name Y-H-V-H, and this is how one should begin:

**The letter Yod (י):** First, write the first "thorn" <note>term: *kotz*—a small ornamental point or serif on a Hebrew letter</note>, then the second thorn, and afterward the third thorn. One should intend that within the letter **Yod**, the first three **Sephirot** <note>term: *Sephirot*—the ten divine attributes or emanations in Kabbalah</note> are included. They also resemble the three letters found in the "full spelling" of the letter Yod <note>original: *milui*—spelling out a letter's name (Yod-Vav-Dalet) to reveal hidden meanings</note>, which include all ten Sephirot. As is known, the letter Yod includes **Crown** (*Keter*), **Wisdom** (*Chokhmah*), and **Understanding** (*Binah*) within its three thorns. The body of the **Yod** includes the six "extremities" <note>The six emotional Sephirot from Kindness to Foundation</note>, and the letter **Dalet** <note>the final part of the spelled-out 'Yod'</note> includes **Sovereignty** (*Malchut*). Also, the Yod contains fifty "crowns" that are drawn from below to above.

### And afterward he shall write:

**The letter He (ה):** To create the connection for the letter **He**, according to the secret of "Honor," which ascends from below to unify the worlds. Therefore, one should not write this **He** like other letters. Rather, first write the form of a **Vav (ו)**, and then extend one line lengthwise and one line widthwise. The third line is left "hanging" and standing, as mentioned. In this, it is hinted that the letter **He** is bound to the **Vav**. Behold, the three lines are **Kindness** (*Chesed*), **Judgment** (*Din*), and **Mercy** (*Rachamim*): Kindness, Victory, Strength, Beauty, and Foundation. These six are included in the three lines that spread and emerge from the **Yod** at its right corner. This was the end of the connection of the **He** with the **Vav**... and behold, three letters will be included in the **Yod**. Every "simple" form of the **Vav** that hangs in the final letter **He** should have a small thorn made for it at the top, and he should place a "tongue" below at the "leg" of the **Vav**. The "step" within the name should be a single step, as mentioned in the Book of the Zohar, portion *Balak*, page 203b, which is the secret of **Malchut** which was a point at the end of the letter **Gimel** when it was within **Binah**.

---

### And afterward he shall write:

**The letter Vav (ו):** Which is the secret of "Vav-Vav." One must give it a body, a head, and a small line upon the head. One should intend for the "Giving of the Torah" <note>original: *Matan Torah*</note>, and **Malchut** includes them, which are the Six Orders of the **Mishnah** <note>The foundational text of Rabbinic law, organized into six parts</note>, as is known. One should intend for the head of the letter **Vav** to represent the "Higher Knowledge" (*Da'at Elyon*) as it is drawn from **Crown, Wisdom, and Understanding**.

**And afterward he shall write the [final] He (ה):** The last one is modeled after the first **He**, to hint also at the connection it has with **Beauty** (*Tiferet*). However, there is a variation here: instead of what we wrote regarding the first **He**, where he extends a form of a **Yod** in its right corner, here he extends the form of a **Vav**. This creates the form of **H-V**. Behold, in this, the entire Name [Y-H-V-H] is bound together in "Radiance with Radiance" <note>original: *Zohar be-Zohar*</note>. 

I do not mean to say that they should write **H-V** separately, as explained above, but rather the matter is that at the time he writes, he should write them in his mind <note>original: *be-al peh*—by heart or through mental intention</note>. He should first write the letter **Yod**, and afterward write and draw upon it the form of the **He** in its completeness, passing the quill over the letters to confirm the form, and so he shall do for all the others. He shall do the same for the second letter **He**.

## The Secret of the Ma’abarta of the Tefillin
These are the three names of God [E-H-Y-H], the secret of which is *Adonai* <note>numerical value 65</note>. Through the <term>Ma'abarta</term> passes the name **Yabok** <note>Y-B-Q; numerical value 112, representing the combination of several Divine names</note>, for through these names, all the spiritual flow (*Shefa*) passes from the beginning of the heart to the body. (And this is the secret of the Head-Tefillin: the side of **Mercy** should be on the right, and the side of **Mercy** should also be on the left).

These <term>Krinus</term> [grooves] are deep upon the <term>Ma'abarta</term> and should be spread out between the four compartments, each one from its own aspect, down to the base where the <term>Ma'abarta</term> sits. ## The Secret of the Four Lines of the Head-Tefillin
The reason for this is because there are **Four Mentalities** (*Mohin*) corresponding to the four Torah portions. Each one is comprised of four; therefore, in each of the four sections, there are **four lines** of text. Another reason is that the spiritual form has only four "surrounding" lights (*Makifim*), as is stated in the sources.

## The Secret of the Seven Lines of the Hand-Tefillin
The reason is that these are the "Mentalities of Sovereignty" (*Mohin d’Malchut*). They represent the powers of "Strength and Voice," and they require their "Sovereignty" to be three Mentalities. When you count them, they are 30 Mentalities <note>original: "L-M" refers to the letters Lamed and Mem</note>. Additionally, there are the attributes of **Kindness** (*Chesed*), **Strength** (*Gevurah*), and **Beauty** (*Tiferet*), which makes seven. From them, the strength and voice are filled, which are her "Mentalities." Therefore, there are **seven lines**. Another reason is that the attribute of Sovereignty (*Malchut*) has seven surrounding lights (*Makifim*), as is stated. Initially, the "Mentalities" are clothed in the soul (*Nefesh*) and the spirit (*Ruach*), and they enter the "Skull" of the spiritual persona.

## The Order of Writing the Name of God (Havayah)
One must be careful to write the Name [Y-H-V-H] with the proper intention (*Kavanah*). In the beginning, one should speak it with the mouth and focus the heart on the writing, as I have written.

# Third Reason for the 28 Mentions of the Divine Name

## Intention of the Divine Names in the Four Sections
**One should intend** that all the <term>Havayot</term><note>term: *Havayot*—plural of the four-letter Name of God (Y-H-V-H), the Tetragrammaton</note> present in the Tefillin total twenty-one. These correspond to the numerical value of "Simple Kindness" <note>original: "חס"ד פשוט" — The scribe notes that the 21 Names equal this value, though the standard value of *Chesed* is 72. The number 21 more commonly corresponds to the Name *Ehyeh* (א-ה-י-ה), as noted in the next heading</note>. Therefore, when it is written "your voice" or "to your brow," one should intend to take the first letter of "Kindness" (*Chesed*). With five other Divine Names, one should intend for the second letter of "Kindness"; with five other Divine Names, one should intend for the third letter of "Kindness"; and with the final five Divine Names, one should intend for the final letter of "Kindness."

**The order** of the sections is as follows: there are six Divine Names in the first section <note>The section of *Kadesh* (Exodus 13:1-10)</note>, eight Divine Names in the second section <note>*Ve-hayah Ki Yeviacha* (Exodus 13:11-16)</note>, two Divine Names in the third section <note>*Shema* (Deuteronomy 6:4-9)</note>, and five Divine Names in the fourth section <note>*Ve-hayah Im Shamoa* (Deuteronomy 11:13-21)</note>. One should intend to draw the five Names of the first section toward the Names corresponding to the Tablets [of the Ten Commandments]. Because this Divine Name in the second section—all the Names within it—is doubled according to the collective nature of its word, and therefore acts as a remembrance, as written later on page 55.

## The Reason for the 21 Divine Names in the Tefillin which are the Numerical Value of *Ehyeh*
**And it is not** the same for the sections we study regarding the Divine Names. The matter is this: know that man has three aspects. The "Face" is double, meaning it can potentially add 50 against 6. Behold, the first and last <term>Gestation</term><note>term: *Ibur*—lit. "pregnancy," referring to a lower state of spiritual development or an internal stage of divine light</note> are hinted at in the name <term>Eloah</term><note>A Name of God associated with the attribute of Kindness or the sphere of *Binah* (Understanding)</note>, for this name indicates strength and the "Right Side" for the wise, and for progeny, as mentioned in the Zohar, portion of *Acharei Mot*. The explanation is that these Divine Names are the "intestines of life" for him; they were doubled to six and joined in an aspect of "three within three" <note>A Kabbalistic phrase referring to the nesting of spiritual dimensions</note>. The <term>Malchut</term><note>term: *Malchut*—the lowest of the ten spiritual spheres, representing Sovereignty or the physical realm</note> was with him like a miracle alone, a point at the end of the letter *Vav*. Behold, all thirty "kings" were included from every aspect, which are the six directions and the *Malchut* which was bent. And the "miracle" is three times seven, which equals twenty-one <note>7 + 7 + 7 = 21, the value of the Name *Ehyeh* (I Will Be)</note>. This stands against the twenty-eight Divine Names <note>In some configurations, there are 28 Names, equaling the Hebrew word for "Power" (*Koach*)</note>. Because they were almost entirely pure and refined, cleaner than the Uzites and free of blemish, being from within the "Double Understanding," the internal vessels, they are therefore hinted at in the secret of the twenty-eight Divine Names. Also, in the secret <term>Gestation</term> of "Greatness," they also call out to *Ehyeh*, because they go and intend toward the five extremities according to the secret of the second <term>Gestation</term>.

## The Reason for the 21 Mentions of the Name in Tefillin matching the value of *Ehyeh*

**And this is not** so for the sections [when they are] complete with Tetragrammatons. And behold, each of the three parts was comprised of all seven [Sefirot], which are the "Six Directions" and the Kingship within them. Because they were in the "First Gestation," they were more elevated and pure than the level of the "Mentalities" (*Mohin*), being inside Understanding (*Binah*) in the secret of "Inner Vessels"; therefore, they are hidden in the secret of the 21 mentions of the Name. Furthermore, in the "Second Gestation" of "Greatness" (*Gadlut*), it is also called *Ehyeh*, because the Mentalities of the Seven Extremities rise in the secret of gestation a second time in the womb of Understanding (*Binah*).

## Another reason for the 21 Mentions of the Name being more hidden than the first reason

**The matter** is as I have informed you: that the entire "Surrounding Light" of the "Small Face" and its "Feminine" (*Zun*) <note>term: *Zun*—an acronym for *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*, the central personas in Lurianic Kabbalah</note> all stem from the level of the name *Ehyeh*. It is in the aspect of the "Higher Surrounding Light" that comes from the "Throne of Wisdom" prior to its investment within the "Head of the Small Face" (*Reisha deZeir*). This is ultimately the aspect of the "Inner Mentalities" which enter the skull... and the end of the "Surrounding Light" covers the brain in its form. The essence of the Tefillin is this "Surrounding Light" which covers [the head]. Therefore, it is necessary that the levels that preceded it, as well as its own level, be revealed within it. Thus, the first level of the first "Surrounding Light" is the aspect of the name *Ehyeh*, for every *Ehyeh* is a Surrounding Light. Its place below is in the "Hidden Realm" above the head of the "Small Face" (*Zeir Anpin*). Therefore, we cannot act toward them in the aspect of Tefillin, because they are above in the world, in the secrecy of their existence above in the secret of the "Surrounding Light" over the *Zun*. However, they are revealed and shine below in the "Inner Mentalities" after they have been invested within the skull of the skull <note>term: *Galgaltah de-Galgaltah*—the highest level of the crown or skull in Kabbalistic anatomy</note>.

# Laws of Tefillin

**And it shall be** <note>original: "והיה" (Ve-haya) — specifically referring to the fourth section of the Tefillin, 'Ve-haya Im Shamoa' [Deuteronomy 11:13-21]</note> if you obey: before the scribe writes, he should intend that this section corresponds to the final letter <term>Heh</term><note>The letter 'H' (ה), the last letter of the four-letter Name of God, representing the physical world and the feminine aspect of the Divine</note> of the simple Tetragrammaton. This corresponds to the Name of 52 <note>original: "בן" (Ban) — the numerical value of the Tetragrammaton when spelled out with the letter Heh [Yud-Vav-Dalet, Heh-Heh, Vav-Vav, Heh-Heh]</note> and the Name of <term>Adonai</term><note>The Name of God usually translated as 'Lord' [Aleph-Dalet-Nun-Yud]</note> spelled out: *Aleph-Dalet, Dalet-Lamed-Tav, Nun-Vav-Nun, Yud-Vav-Dalet*.

->And this is the order of the mystical intention:<-

**And you shall love** <note>original: "ואהב" (V'ahavta) — referring to the third section, the 'Shema'</note> with the acronym *B.S.Ch.M.L.S.* <note>The acronym for 'Baruch Shem Kavod Malchuto L'olam Va'ed' (Blessed be the Name of His glorious Kingdom forever and ever), a phrase recited silently after the first verse of the Shema</note>. This follows the order of the Moon. Before writing the first line, one should meditate as follows:

**On the 1st Line:** Focus on the letter <term>Yud</term> of the simple Tetragrammaton. Intend the letter *Yud* of the Name spelled out to the value of 72 <note>original: "ע"ב" (Av) — the highest mystical spelling of the Name of God using the letter Yud as a filler</note>. Also, intend the letter *Aleph* of the Name *Ehyeh* <note>The Divine Name meaning 'I Shall Be' [Aleph-Heh-Yud-Heh]</note> when it is spelled out.
**On the 2nd Line:** Intend the letter *Heh* of the spelling-out of 72, and the letter *Heh* of the spelling-out of *Ehyeh* using *Alephs*.
**On the 3rd Line:** Intend the letter *Vav* of the spelling-out of 72, and the letter *Yud* of the spelling-out of *Ehyeh* using *Alephs*.
**On the 4th Line:** Intend the final letter *Heh* of the spelling-out of 72, and the final letter *Heh* of the spelling-out of *Ehyeh* using *Yuds*. Until here, one intends for the four lines of the <term>Pe</term><note>Referring to the internal form of the Hebrew letter 'Pe' (פ)</note>.

**And it shall be when He brings you** <note>original: "והיה כי יביאך" — the second section [Exodus 13:11-16]</note>: there are three types of intentions for this whole portion. These correspond to the simple Tetragrammaton throughout the section. First, the Name of 45 <note>original: "מ"ה" (Mah) — the Tetragrammaton spelled out with the letter Aleph, associated with humanity</note> in its entirety, divided by its four letters across four lines. Second, the Name of 161 <note>original: "חק"פ" (Ehyeh spelled with Yuds) — numerical value 161</note> divided by its four letters across the lines.

**Hear [Israel]** <note>original: "שמע" (Shema) — the third section [Deuteronomy 6:4-9]</note>: across four lines, one should intend for three types of meditations: the Name *El* [God], and the simple Tetragrammaton throughout the section. Also, the Name of 45 divided by its letters, and the Name *Ehyeh* spelled with the letter *Heh* [value 151] divided across four lines.

**And it shall be if you obey**: across four lines, one should intend for three types of meditations: the final letter *Heh* of the simple Tetragrammaton throughout the whole section. Also, the Name of 52 divided into its letters across the lines, and the Name *Adonai* divided across the lines.

->The Scroll of the Hand<-

However, the intentions for the sections of the Hand-Tefillin <note>The Arm-Tefillin consists of one single scroll containing all four portions, whereas the Head-Tefillin has four separate compartments</note> are like the others, but they are written in twenty-six lines. One must divide the intentions into various aspects. Here are the general intentions:
**First:** A "Good End" for the four letters of the simple Tetragrammaton throughout the portions.
**Furthermore:** There are two known names of four letters in these intentions: the Name *Ehyeh* with *Yuds*, and the Name of 45 in its spelling-out, as well as the Name of 52 in the letter *Vav*, and also the Name 161 [Kashap] for the final letter *Heh*.
**Furthermore:** There are names known as "L. Sh." <note>Likely referring to 'Lamed-Shin,' a cryptic scribal reference to specific Divine Name permutations</note>... for the final *Heh*, only the Name *Adonai* in its spelling-out is placed, as mentioned before. All these aspects are divided across the four portions of the Hand-Tefillin.

->Before the Section of "Sanctify"<-

**On the 1st Line:** Intend the letter *Yud* of the simple Tetragrammaton. Also, the two names *L.K.S.* <note>original: "לק"ס" — a common Kabbalistic transposition of the Name of God</note> spelled with *Yuds*, and *Kuzu* <note>A name formed by shifting the letters of the Tetragrammaton one step forward in the alphabet</note> squared together. This fulfills the "Rectification of the Act" of the Hand-Tefillin being written. Then, divide the spellings of the four mentioned Names into seven parts across seven lines—these are twenty letters. Add the letter *Yud* of the simple Tetragrammaton at the beginning, making 21 letters. In each line, there will be three letters, like this:

->YAL P.Y. D.H.Y. H.Y.Y. V.D.V. A.V.H. Y.H.Y.<-

**Before** the second section: Intend for the first *Heh* of the simple Tetragrammaton, and the full spelling of the two Names *L.K.S.* with *Alephs* and *Kuzu*. This "Sanctifies the Holiness" of the Tetragrammaton over all. Then divide the 28 letters into groups of three letters across the seven lines.
**Before** the third section: Intend for the letter *Vav* of the simple Tetragrammaton and the spellings of the two names *L.K.S.* with *Hehs* and *Kuzu*. This "Sanctifies the Holiness" as mentioned. Then divide the 28 letters into groups of three letters across the seven lines in the manner mentioned.

And let us return to the matter of the scriptural portions, etc. You should focus your intention on what is written in the *Introduction to the Corrections of the Zohar* <note>original: "Tikunei Zohar" — a foundational kabbalistic text that offers seventy interpretations of the first word of the Torah</note>, page 3. For the Tefillin correspond to the <term>Mother</term> <note>original: "Imma" — the Sephirah (Divine Emanation) of Binah, representing Understanding and the source of the intellect</note>, encompassing all the letters *Yud* and *Heh* of the <term>Tiferet</term> <note>original: "T.T." — the Sephirah of Beauty/Balance, often representing the "Son" or the central masculine aspect of the Divine</note>. And as is known regarding the portion "Strength" <note>original: "Koach" (כ"ח)</note> and the portion "To place you on high," the Tefillin are the "these" <note>original: "Hen" (ה"ן) — numerically 55</note> of <term>Chesed and Gevurah</term> <note>original: "Chug" (חוג) — the Divine attributes of Kindness and Severity</note>. Regarding this entire matter: the four portions are in the "houses" <note>the compartments of the Tefillin</note> and according to the small numerical value they equal <term>Binah</term> <note>Understanding</note>. Primarily, it is said that the Tefillin belong to the Divine Mother over everything.

Also, they write "merits," because these four portions are hidden within the aspect of the Mother. Behold, all these three versions of the Name <term>Ehyeh</term> <note>original: "I Will Be" — the Divine Name associated with the Sephirah of Binah</note> are the aspects of the "Crowns" of these four portions. 

Now, corresponding to the Name *Ehyeh* spelled out with the letter *Yud* <note>A specific kabbalistic way of expanding the Name Aleph-Heh-Yud-Heh</note> which is the Crown of <term>Chokhmah</term> <note>Wisdom</note>, there is the Name <term>Havayah</term> <note>The four-letter Name of God, Y-H-V-H</note> spelled out to the numerical value of 63 <note>original: "Sag" (ס"ג)</note>. These are the three *Yuds* (and the *Heh*? <note>translator note: the scribe appears to be questioning the letter count here</note>). This corresponds to the three *Yuds* and one *Aleph* found in the Name *Ehyeh* expanded with *Yuds*, which represents the 27 forms within Wisdom. The Name of 180 within the seventh <note>Sephirah</note> is clothed within it in the eighth "constellation" above it, for it is the aspect of the "Three Head" Sephirot. And this Name *Ehyeh* expanded with *Yuds*, according to its small numerical value, is the "Crown" within Understanding. It serves as the "Soul" to the Name *Havayah* expanded with *Alephs* <note>original: "Mah" (מ"ה), value 45</note> within Understanding, which exists in the seven forms within the *Heh*. And the Name of 180 of the expansion of *Hehs* is the Crown within the "Yud-hood" <note>referring to the internal essence of the letter Yud</note>, and it is the Soul of the Name *Havayah* expanded with *Hehs* <note>original: "Ban" (ב"ן), value 52</note> in the five forms within the *Heh*. And this is why every such Name is in the <term>Malchut</term> <note>Kingdom/the lowest Sephirah</note> corresponding to the portion "And it shall be if you obey," etc., and there is no other "clothing" within it. 

Therefore, in the **Hand Tefillin**, one focuses in its four portions on the four names of the "forms" mentioned, which are 63 (*Sag*), 45 (*Mah*), 52 (*Ban*), and the Name *Ehyeh* in its full expansion. These four Names also encompass the four portions of the Tefillin in their proper order. Consequently, before one writes a portion:

**Sanctify** <note>original: "Kadesh" — the first portion</note>: Focus your intention that this entire portion shall be the letter **Yud** of the simple Tetragrammaton, and it shall be the complete Name of 72 <note>original: "Ab" (ע"ב) — the highest expansion of the Divine Name</note>, and it shall be the Name **Ehyeh** expanded with *Yuds*.

**And it shall be when He brings you** <note>original: "Ve-haya Ki Yeviakha" — the second portion</note>: Before writing, focus your intention that this entire portion shall be the **first Heh** of the simple Tetragrammaton, and it shall be the complete Name of 63 (*Sag*), and it shall be the Name **Ehyeh** expanded with *Alephs*.

**Hear** <note>original: "Shema" — the third portion</note>: Before writing, focus your intention that the entire portion shall be the **Vav** of the simple Tetragrammaton, and it shall be the source of the Name of 45 (*Mah*), and it shall be the Name **Ehyeh** expanded with *Hehs*.

# A third reason why the four sections of the Hand Tefillin are in a single compartment

**It is** according to the secret explained, with God's help, regarding the Head Tefillin. As was written, the intellects themselves of Wisdom and Understanding <note>original: "Chokhmah" and "Binah"</note> are within the "Small Face" <note>term: Zeir Anpin - the Kabbalistic persona representing the six emotional attributes of the Divine</term>. They are only enclothed in the aspect of the Mother <note>original: "Imma," a name for the sphere of Understanding</note>... which brings the impact to the inner part of the intellects and carries them outward, and for them, there are four compartments for the head. However, for the Kingship <note>term: Malchut - the final sphere of the Kabbalistic tree, representing the Feminine Presence or Shekhinah</term>, the essence of her intellects is only an "enclothment" of the Mother within the "Small Face." Afterward, through the "power of the hair" <note>a mystical metaphor for the extension of divine energy</note>, they bulge outward... and then return back into the vein of the "Small Face." From this, two straps are formed that surround the head from the outside, representing Kindness and Strength <note>original: "Chesed" and "Gevurah"</note>... and it forms the aspect of the knot of the letter *Dalet* <note>the knot at the back of the head Tefillin is shaped like the Hebrew letter Dalet</note>, which is opposite the "Secret of the Beauty" <note>original: "Sod Tiferet"</note>, for in it is the knot of all things. Then, the Kingship is recorded within it... and this is the "Large Dalet" that was mentioned, the Dalet of the Foundation <note>original: "Yesod"</note> and the Dalet of the Tefillin. And from the end of the "Secret of Beauty," which is the knot, the energy descends further with power and secret, forming the two straps that descend alongside the body... down to the Hand Tefillin, which is the aspect of Rachel <note>the biblical matriarch Rachel represents the revealed aspect of the Divine Presence</note>. There, the intellects are enclothed. Thus, the essence of the intellects of the Feminine are merely the "power and secret" of the Mother, and not from the global intellects themselves. Also, below in the "Small Face," they are only enclothed in her through their power and secret alone, and these two alone constitute the totality of her intellects. And as you already know, "Power" and "Secret" <note>referring to the Hebrew terms 'Koach' and 'Sod'</note> are like "two halves of a body" <note>original Aramaic: "trei palgi gufa"</note> and are but one single body. Therefore, in the Kingship <note>Malchut/Hand Tefillin</note>, there is only one compartment for all the sections, though there are four, because ultimately four quarters of the intellect are within her, as will be explained later.

# The reason why the Head Tefillin are alluded to by the name *Ehyeh* and the Hand Tefillin by the name *Adonai*

**Behold**, we have learned in the *Tikunim* <note>Tikunei Zohar, a central Kabbalistic text</note>, Tikun 18, page 37b and 38a: The name *Ehyeh* <note>original: "I Will Be"</note> is called out for the four... and the four names that are in the four sections of the Hand Tefillin and in the four compartments of the Head Tefillin. It is necessary to understand why it first mentioned the four sections of the Hand Tefillin and regarding the Head Tefillin it mentioned "compartments." For in every matter, the "Small Face" has inner intellects and surrounding intellects. In the aspect of the surrounding energies <note>original: "Makifin"</note> which are outside, there are four quarters of the intellect: Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge <note>original: "Chokhmah, Binah, Da'at"</note>, and the inclusion of the "Two Crowns" <note>Kindness and Strength within Knowledge</note>—these are the four quarters. Therefore, the aspect of the four compartments of the head corresponds to the name *Ehyeh*, because they are hidden in the secret of "pregnancy" within Understanding <note>Binah</note>. There is no pregnancy except through the name *Ehyeh*, and it constitutes four intellects which form four compartments. For the Understanding and Majesty <note>Binah and Hod</note> of the "Small Face"... are not called by the name of the "Small Face" at all, but they are actually the "Upper World" of the Feminine; therefore *Adonai* is called upon her name. But from the Understanding and Majesty of the Queen <note>the Feminine Presence</note>, the head of the "Small Face" is not made from them; rather they are hidden within him. When they are hidden within him, they are strengthened in the two hollows of the "Nogah" <note>a shell or glow</note> that descend right and left. Therefore they are called "two houses," and also for this reason the name *Ehyeh* is called by the name of Understanding <note>Binah</note> itself, which is named so.

### Hand Tefillin

Just as the Head [Tefillin] has within it [Divine] Names totaling the number 14 <note>the word "Yad" (Hand) equals 14</note>, which are the Names of 72, 63, 45, and 52 <note>these are the four primary expansions of the Tetragrammaton used in Kabbalah</note>, along with 161, 151, 143, and 125 <note>expansions of the name Eheyeh</note>, and 42 for the 72, and the 45 of the 63, the 45 of the 45... and so too regarding the Hand [Tefillin] there are 14 Names. And this is why the letter *Lamed* [stands for] "Thirty" [and] "To whom" in the portion of *Mishpatim*. ### The reason why the Head has four compartments
### but the Hand has only one compartment

The matter is as follows, as will be explained later: the Intellects <term>Mochin</term> of the Small Face <term>Zeir Anpin</term> are enclothed within the vessels of the Mother <term>Imma</term>. And behold, the Foundation <term>Yesod</term> is divided into two by the "wall" of the Mother. Thus, from it are made two Intellects: Kindnesses <term>Chasadim</term> and Severities <term>Gevurot</term>. Also, the Wisdom <term>Chokhmah</term> and Understanding <term>Binah</term> are two other aspects, totaling four. These are the four compartments.
However, the Kingship <term>Malchut - the Feminine</term> has only two Intellects within her, for they are the "enclothment" of the "Small Face." And these [aspects of] the Small Face itself do not enter into her, but rather they themselves become compartments. If these two Intellects were separate, they would be called "two compartments," following the example of the Wisdom and Understanding of the Mother that enter the Small Face.
But here it is not so. For the Kingship has only a "diffused light" that permeates the Kingship. Therefore, it is made into a single compartment.

### A second reason why there is only one
### compartment in the Hand Tefillin

This is based on what is explained in the Zohar, Portion of *Bereshit*, page 25b: "That which is sanctified for the structure is compared to a leg..." And behold, the Wisdom is the fourth, and Understanding is the fifth. It has already been explained elsewhere that the "Small Face" and "Feminine" <note>Zon - Zeir Anpin and Nukva</note> are back-to-back. The "Back" of the Mother stands against the "Back" of the Father, and his "Back" stands against her "Back."
And it is explained there that from the "Front" side of the Father and Mother, they are the two "Legs" of the Small Face, according to the secret of the Masculine. Therefore, they must be divided into two legs. But from the "Back" side, the three [aspects] are joined together because they are "sealed" <note>metmamtin</note> into one head. They are forced to connect together essentially, because from them themselves, a single head is made. For the Wisdom and Understanding of the Small Face are "sealed" into the "Small Face and Feminine" <note>Zon</note> as one. And they become a single wall that separates between the two of them.
Only from the "Front" side are they divided into two, etc. But from the "Back" side, they are joined. And this is one of the reasons why Wisdom and Understanding are called "two halves of a body." If so, since from them the head of the Kingship <term>Malchut</term> is actually made, they must be joined together [in one compartment].

# The Laws of Tefillin

To understand them thoroughly, and likewise to understand their form: the two ends <note>original: "shnei ketzavot"</note>, and these in their "filling" <note>The "filling" or *Milui* is a Kabbalistic method of calculating the numerical value of a letter by spelling out its name (e.g., Aleph = Aleph-Lamed-Pe). ## The Secret of Knowing the Essence of the Tefillin

And why are they placed specifically on the forehead and not in the place of the neck <note>The OCR is unclear here; context suggests "neck" or "heart"</note>? Generally, at the beginning, the Inner Light <term>Or Pnimi - the light that enters a vessel</term> of the Tefillin and three [aspects] are in the surrounding river... behold, it has already been explained that the Intellects <term>Mochin - divine intellectual energies</term> of the Small Face <term>Zeir Anpin/Z"A - the masculine persona of the divine</term> were made from the union of Father and Mother <note>original: "Abba ve-Imma" (A"L)</note>... in the name *Elohim*... and toward the three in the secret of the Inner [Light] and three in the secret of the Surrounding [Light].

### The First Aspect
It is that at first, the Two Constellations <note>original: "Tarin Mazalin" - two streams of divine influence from the "beard" of the highest divine level</note> of the Beard unite to lower a male drop from the *Lokenah* <note>likely a corrupted transcription of a technical term</note> and they influence the flow within Father and Mother. These, Father and Mother, also unite together (and see further on), and they become four Intellects belonging to the Small Face and are hidden within Mother in the secret of "Pregnancy" <term>Ibbur - the stage where divine lights are contained within a higher persona</term> in the aspect of Internal Intellects.

### The Second Aspect
It is that just as the aforementioned Internal Intellects were from the aspect of the union... <note>The text here contains fragmented numerical and technical shorthand</note> ...then the birth of the holy source was blessed, which always trickles flow into Father and Mother. Meanwhile, these Internal Intellects began, which stand there in the secret of Pregnancy; and then from the Lower Understanding <term>Tevunah</term> a light shines to them there in their place, directly opposite the interior; and now they are

<margin>
The Surrounding Light of the four Intellects. (He gave a general rule of three aspects regarding them). The lower part of Understanding in the aspect of "Pregnancy."
</margin>

### The Third Aspect
When the four Intellects left the state of Pregnancy that was within the Upper Understanding, they returned to be "impregnated" within *Tevunah*, which is the lower aspect of Understanding. Know that regarding these in the aspect of the "Written Intellect," they are not uprooted from their place, Heaven forbid; it is only that through the abundance of the illumination of the Holy Constellation in the meantime, it comes to her and they give birth lower than their place. But their root always remains established above. However, there is one difference: that Wisdom and Understanding <note>Chokhmah and Bina</note> which are called the "Infinite" <note>Ein Sof</note>... only their illumination alone [descends], while their essence remains above in all aspects. But the "Two Crowns" which are the Kindness and Strength <term>Chesed and Gevurah</term> of the Small Face itself—these Two Crowns do not have a half for Wisdom and Understanding... and they are in the aspect of the Intellects of Kindnesses and Strengths which are included together and become one Intellect. It is the "Knowledge" <term>Da'at - the sefirah that mediates between the mind and the body</term> of Father and Mother, a single essence, which literally descends and is drawn into the Small Face. Then we have shown it alone, and therefore the Small Face is called the "Knowledge of all Emanation" because he takes the Knowledge itself and the essence, and not just its illumination. But [at other times] they take the illumination of Knowledge which needs to be recognized. But [the] good needs to take the light of its essence, and [the] side takes the illumination of the outer light alone.

### The Fourth Aspect
Because they are literally in the flesh and in their enclothement within the "shells" <term>Kelippot - the outer layers or husks</term> of *Tevunah*, illumination was also added to them from the Holy Constellation. Their illumination also descended from the outside in their place, just like the aforementioned internal [aspects]. And now they are Surrounding Light a second time, just as they were in their state above within the Upper... in the aspect of Internal and Surrounding lights, so they are below in *Tevunah*.

### The Fifth Aspect
At the time of the "sweetening" of the *Tevunah* of the Intellects, they are called a "sea"... and their illumination is submerged above in the secrets of the... of *Tevunah*. Then the [letter] *He* is emptied of their illumination, and the Intellects belonging to the Small Face enter into the *He* of *Tevunah*. Then the "vessels" enter into a state of confusion with the four Intellects that are in *Tevunah* into the head of the Small Face, in the aspect of three Intellects for each, within the three hollows of the skull of the Small Face. And they are there in the aspect of Internal Intellects.

# The Laws of Tefillin

To be able to understand and respond with a voice from below that rises up from the midst of the voices <note>original: "kolot" - voices or sounds, often referring to the thunder at Sinai</note> totaling 44. As it is said: "more than the voices of many waters." This has the numerical value <term>Gematria - Jewish numerology</term> of "Study," relating to the Wisdom called the "Staff" <note>original: "Matteh"</note> whose voice represents the abundance of flow that is integrated into the Foundation of Wisdom and flows into the Foundation of Understanding. "And in His voice, they heard the voice of the Foundation" which is called the "Voice of Jacob." For corresponding to it are the drops that a mother gives birth to; and this is the secret of "And the mountain burned with smoke" <note>Exodus 19:18</note>. For the "smoke" <note>original: "ashan"</note> represents the two crowns of the Foundation of Understanding. The mountain was all smoke because the Lord descended upon it in **fire**, meaning the "Strengths" <term>Gevurot - the divine attribute of judgment and restraint</term> of Understanding emerged, and they are the Wisdom that descends below. This is the secret found in the Holy Zohar, page 39, side A.

### The base <note>original: "Titura"</note> of the Tefillin is a law given to Moses at Sinai.

For the **base** is the lower part of the Foundation of Understanding, where the three "Brains" <term>Mohin - the internal intellectual lights</term> of the "Small Face" <note>the emotive divine persona</note> are placed. The Foundation itself contains the four sections of the parchment, which are the Written Torah as previously mentioned. However, the opening of the Foundation is called the **passage** <note>original: "Ma’avarta"</note>, through which the "nurturing" and the thickness of the straps pass; these represent the "Kindnesses" <term>Hasadim</term> and the "Strengths" <term>Gevurot</term>, as will be explained later. This is the secret of the next law:

### The passage of the Tefillin is a law given to Moses at Sinai.

For this reason, the Tefillin must be **square**, because the inner essence of the Foundation contains the four "Brains" arranged in a square order. This is the secret found in the Talmud:

### Square Tefillin are a law given to Moses at Sinai.

The square shapes that surround the head are the two sides of the Foundation called the "Two Crowns," and they are covered with black hair. This is the secret of what Rabbi Isaac said:

### Black straps are a law given to Moses at Sinai.

Furthermore, they are surrounded by Kindnesses, but within them are the Strengths of the "Father." Therefore, the straps, which are the Kindnesses and Strengths within the Foundation, are entirely black. We can also say that the Tefillin and the straps must be black because Understanding is called "black as a raven," a light that shines but is called "darkness" because its brilliance is so intense it blinds the eyes of created beings from perceiving it. This is the secret mentioned by the Sages of blessed memory in the Holy Zohar, page 33, side B:

### It is taught as a law given to Moses at Sinai: Tefillin on parchment <note>original: "Klaf"</note> and Mezuzah on *duchsustos*. Parchment on the side of the flesh; *duchsustos* on the side of the hair.

To understand this, look at the "Work of the Chariot" in Ezekiel, Chapter 1, which explains: The skin of the "Small Face" is composed of sparks... which are the "Backs" of the sparks. This skin itself is one skin over another, two layers of clothing called "G-V-L." This is the vacuum that separates the internal and the external, and it is entirely derived from the names of God <note>original: "Elohim"</note> which are the "Throne of Discernment." They are doubled in the **parchment** <note>Klaf</note>. This is the skin and the flesh, as it is known that there is no connection to the flesh except through the skin, for every limb of the body stands on its own and they are only joined by the skin, which is called "G-V-L." This explains the two skins of *Klaf* and *Duchsustos* belonging to the "Small Face." The *Klaf* of the Tefillin represents the aspect of the "Brains," while *Duchsustos* belongs to the "Kingdom" <term>Malkhut</term> and the Mezuzah. For everything that was in the aspect of the body—in the stages of embryo and suckling—now becomes skin over the aspect of greatness. This is the secret of the "Winter" <note>Likely a reference to a specific mystical text or season of study</note>: the four sections of the Tefillin are in the place of the "flesh" of the Foundation of Understanding. But the Mezuzah is at the "opening" of the Foundation where the hair of the Foundation is, where the "Living God" is revealed from outside the Foundation. Therefore, it is "outside," and one must also write the Mezuzah on *duchsustos*, which is the place of the hair. This will be explained further in the Laws of Mezuzah. The "flesh" and "skin" of the Tefillin are the "Backs" of the Foundation of Understanding, which is the Kingdom. There, one needs the lights of the Foundation to descend through it. The secret of Understanding is that the straps hang down. This "knot" is only visible through the "Back" <note>original: "Achorayim"</note>. Thus the Sages said: "And you shall see My back" <note>Exodus 33:23</note>—this refers to the knot of the Tefillin. The Holy One (who is Understanding) showed Moses the knot of the Tefillin, which is the skin at the end of the Foundation, at the "Back" of Understanding in the head. There, all the lights are distributed, "and the face of the Lord shall not be seen," meaning the interior of the Foundation where the Tefillin themselves reside. This is the secret said by Rav Yehuda in the Holy Zohar, page 35, side B:

### The knot of the Tefillin must be high, so that Israel shall be above and not below.

This means that the place of the knot is the connection of Mercies, and it is slightly below the knot itself. Therefore, the knot must be high, close to the Foundation, so that Israel may receive spiritual influence.

For those who attempt to place a servant in the place of his master, and a handmaid in the place of her mistress, through the binding of the Tefillin; for whoever does not have Tefillin on during the time of the *Recitation of the Shema* <term>Shema - the central declaration of Jewish faith</term> from the side of the arm, the "servant" and "handmaid" <note>The "servant" and "handmaid" represent the "Other Side" (Sitra Achra) or forces of spiritual impurity that attempt to usurp the Divine order.</note> rule over the world. At that moment, the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term> is angered and feels no possessiveness, as it is written: "Under a servant when he reigns, and a handmaid when she inherits her mistress" <note>Proverbs 30:22-23</note>. End of quote. And this explains why the world is captured by such forces.

Regarding the light of the **Divine Presence**, it is written "Righteousness lodged in her" <note>Isaiah 1:21</note>, and the "External Ones" <term>Husponim - external forces of impurity</term>, the servant and the handmaid, were not recognized over Jerusalem. There are two Tefillin, and they are the "Signs." Therefore, a person should desire to wear Tefillin and know their hidden meaning—that they subdue all the "External Ones."

This is what was written by the school of Hezekiah on the verse "And Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him" <note>Genesis 32:25</note>. Our Sages, of blessed memory, said: This teaches that the angel wanted to kill him, but he did not have the power because our father Jacob was armed with Tefillin on his head and his arm, and the *Tzitzit* <term>Tzitzit - ritual fringes</term> were opposite him. The Holy One, blessed be He, "saw that he could not prevail against him, so he touched the socket of his hip..." <note>Genesis 32:26</note>. End of quote.

Proof for these words can be found in what is written in the **Zohar**, portion *Lekh Lekha*, page 146 side B: "He saw that he could not prevail against him"—the angel looked to the right and saw Abraham; he looked to the left and saw Isaac; he looked at Jacob's body and saw that he was protected from this side and that side; therefore, "he touched the socket of his hip." End of quote.

Do not wonder how Jacob our father could wear Tefillin at night <note>Halakhically, Tefillin are usually only worn during the day.</note>. We can say that he held the opinion of Rabbi Elazar in the chapter "The Handful of Meal" <term>Menachot - a tractate of the Talmud</term> that the verse "from day to day" is not meant to exclude nights; rather, it is permitted to wear Tefillin at night because of the letters *Shin*, *Dalet*, and *Yud* <note>The letters spelling "Shaddai," a Name of God, formed by the Tefillin</note> of the Tefillin, which provide protection. Therefore, according to his reasoning, it is permitted. See the chapter "The Handful."

This is the secret of Jacob's journey. To explain the intention of "the socket of Jacob’s hip was out of joint": with the seven letters of the Tefillin, the angel could only strike the socket of the hip and not the higher levels. The word "the hip" <note>original: "Ha-Yerech"</note> has a numerical value <term>Gematria</term> that relates to the *Tikunim* <term>Tikunei Zohar - a mystical commentary on Genesis</term>, page 8. It is stated there that the "Great Hand" comes from the side of Kindness, the "Strong Hand" comes from the side of Strength, and the "High Hand" comes from the side of the middle world. These three types of "Hands" are the "Remembrance" of the Tefillin of the hand and the Tefillin of the head. End of quote.

This is what is mentioned in the Zohar: the "Moon" <note>symbolizing the Shekhinah</note> was surrounded by 42 letters of the Tefillin. He also had the *Tzitzit*, which is the "One" that a person recognizes at the time of the blessing, along with the 28 "ears" <note>referring to the knots/strings</note>, totaling 22 letters. This matches the number of the **Divine Presence**. All of this was to show that through the Tefillin and the Tzitzit, the **Divine Presence** was constantly attached to Jacob, and that is why the angel could not prevail against him.

Therefore, it is written "And he called him El, the God of Israel," meaning that he rose to the level of the "Tefillin of the Head." Originally, he was in the secret of the "Tefillin of the Arm," which is associated with the name Jacob, and afterward, he rose to the secret of the "Tefillin of the Head" and was called "El." Know that there are 22 letters in the Tefillin and Tzitzit combined... as it appears to my humble opinion.

These are the attributes of **Kindness** and **Strength** <term>Chessed and Gevurah</term> that surround the head. For this reason, we make a **Knot**, which is the secret of the attribute of **Harmony/Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>, for in it, everything is bound together as is known.

And also, as it is said, she is Leah, who is opposite him. This indicates that she cannot take from the Intellects themselves, but only from their "pouches," which are the attributes of the "Mother" <term>Binah - Understanding</term>. There is the "forehead" of the hollow of the hair, and from there it covers the "throne" <note>original: "כורס"</note> in the two surrounding holes of the Tefillin. 

It is found that, at first, the brains were not standing in the front, but were only three brains. However, through the "air" that enters the "cup," and through the "voice" of the hollow of the hair, the two crowns within **Knowledge** were divided. Consequently, two brains were made on the outside instead of being inside. Now, four sections are made in the Tefillin. These were established as the thirty sections which are the four brains of the "seven" levels of knowledge, to be covered by only three garments. Because the "force of life" is sent from the "voice" of the hollow of the hair, they said in the **Zohar** (page 140, column 2) that the "Voice of the Supernal Brain" of the Macroprosopus, together with the three brains of the Lesser Countenance <term>Zeir Anpin</term>, constitute the four sections of the Tefillin. This means the "Voice" joins with the three brains of the Lesser Countenance through the thought of the hollow of the hair. The "voice" strikes the vitality into four sections instead of three. By this, you will understand why there are four compartments in the **Tefillin of the Head** and only one in the **Tefillin of the Hand**, because the essence of these four sections are the four brains themselves of the Lesser Countenance, but they are clothed within the Tefillin boxes.

Therefore, it is also written that they are four compartments in their structure. End of quote.

->**Nathan Gilead**<-

Regarding the support for the "Master of Leah" <note>The spiritual persona of "Leah" represents the hidden world of Thought</note>: When the hair of the Macroprosopus, which is the "four-square" of the beard <note>original: "דיקנא"</note>, descends behind the neck of Leah, of blessed memory, from the skull, one side of the skull of the Lesser Countenance comes out. There, four portions of strength pass to the back. 

The **Concealed Brain** <term>Mocha Stima'a</term> is the "voice" of the hollow of the hair, and the "whiteness" within it is the mystery of the "Brain of the Fifty" of the Macroprosopus. From there <unclear>it is possible --- and three and it is composed of 60 8 and extends behind</unclear> the "holy of holies" upon the mystery of the "hundred" of the "cup" and enters the vein of the Lesser Countenance. At the head of the Female <note>The persona of Nukva/Malchut</note>, which is called the structure of the heart, is the "voice" of the Name of 63 <term>SAG</term>. At the third head is the mystery of the **Concealed Brain**, which is the "voice" of the Name of 45 <term>MAH</term>. 

Behold, the "voice" of the hollow of the hair, which is the "hard spark," and the **Concealed Brain**, which is the "voice," ascend through the "back hole" and return outward through the "window" and the "ears" of the skull. Behold, all the voices connect together—the voice of the "hollow" with the "whiteness"—and cover the vein of the Lesser Countenance. The brains then emerge outward into the brain of the "seven," where the Tefillin are written. This equals the number 400, the mystery of "silver" <note>The Hebrew word for silver, Kesef, equals 160; however, 400 is the value of the letter Tav, symbolizing completion</note>, and the Names 72, 63, and 45, which together equal the numerical value of "Tefillin."

When Abraham was with Ephron, he told them to make for him a "place of dwelling" <note>original: "בי מטבנא"</note>, which resembles the "Eye of the Supernal Adam." There are two "houses" in Jerusalem <note>A metaphor for the two Tefillin boxes</note>, the "houses of assembly," in the number of "My Kingdom" <note>original: "מכל"תי"</note>, the "Secret of Righteousness." Through kindness, it is buried there with the word "And it shall be" <note>original: "והיה" - the start of the Tefillin scrolls</note>, which are the letters of "Tefillin." 

And this is the meaning of "Make for Me a Sanctuary": "Sanctuary" <note>original: "מקד"ש"</note> in its full spelling is equivalent to the "glory of the Torah" and "Tefillin." The order of the letters of "Sanctuary" teaches the reason for its voices, which is the numerical value of **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>. The **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term> rests upon his head, for the Divine Presence is the Torah of the Tefillin. This is the "Wisdom of Solomon" regarding the Sanctuary. Hinted within it are the letters of "Levi," the numerical value of **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>, as written in the **Tikunei Zohar** (page 60, column 2): "Strength is from the hair of Strength, which sits as a Sanctuary for their King."

# The Laws of Tefillin

In my understanding and by my wisdom, a difficulty arose for me, for the knot of the Head-Tefillin <note>original: "הקשר שלום לי", likely a scribal error for "של ראש" (of the head)</note> was like a exile to me in that place. It was difficult for me because these are four-sided squares, and therefore we require the shape of the Hebrew letter *Dalet* <term>Dalet - the fourth letter of the Hebrew alphabet, shaped like a corner</term>, and I did not understand the "hook" of the letter *Lamed*. <margin>Furthermore, because there is an error in this shape even on the inside, therefore on the outside it must be precisely defined.</margin> Furthermore, in the foundational text of *Parashat Pinhas* <note>A section of the Zohar</note>, page 258a, they said it is a "double *Resh*" <note>original: "ר כפולה"</note>. My mind was not settled until they revealed to me the secret of the "eight," and the students of the New Wisdom <note>referring to Lurianic Kabbalah</note> came and took the knot to be in the shape of a double *Dalet*. This knot was a search for me, and I learned it from a distance to the eye, for it is the shape of a double *Dalet* from the outside, like this: <image-desc>small square symbol representing the shape of the Tefillin knot</image-desc>. Know that the knot of the Hand-Tefillin is also doubled. This is explained in the *Mevaser Shalom* <note>original: "במח"ש", likely referring to a specific Kabbalistic commentary</note> on the laws of Tefillin. And know that the aspect of this letter *Dalet*, which is the knot of the Head-Tefillin, is the aspect of the **Foundation** <term>Yesod - the channel of divine transmission</term> that encompasses the entire realm of **Malchut/Rachel** <term>Rachel - the personification of the Shekhinah or the feminine divine presence</term>. It stands outside and above, and from the outside, it surrounds her. Behold, the secret of this *Dalet*, which is the knot of the Head-Tefillin, is the encompassing light for the "Kingdom" called Rachel, which is the aspect of the Hand-Tefillin, as I will explain many times further on.

### The Secret of the Two Straps Hanging from the Knot of the Head-Tefillin to the Head of Rachel

This will be understood as it is written in the Introduction to the *Tikkunei HaZohar* <note>The "Arrangements of the Zohar," a classic Kabbalistic text</note>, page 9a: "Two straps like the copper of the doors in the upper secret, and the horns are bent, and the rainbow is built from the heavens." In the same way, there are two straps, one long and one short. The short one reaches the chest, and the long one reaches the navel. Their spreading is from the "Upper Leaf" until the secular realm. This is the end of the quote. The explanation here is that the secret of the **Understanding** <term>Bina - the divine motherly attribute</term> alone is what spreads down to the "Foundation" of the **Lesser Countenance** <term>Zeir Anpin - the central six emotional attributes of the Divine</term>. This is not the case with the "Understanding" that is shorter and connects above. The secret of the matter is that it is known that the majority of the "Lesser Countenance" is on the side of the knot for the entire female aspect, Rachel, for they are the "Strengths" <term>Gevurot - the attributes of judgment and boundary</term>. Therefore, his "cloud" and his "right side" and specifically the whole world are for **Kindness** <term>Chessed</term>. We should know that his "Knowledge" and his "palate" are like a mountain toward the female, with only a very small amount coming from him. For this reason, the "Lesser Countenance" is only slightly inclined toward Kindness. Therefore, the right strap, which is the channel for the "Eight Kindnesses" in general, corresponds to the "rubbing" <note>original: "בחיכוכ'"</note> for all and enters into the inner heart of the "Lesser Countenance," which is in the place of his strength, according to the taste of the secret.

And below is the beginning of the head of the "Kingdom" <note>Malchut</note> on the outside. Therefore, in that place, the waters are interrupted, and this aspect of Kindness of the right strap concludes. What remains of it is a very small thing alone, and we build there in the inner part of the "Lesser Countenance," and it spreads there internally until the "Foundation" of the "Lesser Countenance" itself. Know that even though it passes to the foundation when it is in the "Lesser Countenance" according to the aspect of the "Thread of Wisdom" of the **Grandmother** <term>Imma - another name for the attribute of Bina</term>, because of the great magnitude of its light, it is not interrupted because of this. Even for the "Wisdom" <term>Chokhmah</term>, it also cascades down to the "Kingdom." Concerning the right and left straps, the one called "secular" <note>original: "חול"</note> also has a portion of the quantity and spreads over the place of reception. It is interrupted at the place where it can reach the body of the "Lesser Countenance" itself, and not until the navel of the heart as mentioned. The reason it is interrupted there is that there is the beginning of the "Strength" for the "Lesser Countenance" and the entry of the "Strengths" to be combined in the "Foundation" of the "Lesser Countenance," in the image of the intention for the "Lesser Countenance" that was clothed in the vessels of the *Dalet*. Because the "Lesser Countenance" is mostly Kindness, like white, it took from the "Strength" only a very small amount, and the rest was divided to the female. As is explained now, for there to be for the "Kingdom" only three "Brains" in total, which are "Wisdom," "Kindness," and "Strength," as will be explained later on page 24.

### Nathan Bel'er <note>Likely the name of a commentator or student</note>

The difficulty that the Rav <note>referring to Rabbi Isaac Luria, the Ari</note> raised was based on what is written in *Parashat Pinhas*, page 258b: "And the measure of the ancient ones for the Kingdom, they are until the end of the spreading, and until the navel of the right side." If so, it seems to be the opposite of what is said there in the *Tikkunim*. The Rav answered that this is a difficulty because there it speaks of the **Crown** <term>Keter</term> that encompasses everything, while in the *Tikkunim* it speaks of the point of **Understanding** <term>Bina</term> itself. For the "Left" that is in him is the "Right" that is in her, and the "Left" that is in her is the "Right" that is in him. This is the end of his words. And now, if so, we must look at the answer of the Rav, for it seems that it does not answer anything, and the difficulty remains in its place in its full strength. My teacher explained this deeply before me: that in this is the secret of the "Face" with the face of the "Lesser Countenance." Likewise, all the encompassings of the faces are toward Rachel, and the rest are taken to the second side. The "paz" <note>a numerical reference or type of gold</note> of the spice becomes the opposite because of this. The "eight" <note>Chessed</note> stands behind in the foundation with the "Lesser Countenance." Furthermore, there is no word that disagrees that the "Understanding" for her children and all the "pipes" are completed with the totality of the "Lesser Countenance," for their "Understanding" and "Wisdom" spread into the soul of the "Lesser Countenance." And the voice of the whole is in the voice of the "Lesser Countenance."

# The Laws of Tefillin

And to also indicate their place in the "Small Brain" <note>Hebrew: *Moach ha-Moat*; refers to a diminished state of the divine intellect</note> which originates from the three brains, therefore the shape is a *Lamed* <term>Lamed - the 12th letter of the Hebrew alphabet, which kabbalistically represents the flow of influence from the higher intellect to the lower</term>. Also, because the "Foundation" <term>Yesod - the sefira of connection and procreation</term> acts as a support for "Understanding" <term>Binah - the sefira of the Divine Mother</term>, it divides into two and becomes the two "houses" <note>The compartments of the Tefillin boxes</note> of the Tefillin. Such is the case for Understanding; they are the "face" of the aspect of "Other Waters" <note>original: "כמים אחרים"; a mystical reference to the flow of divine emanations</note> as mentioned above.

And behold, there are four names for the Tetragrammaton <note>The four-letter name of God, YHWH</note>, and the four letters *Aleph* of these four names are the Ten Sefirot—the "intellects" of Leah <note>Leah is the spiritual persona representing the concealed upper world</note>. In gematria <term>Gematria - Jewish numerology where letters have numerical values</term>, these equal "Measure" <note>original: "מד"ת", value 444</note>, corresponding to the four *Alephs* of the four names of "What He Was" <note>original: "מה היה"</note>. Corresponding to the four *Alephs* of the four Tetragrammatons is the **knot of the Tefillin** in the shape of the letters *Dalet* and *Lamed*.

The reason for this is that the "intellects" that are within the "vessel" of Understanding rise upward; they are hidden and are not revealed except from the "chest" downward. Therefore, in the upper aspect, they only had a portion in proportion to the whole. All this I wrote in our discourse on the "Countenance of Leah" regarding the verse "Skin for skin" (Job 2:4) etc., see there. 

After this, the knot—which is the lower aspect of the "Measure"—is lacking, and the two straps that surround the head are divided there. It is known that the entire aspect of the Tefillin is "Surrounding Light" <term>Or Makif - divine energy that is too powerful to be internalized and instead hovers over the person</term>. The Tefillin themselves consist of three straps, representing three "Surrounding Days." The two straps surrounding the head are the attributes of "Kindness, Strength, and Beauty" <note>original: "חג"ת" (Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet)</note>, and afterward they are repaired and tied into one knot, which is the aspect of the letter *Tav*. Their "Construction" <note>original: "לבונם", perhaps "building"</note> is also with him in the aspect of Leah. From this "Beauty" <term>Tiferet - the central sefira associated with the torso</term>, which is the knot, more energy emerges miraculously: these are the two straps that extend and descend from the knot downward. They descend alongside the body of Leah and extend until the "Hand-Prayer" <note>The Tefillin of the hand</note>, which is the aspect of Rachel <note>Rachel represents the revealed lower world</note>, serving as her "Surrounding Intellects." Thus, the aspect of the "Surrounding Lights" and the "Six Extremities" <note>The six lower emotional sefirot</note> of Rachel are completed.

One who focuses his intention elsewhere—perhaps it is permitted to return, just like one who throws <note>A legal analogy regarding the focus required for a mitzvah</note>. Therefore, in this aspect, it is judged to another place: the "return of the *Lamed*" <note>referring to a specific scribal or meditative movement</note> to return. The matter of this *Lamed* is as follows: we always say that the aspects of "Comprehension" <term>Tevunah - a sub-aspect of Binah</term> enter with the intellects into the skull of Leah. 

The extension of the "Sovereignty" <term>Malchut - the final sefira</term> of Comprehension, which is lower than them, takes its shape there when entering with them. There is a "voice of connection" there with the "Feminine" <note>The Nukva/Divine Feminine</note> in the "Knowledge" (*Da'at*) of the *Zeir Anpin* <term>Zeir Anpin - the 'Small Face' or emotional aspect of the Divine</term> through miracles from the skull to all its limbs as part of the general intellects. At the head of the "chamber"—the general chamber of the four scrolls of the Head-Tefillin—one returns to the "company" <note>original: "חבורה"</note>. By their power, through the internal intellects, this "return of the *Lamed*" is brought back and "clothed" in that Sovereignty of Comprehension called *Nam* <note>original: "נם"</note>. This is the *Lamed* corresponding to the thirty generations of Sovereignty within it. This "counts" their light from the outside, in the place of the Tefillin knot. There, the aspect of Sovereignty is revealed, which is the aspect of the *Dalet* of the knot, and within Sovereignty are the thirty generations of the "thirty intellects" <note>The numerical value of Lamed is 30</note>. 

Below, because only the existence of Sovereignty was there, there is nothing there but the aspect of "skin," for skin is the fallen state of Sovereignty. The "scrolls" <note>The sacred texts</note> are not within it, because there are no actual "intellects" there as there are in the Tefillin themselves. See this discourse in the name of *El HaMelekh* <note>To the King - likely a specific book or commentary</note> and the matter of this *Lamed* will be clarified. Thus, the matter of the knot is explained. 

(And as previously mentioned, within the "connector" of the Sovereignty of Comprehension, it is the aspect of the "skin" of its Foundation, and not the knot of the upper aspect. Therefore, it is mentioned at the end that the Surrounding Light was "skin only" and a "book." With this, one will understand what is written in the Zohar, Portion Pinhas, page 237b: "The Law of the Tefillin and its secret..." and the sign: it speaks literally of the *Lamed* except when entering in the evening and the "Day of the Covenant." And there on page 237b, it says the opposite—that it was in the pocket during the day and evening. The intention is as mentioned below: for at night this *Lamed* departs and returns to Leah like a "Great Pregnancy," more so than during the day—doubled. "And the Lord God built the side" (Gen 2:22); and in the *Ra'aya Mehemna* <note>A specific layer of the Zohar</note> it speaks of the "breaking of the bread" <note>original: "פירוק לחם"</note>... when entering evening in Leah and the "Day of the Covenant," for the knot departs into the "Heh" of Understanding and in the base... But in the Zohar itself it speaks of the "Heh" itself, that in the morning it enters the aspect of the *Lamed* and the "Day of Evening." At night, the "Surroundings" of Understanding depart once.)

This is the aspect of the "Gates of Beauty" <note>original: "שערים דת"ת"</note>; the light in the Head-Tefillin lacks its full power. Therefore, the light of these four scrolls was written inside the three internal intellects and protrudes to return until the place of the Tefillin knot. # The Secret of the Two Straps hanging from the Knot of the Head-Tefillin to the Head of Rachel

This will be understood through what is said in the Introduction to the *Tikunei Zohar*, page 9a: "The straps are called 'serpents' <note>original: "כנחשים"; refers to the life-force flowing through the narrow channels of the straps</note> because they provide life from the Higher Mother <note>Binah</note>." The "horns" are spread out and the "edges" are aligned... thus the straps are called one long and one short. The short one corresponds to Leah <note>The higher, concealed persona</note>, and the long one to Rachel <note>The lower, revealed persona</note>. They spread from the Higher Hand over the [lower] Hand. End of quote.

The explanation here is that the secret of "Understanding" <note>Binah</note> spreads over the Rachel-aspect of the Lesser Persona <note>Zeir Anpin</note>. This is not the case with the "Mother" <note>Imma</note>, which is shorter and remains hidden above. The secret of the matter is that it is known that her length is not due to any loss, but because the Mother is mostly composed of "Severities" <note>Gevurot - the restrictive divine forces</note>. Therefore, the branch extends and takes the entire "Crown of Kindness" <note>Ateret ha-Chesed</note> which is in his "Knowledge" <note>Da'at</note> and hides it within the Mother, leaving only a very small amount revealed. For this reason, only the Lesser Persona <note>Zeir Anpin</note> extends downward. 

Therefore, the strap is the expansion of "Kindness" <note>Chesed</note>... and it enters the "Navel" <note>Tibbura</note> of the Lesser Persona and enters into the inner parts of the Rachel-aspect of the Lesser Persona, which is at the place of its opening. 

And below, the head of the "Kingdom" <note>Malchut</note> begins on the outside. Therefore, they are in a state of being "ceased" <note>nifsaq</note>, and this aspect of Kindness from the right strap ends. From what remains of it, which is a very small amount, it enters and is built there within the inner part of the Lesser Persona, spreading there as the inner essence of the "Foundation" <note>Yesod</note> of the Lesser Persona itself. 

Know that sometimes the "Crown of Kindness," when it is later in the Lesser Persona... because of the greatness of its light, it does not cease. However, it too becomes adapted until the Kingdom. The strap of "Severities" <note>Gevurot</note> from the Mother's side also encompasses from the outside and spreads over the place of the Mother, and it ceases at the place of the "Navel" of the Female-aspect <note>Nukva</note> of the Lesser Persona itself, and not until the [lower] Navel. The reason it ceases there is because that is where the "Heh" <note>The letter ה</note> of the Lesser Persona begins, and the Severities enter there to be clothed in the Foundation of the Lesser Persona, similar to the "Brains" of the Lesser Persona that we wrote about...

Because the Lesser Persona is mostly "Kindness," he did not take from it the "Crown of Severity" except for a very small amount, and the rest was hidden within the Mother. Thus we find now that the life-force for the Kingdom... the "Brains"... for Kindness and Severity... [continued below on page 24].

# Nathan Gilead
<note>Likely the name of a student or a specific commentary branch</note>

A collection of difficulties that the Rabbi <note>The Arizal</note>, of blessed memory, raised regarding what is written in the *Zohar*, Portion of *Pinchas*, page 228b: "The navel of the 'Female of the Ancient One' <note>Nu'atik'a</note>... until the heart of the Mother." This contradicts what is written in the *Tikunim* regarding Rachel. The Rabbi, of blessed memory, resolves this by saying it is not a contradiction: there it speaks of the "Soul of the Face" <note>Nishmat ha-Panim</note>, while in the *Tikunim* it speaks of the aspect of "Understanding" <note>Binah</note> itself; for the "Lamp" within it is its right side, and its left side is his right side. ### A second reason regarding the matter of the knot of the Head-Tefillin

There is no aspect of the written portions inside it, because there are no actual "brains" there as there are in the Tefillin boxes themselves.

Regarding the mystical nature of the straps, the qualities of <term>Chokhmah|Wisdom, the first spark of intellect</term> and <term>Chesed|Kindness or Mercy</term> were included on the right side, while <term>Binah|Understanding, the expansion of intellect</term> and <term>Gevurah|Might or Judgment</term> were on the left side. ->**The Third Aspect**<- Since these three mentalities enter the "navel of the body" of the <term>Zeir Anpin|The "Lesser Countenance," the central masculine persona of the Sefirot</term>, they clothe themselves within his "Victory" and "Splendor" <note>the sefirot Netzach and Hod</note>. ->**The Fourth Aspect**<- The radiance of these mentalities, which reside within the inner Victory and Splendor of Zeir Anpin, emerges outward in the mystery of her "Surrounding Light" <note>original: "Or Makif," light that is too intense to be internalized and thus surrounds the soul</note>.

->**The Fifth Aspect**<- Afterward, his Wisdom and Understanding are clothed within the general scope of his "Might" <note>Gevurah</note> along with the "Beard" <note>the Dikna, a Kabbalistic metaphor for the flow of mercy</note>. Upon entering her, her mentalities are established in the mystery of the internal ones.

->**The Sixth Aspect**<- These mentalities of the aspect of Zeir Anpin return to be revealed as Surrounding Lights on her forehead in the mystery of the "Hand-Tefillin." Thus, all nine aspects of the mentalities of Sovereignty have been explained—how they mirror what we mentioned above regarding <term>Rachel|The feminine aspect of the Divine</term> and the mentalities of Zeir Anpin in all their aspects.

### The Internal Mentalities of Sovereignty consist of only two Mentalities ###

This is only because the "Foundation" <note>Yesod</note> of the "Mother" <note>Imma/Binah</note> does not extend to the location of the "Feminine" <note>Nukva</note>, as is known. Also, according to the aforementioned argument, the "Crown of Kindness" <note>Atara de-Chesed</note> is countered by that small portion of the "Mother" that resides in his Foundation. Therefore, she possesses only "Two Mentalities" which are in the Victory and Splendor of Zeir Anpin. The Victory contains the power of Wisdom, and the Splendor contains the power of Understanding and the Mights. At the end of these two, Sovereignty exists in silence, for she receives only a "scent" from the Sun <note>a metaphor for Zeir Anpin</note>. Therefore, she has Understanding and Might, but on the right, there is nothing but Wisdom. And below...

And the reason is that the Foundation of Zeir Anpin also enters the "Head of the Feminine," and within it, the "Crown of Might" <note>Atara de-Gevurah</note> is clothed. ### The secret of what causes the protrusion of the Internal Mentalities to emerge outward on the forehead of Jacob and Rachel ###

It follows the path we wrote above regarding the Tefillin of <term>Leah|The higher, often hidden, feminine persona</term>, which are included in the concept of the "Lock of Hair" <note>original: "Kotza de-Sa'arei," a strand of divine energy</note> of the <term>Adam Kadmon|Primordial Man, the highest spiritual realm</term>. The matter here is similar, for in the Foundation of Adam Kadmon, there is also one "Lock of Hair" that spreads through the back until it reaches the back of his own chest. That is where the "Head of Leah" is situated, behind the Zeir Anpin. This is because she stands back-to-back with Zeir Anpin, and thus her face is directed toward the "Lock of Hair." Now, Rachel does not truly clothe his entire body; she only stands attached to him at his back. Even though her body is physically connected and attached to the body of Zeir Anpin, she is not attached throughout her entire height. Her height, being "circular," is completely attached to his body at the "Beauty" <note>Tiferet, the central torso</note> of Zeir Anpin. It is only through the "Circle of Rachel" in this dangling matter... downwards, that regarding Rachel on the right and left, she is not connected. There is an empty space, a void, and air in her Understanding and its likeness. Therefore, only the place of her "Knowledge" <note>Da'at</note>, which stands in the middle, is what is attached to the back of Zeir Anpin. But the Wisdom and Understanding within her are not attached to him.

### Another Reason ###

This is because her "Rachel" <note>the persona of Rachel</note> is small in height. However, the width of the place of her mentalities is wider than the width of her "Rachel," as is known. In the "Secret of the Weights" <note>Ditra de-Tikhla</note>, Rachel is attached to the back of Zeir Anpin, and she requires the width of the body of Zeir Anpin from the aspect of the "Cleaving of Leah." It is found that the "Lock of Hair" from the head of Zeir Anpin protrudes outward and enters into the body... to him.
