# Laws of Tefillin

The "Upper Surrounding Light" <term>Ohr ha-Makif ha-Elyon|The transcendent divine light that surrounds a person's soul without being fully internalized</term> consisted of four "Mentalities" <note>original: "Daled Mochin," referring to the four types of divine intellect: Wisdom, Understanding, and the two aspects of Knowledge</note>. This is as we saw there in the Tractate of Berakhot, in the chapter on the "Pious ones," regarding the "Crown" <term>Keter|The highest of the ten Sefirot, representing divine will</term>—two blessings before and one after. This is to demonstrate how the Mentalities clothe themselves within the aspect of the cheeks and enter into the Crown. This is the meaning of "in the Crown one blesses two before," corresponding to "Knowledge" <term>Da’at|The sefirah of consciousness and connection</term>, which is clothed within the "Foundation of Understanding" <term>Yesod de-Binah|The aspect of the divine mother that transmits wisdom downward</term>. In these arrangements, they depart and stand at the "Head of Man" in the mystery of the "Surrounding Light." Therefore, one must bless "two before" corresponding to Wisdom and Understanding <note>original: "Chokhmah and Binah"</note>, and also "two after" corresponding to Splendor and Foundation, for the surrounding light of the nine and the four is complete. Therefore, the Tefillin has two straps. This is what is meant by "one is long and hidden/absent, and one is short" below the "Sabbath-limit" <note>original: "Mishapit," likely referring to the anatomical point where the knot rests</note>, the place of its knot for the grave, etc., and its function is understood. Afterward, when they clothe themselves in the aspect of Understanding and enter the "Skull of the Lesser Countenance" <term>Gulgaltā de-Zeir Anpin|The spiritual "skull" or container for the divine intellect in the central persona of the Sefirot</term>, they become only three, because the "two crowns" <note>the two aspects of Da'at</note> clothe themselves together in the Foundation of Understanding. Therefore, on the Head-Tefillin, there were two versions of the letter *Shin*: one with four heads and one with three heads, absolutely.

->**The Second Reason**<- Because the four Mentalities of the "Smallness of Leah" <term>Katnut de-Leah|A state of restricted or immature divine consciousness associated with the higher feminine persona</term> and the three garments of the aspect of the Smallness of Leah—corresponding to them are the two *Shins* on the Tefillin. All of them are the names of *Elohim* <note>God</note>, and *Elohim* in its "filled" spelling <note>a Kabbalistic method where each letter's name is spelled out</note> is the secret of the numerical value 300 <note>the value of the letter Shin</note>. These are the three heads of the *Shin* corresponding to the four Mentalities—three of Understanding—and all of them are in the state of "Smallness."

->**The Third Reason**<- And this is the matter: Behold, the Mentalities of "Smallness" are in the "Crown of the Vessels." The Mentalities of "Greatness" <term>Gadlut|A state of expanded, mature divine consciousness</term> are made upon them in the aspect of "Houses" <note>the leather compartments</note> for the Mentalities of Greatness, which are the parchment scrolls of the Tefillin. Therefore, they are hinted at in the aspect of the "skin" <note>leather</note> alone. This is why the *Shins* must be complete, for the state of "Smallness" represents "Judgments" <note>original: "Dinim"</note>. Behold, the state of Smallness is represented by the names of *Elohim*. *Elohim* spelled out with the letter *Yud* has the numerical value of 300 <note>Shin</note>. Furthermore, the Mentalities of Greatness, which are the Names of the Four-Lettered Name <note>original: "Havayah" or Tetragrammaton</note> in the Crown at first—the numerical value of the Four-Lettered Name is... <note>original: "M"T G"T," likely an abbreviation for a specific Gematria calculation</note> in the aspect of "And they shall be afraid of you" (Deuteronomy 28:10), because of the three-headed *Shin* that is upon it. "And all the peoples of the earth shall see that the Name of the Lord is called upon you"—the first letters of this phrase in Hebrew spell *Shin* <note>original: "Shem Yud-He-Vav-He Karu Alecha," though the acronym is usually interpreted mystically</note>. For when the Mentalities of Smallness—which are the Name *Elohim* equaling 300—give power, it is hinted at in the Tefillin. Therefore, "all the <term>Sila'ah|External forces or 'husks' that draw energy from the holy</term> shall fear you," for the name *Elohim* literally [protects]. The reason there are two *Shins* is that they are vessels for the Mentalities of Greatness. Therefore, they hint at the "Internal Reality" that is transformed in the mystery of the "Surrounding Light." There were four Mentalities of Greatness, and these, in our understanding, in the "Head of the Lesser Countenance,"

became only three Mentalities. Thus, there are two *Shins*. ... It is divided into *Yesh* <note>numerical value 310</note> which is the "Living Soul" <note>Chayah</note>. It has two "Vessels," which are two types of Surrounding Lights: the "Surrounding L" of Greatness and the "Surrounding M" of Greatness <note>referring to the letters Lamed and Mem, which signify different scales of surrounding light</note>. This is as mentioned above: two stages of Greatness, two... divided into *Yesh*, which are those that guard it from all the "External Ones" <term>Chitzonim|Forces of evil or impurity that exist outside the realm of holiness</term>. Therefore, one must hint at these two Surrounding Lights with the two *Shins* of the Tefillin. This is found in the Jerusalem Talmud, Tractate Berakhot, Chapter 1: "Our Rabbis taught: 'And all the peoples of the earth shall see...'—this includes seeing even the prayer shawl <note>Tallit</note> and even the amulets." This is because "the Name of the Lord is called upon you," meaning that the four letters of the Name of God are called upon you in the mystery of the Surrounding Light. For all four letters of the Name are revealed, and there is power in the "House" for them. "And they shall fear you," for the "External Ones" have no power to gaze at the Surrounding Light, but only at the "Internal Mystery," as is known. Therefore, our Sages of blessed memory said that this refers to the *Shin* of the Tefillin, and that there are two *Shins* corresponding to the two Surrounding Lights of Greatness. According to what Leah wrote above, the Tefillin are a hint to the Mentalities of the "Lesser Countenance" that enter from the Foundation of Understanding. Therefore, our Sages said that the "Thorns" <note>the small strokes on the letters</note> of the letter *Dalet*... according to the *Shin* of the Tefillin. Is it not below our "Shofinu" <note>possibly the neck or nape</note>? And most *Shins* are called toward the place of the knot. The intention is that the "Radiance" is the radiance of the... of the Foundation of Understanding. And the "Tefillah" <note>prayer/tefillin</note> is the Tefillah of <term>Tal|Dew, which has a numerical value of 39</term>, as is known to the masters of the hidden wisdom. This is in accordance with what I wrote above, that the Foundation of Understanding is called "Sinai," and there is the foundation for the "Woman" who is called... and understand this.

<header>Laws of Tefillin</header>

In the Zohar—and in the Tikkunim of the Zohar, in the portion of *Kometz* <note>original: "Ha-Kometz," referring to a chapter in the Talmudic tractate Menachot, folio 34b, which discusses the scriptural source for Tefillin</note>, folio 54, side b.

And these are its words: "*Totafot, Totafot, le-Totafot*" <note>original: "טטפת לטטפת לטוטפת"</note>—this indicates there are four sections, according to the words of Rabbi Ishmael. For the word "Totafot" appears three times in the Torah <note>the plural spelling variations imply the number of compartments</note>. The word *Tot* means "two" in the Coptic language and *Fot* means "two" in the African language <note>original: "Katpi" and "Afriki." This is the classic Talmudic philological derivation of why the head-tefillin has four compartments</note>. This follows the path of Jacob and the level of Rachel. And the word "Totafot" refers to the two head-tefillin of the Small Face <term>Ze’ir Anpin|The masculine aspect of the divine, often associated with the six emotional attributes</term> and so on. Rabbi Akiva says: it is not necessary to derive it this way <note>Rabbi Akiva derives the four sections from the word "Totafot" itself through a different linguistic method</note>. One does not need to place a blue strap over the entirety of the Tefillin, but rather one must place the four sections <note>original: "G-K-D-R-Y-K," an abbreviation for the four Torah portions: Kadesh, Ve-haya Ki Yeviacha, Shema, and Ve-haya Im Shamoa</note> that exist in every four sections. For it is impossible to say there is a difference between one Tefillah and another in their totality; therefore, one places them as Rabbi Ishmael says. For thus they call the "two" in the Coptic tongue and in the African tongue they call the "two" a total of four <note>original: "Lo-vage" and "Aphriki"</note>. This means that in the head-tefillin there are four distinct sections that branch out for Jacob and Rachel in the aspect of the Hand Tefillin, which are the Kindness and Severity of Wisdom <note>original: "Chasadim and Gevurot of Chokhmah"</note> and the Kindness and Severity of the Mother <term>Imma|The Sefirah of Binah or Understanding, the Divine Mother</term>. Sometimes the Kindness and Severity of the Mother are the aspect... and this is the secret regarding the Kindness and Severity of Wisdom. Inasmuch as every Tefillah has four sections, therefore Rabbi Akiva derived from the word "*Totafot*" to teach that every "frontlet" has four sections, so that one should not err and say: since Jacob and Rachel do not have the Kindness and Severity of Wisdom—which are the three and four sections—therefore he derived from "Totafot" that they branch out even if they lack Wisdom. Nevertheless, we see that the four aspects of the Mother become for them the aspect of Kindness and Severity, and in this, they have the three and four sections completed. And behold, "these and those are the words of the Living God" <note>A famous Talmudic phrase meaning both conflicting opinions are divinely true</note>, and not just one; for one Master believes there are four distinct types of Tefillin, and the other Master believes that in every Tefillah there are four sections, and this is simple to understand.

## The Secret of the Knot of the Tefillin of Jacob

**And afterwards**, from the power of the radiance that was drawn to Jacob, the lights return to the back. And just as their reception caused them to go to every "Face" until the end—which is the "Head of Jacob"—so too in their return to the back, they return until the end—which is Rachel. And in every place they strike, they form a **knot**. How so? Behold, as they return to the back of the Head of Jacob at the location of the nape, they bring out a radiance there for Leah, the wife of Jacob. And so we find regarding the Generation of the Wilderness: when the Generation of the Wilderness stood, they held fast there and made there the **Knot of the Tefillin of Jacob**, which is the aspect of Leah, the wife of Jacob. This is according to the secret that in every "Solomon's wife" <note>Referring to the feminine divine persona</note> a knot of the Tefillin is made at the nape of the Small Face <term>Ze'ir Anpin</term>. All of this was explained well and at greater length there in its proper place, see there. And we have already explained that Leah is called "*Tam*" <note>original: "תם," meaning simple, complete, or perfect</note> because she is the aspect of the knot of the Tefillah of Rachel and of the Small Face, and she takes the four *Alephs* of the name *Ehyeh* <note>original: "א׳ א׳ א׳ א׳" of the divine name "I Will Be"</note> which exist in the aspect of the Mother, in which the "Mentalities" of the Small Face are clothed from the side of the Mother, as is known. And on page 100... and when you remove the four simple *Alephs*... the numerical value equals "**Tam**" <note>The word Tam (תם) equals 440. This is a complex Gematria calculation involving the divine name Ehyeh</note>. And so too regarding the aspect of Jacob and the Female: "Jacob was a **simple** <note>original: "Tam"</note> man" (Genesis 25:27), the husband of the "Simple One," in the Zohar, portion *Shelach Lecha*, folio 163, side b.

And do not say that before the lights reach Jacob, they strike the persona of the "Generation of the Wilderness" which is adjacent to the Small Face, while Jacob is in a "Small State" <term>Katnut|A state of diminished spiritual consciousness</term>. If so, why is the aspect of the Tefillin not made on the head, but rather earlier? The reason is that the primary intention of the return of these lights was for Jacob and to become Tefillin for the structure of Jacob. Their passage through the Generation of the Wilderness is merely a temporary passing; therefore, the aspect of Tefillin was not made there, but only a knot alone. And understand this.

## The Secret of the Head Tefillin of Rachel

### Afterward, the light returns further back

Until it strikes the body of the Small Face and is hidden there, and returns and exits from the Small Face and is hidden in the Head of Rachel at her nape. For behold, the back of the head corresponds to the back of the Small Face. Therefore, it first strikes her nape and is hidden in the head, and this is at her forehead. And there the **Tefillin of Rachel** are made in the aspect of the "Hand Tefillah." There too are four sections, but they are not like the four sections of the Head Tefillin of the Small Face, which are Wisdom and Understanding, and Wisdom and Understanding. Rather, they are in the manner we explained regarding the Tefillin of Jacob. They are *Kadesh* and *Ve-haya Ki Yeviacha*—the Wisdom and Understanding of "Father" <term>Abba|The Sefirah of Chokhmah</term>; *Shema* and *Ve-haya Im Shamoa*—the Wisdom and Understanding of "Mother." And the Wisdom and Understanding of the Mother are "Kindness and Severity" <note>original: "Chasadim and Gevurot"</note> relative to the Wisdom and Understanding of the Father. Know that in the Zohar, portion *Bo*, folio 43, side b, it is explained that for the four sections of the Hand Tefillah, they are also Wisdom/Understanding and Wisdom/Understanding. And this is as mentioned, for the Wisdom and Understanding of the Mother become in her the aspect of Wisdom/Understanding in the aspect of the "Wisdom and Understanding of Wisdom."

According to the choice for its taste, it was the Wisdom and Understanding of the Father and the Wisdom and Understanding of the Mother in the secret of Jacob.

# Laws of Tefillin

## Head-Tefillin of Jacob: How?

**They emerge** from the aspect of the "Voice, the voice of Jacob" <note>original: "Ha-kol kol Yaakov," a reference to Genesis 27:22</note> from the side that strikes the aspect of the "thorn" <note>a *kotz* or "thorn" refers to a minute stroke of light or the tip of a Hebrew letter representing a high spiritual root</note> of the Small Face <term>Ze’ir Anpin|The masculine aspect of the divine, often associated with the six emotional attributes</term> toward the internal Small Face, as mentioned. The voice shines within them through the "windows" that pass through his hair from his "brains" <term>Mohin|Mentalities or intellectual lights that descend into the divine personas</term>. This follows the secret of the "thorn" of the Small Face that strikes the head, for the Small Face is the essence itself. Then, the name "152" <note>original: "KN'B," the numerical value (Gematria) of the divine name *Ehyeh* (I Will Be) when spelled out with the letter *He*</note> of the Small Face and the Wisdom and Understanding <note>Chochmah and Binah</note> of the Mother <term>Imma|The divine persona representing the attribute of Understanding</term> are placed there. He brings them forth toward the interior of the Small Face, and they emerge outward toward his face. There, they encounter the back of the head of Jacob, who stands "back-to-face" with the Small Face. For the back of Jacob corresponds to the face of the Small Face, as is known. There, the "Voice, the Voice" encounters the thorn of the hair at the nape of Jacob's neck and enters into his head as his own mentalities. These are brought forth to the exterior on Jacob's forehead, and there they become Tefillin on Jacob's forehead, containing four passages.

However, they are not like the four passages of the head-Tefillin of the Small Face, which consist of the name "152" and the Kindness and Strength <note>Chesed and Gevurah</note> of the Mother. Nor are they like the Kindness, Strength, and Brains of Leah <note>Jacob’s first wife, representing a higher feminine level</note> in the place of Leah's Tefillin, as explained later. Rather, in these Tefillin [of Jacob], there are only two Wisdoms and two Understandings from the Father and Mother <note>Aba and Imma</note>. For him, the passage of *Kadesh* (Sanctify) corresponds to the Wisdom of the Father. The passage of *Ve-haya Ki Yeviacha* (And it shall be when He brings you) corresponds to the Wisdom of Understanding. The passage of *Shema* (Hear) corresponds to the Wisdom of the Mother. And the passage of *Ve-haya Im Shamoa* (And it shall be if you obey) corresponds to the Understanding of the Mother. The name "152" of the Mother is considered as Kindness and Strength relative to the Wisdom and Understanding of the Father.

**Let us return to the matter** of why we place the Tefillin on the head, which is the prayer of the Small Face, and the Tefillin of the hand, which is the prayer of the Female <term>Nukvah|The feminine aspect of the divine, often associated with Malchut or the Shekhinah</term>. And why, also, do we not place Tefillin for Jacob? Furthermore, how does Jacob have Tefillin, since the name "prayer" <note>Tefillah, often used as a synonym for Tefillin</note> does not belong to his head at all, as he is a "collection" for the Small Face? It appears this follows the Mishnah in the chapter "The Blue Thread" <note>original: "Perek Ha-Techelet," referring to Tractate Menachot, folio 38a</note>: "The Tefillah of the hand does not prevent the [use of] the head-Tefillah, and the head-Tefillah does not prevent the hand-Tefillah." For we find that Jacob has only one Tefillah—that of the head alone. But it is still difficult: why, in truth, does he have only one Tefillah? Also, the Tefillah of Jacob is considered the same as the Tefillah of the hand for Leah, as is known. Just as the head-Tefillah of the Female is the hand-Tefillah of the Small Face, so too the head-Tefillah of Jacob is equivalent to the hand-Tefillah of Leah.

...to the Grandfather <term>Arich Anpin|The "Long Face," the highest persona of the world of Atzilut, representing Divine Will</term> himself. The second grew by the "strike" of the Female; it does not strike the Female herself in the same way the thorn of the hair of the Small Face strikes the head of the Small Face itself. This is because there, the "Voice of the Wanderer" <note>original: "Sotim," possibly referring to peripheral or "deviant" lights</note> clothes the Grandfather. Not so here, where the membrane of the Small Face separates the "Voice-Thorn of the hair" and the "Voice-Body of the Grandfather." But here, where there is a place in the body of the Small Face itself on both sides of the Female's neck, all that can emerge through the internal "End-Splendor-Foundation" <note>the sefirot Netzach, Hod, and Yesod</note> of the Small Face connects and shines there. Furthermore, the reason it is called a "Voice" in the Small Face is that it strikes the nape of the Small Face because there is hair like it there; but here, in the "strike" of the Female, there is no hair like it, so it does not strike there.

### Third Reason

It has been explained elsewhere that there is a difference between the Knowledge <note>Da'at</note> of the Small Face and the Knowledge of the Female. For the Knowledge of the Small Face is literally high in his head. The "strike" of the Female's Knowledge is lower than her head; it is literally in her body, in the middle between her two shoulders. There lies the name "152," and they are in the upper third of her Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>. Her Knowledge always stands and shines there because her Knowledge immediately stands above. Therefore, the "Voice-Thorn" of the side immediately strikes in the middle, corresponding to the Knowledge, etc. This is why a "Unification" <note>Yichud</note> is placed there on the secret of a place where there is no "brain," and therefore it strikes from three sides—which are the two lines of Wisdom and Understanding.

**Behold, it is known** that three "brains" of the Small Face spread from his head to his feet through his three columns. Sometimes, in the estimation of the Small Face himself, there is no spreading of the... [as] in the value of Jacob and Rachel... for from the chest <note>Chazeh</note> downward, those that emerge from them become the brains for Jacob and Rachel, as is known. It is found that the "Voice-Thorn" of the side that strikes the two sides of the body of the Small Face strikes the two columns from the sides. These are the two middle joints... which enter within the three... which are the spreading of the Secret Brains of the Small Face... but the Knowledge of the Small Face, which is in the... in his middle column, does not strike, because there the Male and Female are connected "flesh in a single piece" <note>original: "be-mashkesha," a reference to the primordial union of the masculine and feminine back-to-back</note>.

# Laws of Tefillin

Three layers cover the worlds, and they are the aspect of the *Nefesh* <note>The lowest level of the soul</note> because they are only a *Reshimu* <note>term: Reshimu; a "trace" or "impression" left behind after light has departed</note> of the mentalities (*Mochin*) and not the mentalities themselves. During the recitation of the *Shema*, they are internal mentalities covering the Divine Names, and they are the aspect of the *Ruach* <note>The middle level of the soul</note>. During the Standing Prayer (*Amidah*), they are the secret of the "Surrounding Light" (*Makkif*) covering the Names, and they are the aspect of the *Neshamah* <note>The higher level of the soul</note>, for through prayer, actual new mentalities come into the "Will of Israel." This is the end of the quote.

And with this, it will be answered: for in the morning, the soul enters *Zeir Anpin* <note>term: Zeir Anpin; literally "Small Face," the emotive attributes of the Divine</note> in a complete state, but only the mentalities of *Imma* <note>term: Imma; "Mother," the attribute of Understanding/Binah</note>. Therefore, the union is only through the mentalities of *Rabbeinu Tam* <note>note: Referring to the specific arrangement of Tefillin scrolls according to the sage Rabbeinu Tam</note>, which are the Tefillin of *Imma*. At that time, they are still "back-to-back" <note>note: A state of diminished connection where the Divine attributes do not face one another</note> or a "clinging of the personas back-to-back." But afterward, during the Standing Prayer, the union is "face-to-face," and then there are mentalities of *Abba* <note>term: Abba; "Father," the attribute of Wisdom/Chokhmah</note> as well, which are the Tefillin of *Rabbeinu Tam*.

Regarding what the Rabbi <note>note: Likely referring to Isaac Luria, the Ari</note>, of blessed memory, wrote—that the mentalities of Jacob and Rachel are from the back of the persona of *Chokhmah* of *Arich Anpin* <note>term: Arich Anpin; "Long Face," the Divine attribute of Will/Crown</note> clothed in the *Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet* of *Zeir Anpin*—this is to say that the lights were previously the upper mentalities of *Imma*. *Zun* <note>term: Zun; the pair of Zeir Anpin and Nukva/Feminine</note> has nothing but the back of the three, and certainly the mentalities of *Chokhmah* do not begin to enter *Zeir Anpin* until the time of the Standing Prayer, when *Abba* is face-to-face with *Zeir Anpin*.

If so, how can we say the mentalities come from the "back" of *Abba*? Rather, you must say they are the "traces" (*Reshimu*) of the Tefillin of *Abba* and *Imma* that are revealed as "Will" in Jacob and Rachel. Therefore, one must lay two pairs of Tefillin—those of *Rashi* and *Rabbeinu Tam*—because in these traces, both pairs of Tefillin are included. But the truth is that in the morning before the prayer, the "back" of *Abba* and *Imma* are traces in the Feminine, and they are the active force. In all the "back" of *Abba* and *Imma*, the traces are not revealed; they are in potential and not in action because *Zeir Anpin* is still "small" and lacks *Da'at* <note>Knowledge/Connection</note> except for the *Shema*. Therefore, he only selects the *Chesed, Gevurah, and Lamed* of *Abba* and *Imma* alone, and not the back of the three.

We can also say that when the time of the Standing Prayer arrives, her *Da'at* rises up to his head, and all the Tefillin become traces. "Give to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser" <note>note: A quote from Proverbs 9:9</note>.

Therefore, there was power in the "Parallelism" to raise the "Feminine Waters" to bring out all the lights as mentioned. **He gives forever**, for the three times mentioned above were prayed from him. And the reason for its squareness...

And the *Da'at* does not suckle at the top of the head, but rather in order below between the shoulders. However, the "back" of *Imma* is... in relation to the "back" of *Abba*. For the Tefillin of *Rabbeinu Tam* there are three reasons how they were made... and this is a great matter that appears as one.

Furthermore, regarding the level of the persona of Jacob, the Rabbi, of blessed memory, wrote that just as there are aspects of "Surrounding Lights" for *Zal* and *Zeir Anpin* called "Israel" which are opposite his Tefillin, so too are there these aspects in Jacob. From these, we can [derive] another three... this language is toward his face, and then they become the four "Surrounding Lights" for Jacob, and these are the secret of the Tefillin of Jacob, etc. See there. And so in the discourse on King David and in several places, it is explained that the mentalities for Jacob are made from the "back" of *Zeir Anpin*.

And why, at the time of the union, when the mentalities of Jacob are in the secret of "Returning Light" to make mentalities for Rachel, how is it possible that she also receives from the mentalities of... to *Abba*... And furthermore, if... in Jacob, we wrote above that he only receives from the "back" of *Zal* and they become his mentalities. And there he wrote that the mentalities of Jacob are made from the "back" of the *Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet*, the lights in the *Yesod* of the male. And this is what seems to me to correct this, according to my humble opinion, according to what the Rabbi brought regarding *Chokhmah*: that the Tefillin are those internal [lights] with the surrounding [lights].

# Laws of Tefillin

### The Distribution of the Lights

The essence of every spiritual level is defined by its measure, and it does not spread beyond its boundary. When the lights spread there, as mentioned previously, they reach the "chest" <note>Hebrew: Chazeh; a kabbalistic landmark in the spiritual body</note> and from there they are divided. Therefore, the knowledge <term>Da'at: the faculty of connection and integration</term> of the female persona, Rachel, cannot be formed at the top of her head. 

And if you should say that since the "Crown of Kindness" <note>The highest sub-sefirah of Chesed</note> is at the chest and not at the throat, this is impossible; for it is simple to us that the entire body of Rachel is formed by the two Kindnesses <note>Chasadim</note> (as is known, the "Water" <note>Mayim: representing masculine flow</note> of the male and female are in the secret of the square, for the Crown of Kindness is as written: "in the middle of her heart," and the power of the essence—meaning the skull of the Kindness—is there at the chest, and it concludes at the head, which is the throat). The answer is that because the "Upper Foundation" <note>Yesod of the Father/Abba</note> was forced to build the persona of Rachel herself, they are required to stop at this point; therefore, they no longer have the power to create the aspect of Knowledge <term>Da'at</term> within her.

**The Second Reason:** Because the Brains <term>Mohin: the intellectual lights of the soul</term> themselves, which are Wisdom and Understanding <note>Chokhmah and Binah</note>, could not emerge except through these two revealed Kindnesses within them. These are the ones that give them the power to bring the lights outward so they can form the aspect of Tefillin for Rachel; and for this reason, they are required to stop here.

**The Third Reason:** Because the "Upper Foundation" of the Small Face <note>Yesod of Zeir Anpin (the masculine divine persona)</note>, which is the light of the "Father," was likewise at the chest; it did not have enough power to bring out the Brains of Wisdom and Understanding for Rachel except through the descent of the two Kindnesses as mentioned. Since the "Upper Foundation" brings out many generations—which are the Tefillin of Jacob, and their knot which is Leah, and the Tefillin of Rachel—this requires great power to bring out all these generations. Therefore, they are required to stop at the two Kindnesses to bring out the Brains for Rachel. Consequently, they cannot form the Knowledge <term>Da'at</term> in Rachel at the top of her head.

And now one must understand the first reason: why the "Upper Foundation" of the Long Face <note>Arich Anpin: the most primal divine persona</note> only brought out the aspect of Tefillin for the Small Face <note>Zeir Anpin</note> and their knot alone, whereas the "Upper Foundation" of the Small Face brought out the aspect of the "Knot" <note>the back-knot of the Tefillin</note>, which are the Tefillin of Jacob and their knot, and the Tefillin of Rachel. This is because the "Upper Foundation" of the Long Face is in a place where the lights are hidden <note>the "Closed Memory"</note>... and therefore it only had the power to bring out the Tefillin of the Small Face and its knot. But the "Upper Foundation" of the Small Face is from the place where the Kindnesses are revealed, within the essence of the chest, as mentioned.

<column-break/>

...of Jacob, and so it is for Rachel. And it is known that the speech is there, therefore it is found there. And there are the 72 names <note>The Name of 72 (Ayin-Bet)</note>... and therefore there are two names of 151 <note>The Gematria/numerical value of the name Eheyeh filled with the letter Heh</note>, which are twice 151 for Jacob, and twice 151 for Rachel. These are the four compartments <note>The four scrolls found in the head-Tefillin</note> that are in Israel: the Priests, the Levites, the Israelites, and the Converts.

The Priests and the Israelites emerge from Jacob, for the persona of Jacob emerges from the "Foundation of the Mother" <note>Yesod of Binah</note>... and it is known that Wisdom is called "Priest." Similarly, it is explained in the secret of the Generation of the Wilderness how they emerge from the Foundation of the Mother: the Priests from the right side of Jacob, and the Israelites from the left side of Jacob. And all the Converts in the world emerge from them...

Therefore, the aspect of the two compartments of the Priests and the Israelites emerge from Jacob. But the aspect of the two other compartments, which are the Levites and the Converts, emerge from Rachel. For she receives the aspect of the "Indwelling Presence" <note>Shekhinah</note> which is called "Levi" in secret... and also the Kingship <term>Malkhut</term> itself, her entire persona is built through the Severities <term>Gevurot</term> which are the Levites. Similarly, from the beginning, she was attached to the "Back of the Small Face," and her entire rectification is from Israel. Therefore, the Levites and the Converts emerge from the aspect of Rachel.

And the verse "He counts the number of the stars" <note>Psalm 147:4</note> means: the "Number" <note>Mispar</note> is the Indwelling Presence, and the count of seven times 151 is the numerical value of "Israel" <note>Yisrael = 541</note>... and this is the Indwelling Presence that dwells with them always. For it spreads over four camps, which are the "Four Legs" <note>of the Divine Throne</note>, and it has the power to sustain all the generations of these four classes that emerge from Israel...

Furthermore, "Wisdom" and "Understanding" <note>Chokhmah and Binah</note> have the numerical value of 150, and with the inclusion of the word itself, it equals 151. Therefore, the Tefillin are called "Fear" <term>Pachad</term> <note>The word "Tefillin" is associated with the awe of God</note>. Another reason is because the Small Face receives the aspect of Tefillin from the "Beauty of Understanding," and Jacob and Rachel receive the aspect of their Tefillin from the "Beauty of the Small Face," and therefore the Tefillin are called "Fear."

From there, the "war" descends into his **Foundation** <note>Yesod</note> in the aspect of **Justice** <note>Tzedek</note>, for the seven wandering stars <note>the planets</note> are in the seven extremities of Zeir Anpin: Saturn in **Kindness** <note>Chesed</note>, Jupiter in **Might** <note>Gevurah</note>. And the Foundation of Zeir Anpin is also called **Justice**, as it is written: "He forms study as good to be sent," and its spirit is Judgment... five Kindnesses and five Mights in the Foundation. It is called a "perfect vision." But their "wing" does not yet have the five Kindnesses and five Mights of the union, but rather her five Mights alone; therefore, it is simply called **Justice** <note>Tzedek - implying a harsh or incomplete state before the union</note>. Afterward, when she receives the five Mights into the **Crown of the Foundation** <note>Atarah di-Yesod</note> of Zeir Anpin, in her Knowledge it is called "Perfect Justice." And she still lacks Kindnesses... she is also called **Life** <note>Chai</note>, but the male is called **Life** because he always possesses the five Kindnesses and five Mights. Therefore, they are precise in order to be bound to her and mixed with her, so as to receive during the time of union the 160 Kindnesses. Therefore, a person must first rectify them to return again and again. One must be purified "face to face" through the intention of prayer. This is the secret of "calling from a distance" to remind her face to face so she may have the capacity to receive the five Kindnesses and the Mights themselves at the time of the Radiance. Therefore, she is called "alone" as when she is clarified from Zeir Anpin, receiving only the Mights of rest. Therefore, one must connect with her the "return," which is the Foundation of Zeir Anpin, through which she comes to appease Zeir Anpin. Then she receives the branches, the five... in the crown of her Knowledge in the hidden worlds.

And the reason the Foundation is called *Yesod* is because it has the five Kindnesses and five Mights of the union. Therefore, for **Sovereignty** <note>Malchut</note> to be like the male, she must be established in the Foundation of Zeir Anpin and not in the wall above in the Foundation of Understanding. Therefore, one must connect the Foundation of Zeir Anpin... the Foundation of Wisdom which causes the Knowledge of Sovereignty to ascend... as explained in the *Tree of Life* <note>Etz Chaim - the primary text of Lurianic Kabbalah</note>.

# Laws of Tefillin

To understand the secret of the knot: these were born outwardly in the form of <note>The Hebrew "Selah" here likely refers to a meditative pause or emphasis</note> Selah. And these are made into a knot for the Tefillin of the hand <note>The phylactery worn on the arm</note>, which is the shape of the letter *Yod*. This is because it is formed from the *Yesod* <term>Foundation: the ninth emanation or Sefirah, often associated with the procreative force</term> of *Zeir Anpin* <term>The "Small Face" or Divine Son, representing the emotive attributes of God</term>, which is lacking within her *Mochin* <term>Brains/Intellect: the higher cognitive lights of a Divine persona</term>. It takes the shape of a *Yod*, and within it are the aspects of her four *Mochin*, which are the four sections of the Tefillin of the hand, following the pattern of the form of the Tefillin of the head. (Here it seems to me, the editor, that I found a gloss in the Zohar, Portion Balak, page 83b: "Every hollow of the oak <note>original: "mactesh alon"</note>, the Tefillin of the arm are bound below, the secret of the Holy Covenant." This is a hint to the *Yesod* of *Zeir Anpin* which becomes the knot of the hand-Tefillin. Likewise in Portion Phinehas, page 236b).

### The Secret of the Second Knot of the Hand-Tefillin

And it is slightly distant from the main arrangement. We have already explained that above, in "Small Rachel" <note>A mystical persona representing the Shekhinah or Divine Presence in a specific state</note>, there are only two *Mochin*, which are *Wisdom* and *Understanding* from the "Father" <term>Abba</term>, and she also has *Wisdom* and *Understanding* from the "Mother" <term>Imma</term> in place of *Kindness* and *Strength*, as mentioned above. Regarding the "Brain" according to this, they are equal in Rachel only in the measure of two *Mochin* for each side, *Kindness* and *Strength*. Despite all this, they are divided into four *Mochin* until this point, which is the *Da'at* <term>Knowledge: the bridge between the intellect and the emotions</term>. Her "Hiddenness," which is the "Crown of Strength," is lower down in her body, and therefore a seventh "Brain" does not ascend there. Consequently, there were not five sections in the Tefillin of the hand, because the Tefillin correspond to the *Mochin* in her head. Therefore, they are actual sections, modeled after the Tefillin of the head of *Zeir Anpin*, for all of her *Da'at* which is below in the aspect of the "Body" and is not in the aspect of "Brains"—therefore there was no section corresponding to it. However, the matter of *Da'at* in Rachel is the aspect of the knot found in the hand-Tefillin. Therefore, it is the shape of a *Yod*, which is the aspect of *Da'at* that our Sages of blessed memory mentioned, similar to the first knot which is the *Yesod* of *Zeir Anpin*. And because the *Da'at* is below in her body, it only has the shape of a *Yod*—a simple concave line—and there is no parchment section inside it (which would be the aspect of the "Brain") like the other sections. However, know that this knot is not like the knot of the head-Tefillin; for there, it is in an aspect of lacking a place of its own, and after it, it is doubled... and stands there in the *Mochin*. Therefore, the knot of the head-Tefillin is far from the Tefillin boxes themselves. For first, two straps extend from the Tefillin, and afterward, far from the Tefillin, they make a knot there which is very distant from it. But in this knot...

<column-break/>

...it is the very essence of Rachel, the aspect of *Da'at*, the numerical value <term>Gematria</term> of her "Strength" <note>Gevurah</note> from her front side, and not like her back side in the knot of the head-Tefillin. There, since it is below the head, it was not inside the Tefillin boxes (which indicate the *Mochin*). However, they were below, a place against the skin, so that our "cutters" <note>likely referring to the physical limits of the anatomy or the scribal process</note> would not understand it as a "Brain" for all. Nevertheless, the knot is the aspect of the "Brain of Knowledge" <note>Da'at</note> which is lower in the body. And therefore they wrote in the Zohar, Portion Phinehas, page 236: "This *Yod* is below; a hand that shall not depart at all from within the hand-Tefillin, so as not to create a separation." And all her division is in this *Yod*, as it is written in the portion *Vayechi*... and not like yesterday. And the matter is thus: that it is sustained like this, and whoever distances it remains distanced from the delight of the World to Come. As it is written: "The bosom of the righteous and the bosom of justice are all *Yod*." And such is its secret: "Justice" <note>Tzedek</note> is all *Yod*, and as mentioned above, from her form the Holy Spirit rests upon her. And to be found with the King, one who distances the delight shall not gaze upon the delight from above. And regarding this it is written: "For those who honor Me, I will honor" etc. End of quote. Therefore, one must not separate that *Yod* from it at all, for if the *Da'at* in the body is separated from her *Mochin*, it is a very, very great blemish. Therefore, they mentioned this *Yod* emphatically in the Book of the Zohar, not to disconnect it from within the hand-Tefillin, because the whole thing is the aspect of the persona of Rachel herself, except that these are "Brains" and this is "Body." This is unlike the knot of the head-Tefillin, which does not have the aspect of the *Yod* itself, but rather another persona, that of Leah. Therefore, one must separate and distance it from the head-Tefillin themselves, but in this one, there is an attachment to it through the straps alone. And this is sufficient for the wise: for the knot of the hand-Tefillin is not at all similar to the knot of the head-Tefillin. For the knot of the hand-Tefillin is also from the totality of the *Mochin* of Rachel, which is the *Da'at* of the five "Strengths" within her; and being lower in her body, it is the aspect of "Skin." But nevertheless, it is part of the totality of her *Mochin*, except that it descended below.

# Laws of Tefillin

### The Mystical Knot and the Horn of Majesty

From what our Sages, of blessed memory, said: "Both these and those are the words of the Living God" <note>A famous Talmudic phrase (Eruvin 13b) indicating that multiple valid opinions can coexist in divine truth</note>, it refers to the unification of the *Foundation* (*Yesod*) of the Father (*Abba*), which is the aspect of Moses, within the *Foundation* of the Lesser Countenance (*Zeir Anpin*). There, the 116 <note>Numerical value (Gematria) of the word "Knot" (Kesher)</note> are hardened, and there is the "Hand of Glory," which is the *Knowledge* (*Da'at*) of the Feminine (*Nukva*). This is also the secret of the "Knot of the Hand" <note>The knot on the arm-tefillin</note>, which is of blessed memory. For "the lips of the priest" <note>Malachi 2:7</note>—which is the Crown of the *Foundation* of the Father—and the *Foundation* of the Lesser Countenance "shall guard knowledge." This becomes the *Knowledge* of the Feminine, which is called *Shamir* <note>A legendary worm or stone used to cut the stones of the Temple; here used as a mystical name</note>.

Regarding what the Aramaic Translation says about the "Knot of the Tefillin," we can say that our Sages also intended the knot of the hand, which is the "Knot of Rachel" <note>Rachel represents the lower feminine divine persona</note>. Indeed, the word *Kesher* (Knot) is an acronym for "Knot of Rachel" (*Kesher Shel Rachel*). Furthermore, the "hangings" <note>The straps</note> are numerically equivalent to "These and These" <note>Referring back to the "words of the Living God"</note>. It is known that in the "Circuit" (*Galgal*), the number is 130, which is five times the name of God (26), totaling 130. This returns to the "Glory of the Divine Presence" (*Shekhinah*) as mentioned in the Translation.

And this is the secret of "And she returned to the Lord from the mountain of fruit" <note>A mystical interpretation of a verse</note>, meaning what was done for the Lesser Countenance, who is more significant than the "Mountain of Fruit." For her *Knowledge* contained 280 lights <note>The numerical value of the Hebrew letters Pe and Resh (PR)</note> which raised her upward. This is the meaning of "shining from horns" <note>A play on Psalm 69:32</note>, meaning that because of the Prophet, the depth of the "Horn" emerges. Thus, the "Oil" is higher than its power, and it is called "from horns." Because from the power of the Judgments (*Dinim*) that shine behind the Lesser Countenance—which are the power of the Mother (*Imma*)—it is called "Hoof" (*Parsah*), but the "Horn" (*Keren*) exists forever. This is the *Foundation* of Understanding (*Binah*), which is called the "World to Come." For the *Foundation* of the Lesser Countenance caused her *Knowledge* to ascend. This is the essence of what was done; the primary repair (*Tikkun*) is the connection of the *Foundation* of the Lesser Countenance with her, along with the *Foundation* of Understanding, which is called "Horn."

The reason he drew this "Horn" to her was for the sake of the "Splendor of Kindness" (*Hod ha-Chesed*), from which her *Knowledge*—called *Zor*—is derived. Since it is not in her head, it must be raised via this "Horn." As it is written, "And he saw a horn from a sign," and see there what the Sages said: "A horn for David," which also became a single horn in her forehead through the horns of the Father, Mother, and the Lesser Countenance. This is the name *Yehudah* (Judah) from "one horn." It is written "Yod-Vav-Resh," meaning the thought which is the *Foundation* of her *Knowledge*, which is from her head. Therefore, he was forced to draw a "Horn" to her, which is the "Voice of Understanding," to produce the "Horn from a sign"—meaning to raise her *Knowledge*, which is called "Horn," to her head. He drew upon her a connection of "bride" <note>original: "Kallah"</note> clothed within the *Foundation* of the Lesser Countenance. There they enter her head, as in "Horns from His hand for him, and there was the hiding of His strength" <note>Habakkuk 3:4</note>. The "Horns" are the two *Foundations* of the Father and the Lesser Countenance "from His hand," because of the letter *Yod*, which is the *Knowledge* of the Feminine...

<column-break/>

...their shoulders above their heads. This is "And she returned to the Lord from the mountain," meaning how the "Voice of Light" benefits the Kingdom (*Malkhut*), which is called "Mountain," for the Lord (the Lesser Countenance). This is what is said: "From before your face," the voice of the five "Severities" (*Gevurot*) of *Knowledge* from above, raising them to the top of his head.

This is why the "Horn" is mentioned three times. The first "Horn" was in his forehead—meaning the Kingdom, which he brought close in the secret of the union. Without the first cause from above in the Beginning, it would not have been possible to bring her close, as her *Knowledge* was below between the shoulders. To walk in this world, this *Knowledge* must be in the head. It says "one horn was in his forehead," which is the *Foundation* of the Father that spreads its "Crown" within the *Foundation* of the Lesser Countenance. This is found in the *Tikkunim* of the *Zohar Chadash* (page 33b): "One horn was in her forehead." We see that the "Horn" is where the "Oil" is placed, for through the "Oil," the *Foundations* of the Father and Mother are drawn down to the *Foundation* of the Father.

Furthermore, the square of the name *MaG* (43) is 186, and the square of *AyB* (72) is... and the "Anointing" is numerically equivalent to "Horn" (*Keren*). Below are all the "Horns of Splendor" of Moses. Therefore, "Horn" is written three times in the portion "Write for yourself these words," corresponding to the three *Foundations* of Father, Mother, and the Lesser Countenance. This is from the power of the Judgments that were in the Tefillin—the *Foundations* of Father and Mother. The boundaries ascended, which are her two aspects of *Knowledge*, to the top of her head, as mentioned in the "Secret of the Face of the Menorah," raising her lamps, which are her five "Severities" (*Gevurot*).

Thus, "one horn"—which is the *Foundation* of the Lesser Countenance—was in his forehead, clothed within her brain in the secret of "Inner Light." Likewise, in the secret of the "Surrounding Light," there was the "Square of Understanding" from the eight kings who descended behind the Lesser Countenance in the World of Action (*Asiyah*). From her "Crown" come "two straps" <note>The leather straps of the Tefillin</note>. Thus, from the "Crown of her Foundation," another height was made at the head of Rachel. The *Foundation* of Understanding is also called "Horn," as he wrote. The "Radiating Horns" are like the *Foundation* in the phrase "Horn of the Temple," or "Horn, son of oil" <note>Isaiah 5:1</note>, as mentioned in the Zohar (Portion *Lech Lecha*, page 74). This also explains the Aramaic Translation: "And strength shall be given to him," on the verse "And I will cut off all the horns," for while one looks at the Tefillin, the Glory of the Divine Presence is there...

And whoever does not rectify this <term>Knowledge (Da'at)</term> <note>Da'at refers to the unifying mental faculty in Kabbalah</note>, they will distance him from the Supernal Delight, and he will enter into the midst of the "Husks" <note>Klipot: the forces of impurity or shells that conceal divine light</note> which possess no Knowledge. For it is known that the "External Ones" <note>Chitzonim: another term for demonic or impure forces</note> have no Brain, Wisdom, Understanding, or Knowledge, as it is written regarding the verse: *Also, without knowledge, the soul is not good* <note>Proverbs 19:2</note>. Therefore, regarding this it is written: *For those who honor Me, I will honor* <note>1 Samuel 2:30</note>. The explanation is: for those who honor the Lord by binding the <term>Yod</term> <note>The small knot of the hand-tefillin representing the letter Yod</note> with the Prayer <note>Tefillah: here referring to the Tefillin themselves</note>, then I will also honor that person with the service of the World to Come. But *those who despise Me shall be lightly esteemed*; the explanation is: those who despise the Lord by failing to bind the <term>Yod</term> with the Prayer, and instead place it in a place of affliction—know that since Knowledge is cleaved to it in purity, both in prayer and in the world, it joins with the white "Secret of the Brains." Therefore, one must be very, very careful to join and tie the *Yod* to the Prayer of the hand.

->The Secret of the Strap of the Hand<-
->What is its Intention?<-

Behold, the Rabbi <note>Isaac Luria, the Ari</note>, of blessed memory, did not explicitly explain the secret of this matter. However, for all your ailments <note>a play on words regarding seeking sources</note>, from the *Tikunim* <note>Tikunei Zohar</note>, page 9, side 2, these are his words: "Three straps on the right and one on the left, etc., and the Foundation <term>Yesod</term> of the Bride takes them all and inherits them for the Daughter, and they all conclude in the secret of the verse: *under it was one horn* <note>referring to a mystical beast</note>." This is the secret of what our Rabbis taught: "The ox that Adam the First Man sacrificed had a single horn in its forehead," as it says: *And it shall please the Lord better than an ox-calf that has a horn and hoofs* <note>Psalm 69:32</note>. The word "from a horn" <note>Hebrew: *mikeren*</note> is written without the letter *Yod*, and this is the strap of the Tefillin of the Master of the Universe. These are his words. And here, in my humble opinion, there is a need to detail this passage. But first, we must detail what is found in the Chapter "The Wine of Heathens" <note>Tractate Avodah Zarah, page 8</note>: "Our Rabbis taught: The day that Adam the First Man was created, when he saw the day shortening [in winter], he said: 'Woe is me, perhaps because I have sinned, the world is darkening around me and returning to Tohu and Bohu (chaos and void), and this is the death decreed upon me from Heaven.' He sat and fasted and wept all night, and Eve wept opposite him. When the pillar of dawn rose, he said: 'It is the custom of the world.' He stood and sacrificed an ox whose horns preceded its hooves, as it is said: *It shall please the Lord better than an ox-calf that has a horn and hoofs*." And Rav Yehuda added: "The ox that Adam sacrificed had a single horn in its forehead."

<column-break/>

These are his words. Now, it is known that because of the "Evil Tongue" <note>Lashon Hara</note> of the Primordial Serpent on the day he was created, he caused the <term>Kingship (Malchut)</term> to descend below the <term>Foundation (Yesod)</term> into the "Hollows" and the "Outer Places." There she remained as a "Blue Point," and those seven upper <term>Sefirot</term> <note>Divine emanations</note> were afraid to ascend and withdraw into <term>Zeir Anpin</term> <note>The "Small Face" or masculine aspect of the divine</note> itself, as was the case during the "Diminishing of the Moon" on the fourth day of Creation. Since Adam sinned, he caused these aspects of Kingship to descend below into the "Husks," and she was at the ultimate stage of diminution. Afterward, when the first Sabbath arrived, the Female <note>Nukva/Malchut</note> returned to be rectified in all aspects, and the world stood with her "face to face" in the full measure of her stature. This is the aspect of the "Crown of Kingship" which was greater than before, as explained in the discourse on the Seven Aspects of the Female. Furthermore, he caused the <term>Knowledge (Da'at)</term> of the Male to descend between his shoulders. Similarly, the Female's Knowledge also descended between her shoulders, as is known from the discourse on the "Smallness of Adam the First Man." This explains why he sacrificed an ox whose "horns preceded its hooves," as stated in the Chapter "These are the Forbidden Animals" <note>Tractate Chullin, page 60</note>: Rabbi Joshua ben Levi said: "All the works of Creation were created in their full stature, created with their Knowledge, and created with their consent." In my humble opinion, the meaning of "with their Knowledge" refers to their stature. The intention is that while all other creatures grow their parts and limbs over time, the works of Creation were created in their full height and perfection. Just as when a horn emerges, the head comes out first, so too his height preceded his hooves; so it is found in the Midrash. The intention is that when Adam performed repentance all through the night of the Sabbath, weeping with his wife, he caused the "Fallen Parts" of the Kingship—which is her Crown that remained in the "External Places"—to ascend first in the secret of Rectification, back to back. This is the secret of "She ascended from the earth," which was the head of the World of Creation <term>Beriyah</term>. There her Crown stood beneath the Foundation of the Male, "back to back" in general. This is the secret of "the head of Creation." This is the hidden meaning of "He stood and sacrificed an ox whose horns preceded its hooves," for her seven Sefirot were still below... as she is rectified every day... as it says: *And it shall please the Lord better than an ox-calf that has a horn and hoofs*. This means he raised the details of the Kingship up to the back of the <term>Beauty (Tiferet)</term> of the Male, and he also sacrificed the Knowledge from between the shoulders...

# Laws of Tefillin

From the teachings of our Sages of blessed memory <note>original: "רז"ל"</note>, these and those are the words of the Living God <note>A reference to the Talmudic principle that differing legal opinions can both be divinely inspired</note>. The clothing of the **Foundation of Wisdom** <term>Yesod of Chokhmah: the creative channel of divine insight</term> within the **Mother** <term>Imma/Binah: the divine understanding</term> is written as "Who is like You." It falls from the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin: the emotive divine persona, often associated with the male aspect</term> and they rectify all this. The hand is like a vessel that is uncovered, and the **Female** <term>Nukva: the divine feminine persona/Shekhinah</term> enters into it to bind upon it the **Wisdom**. For I have found a nest, which is the **Crown of Foundation** <term>Atarah of Yesod</term> and **Wisdom**. And the **Small Face** can guard knowledge, for this becomes the **Knowledge of the Female** <note>original: "דעת דנוקבא"</note> which is called "Guarding" <note>original: "שמי"ר"</note>. And what our Sages of blessed memory said regarding the **Knot of the Tefillin**, one can say that our Rabbis also intended the knot of the bosom, which was the **Knot of the Merciful One** <note>original: "קשר של רחמנא"</note>. And so it was ruled that the Knot of the Merciful One—as in "And you shall see My back"—is the portion of the Merciful One. It is well known that corresponding to them, the number returns to page 8, for this is the section of "Keri" <note>referring to the Shema prayer</note>. This was for the sake of the **Divine Presence** <note>original: "שכינתא"</note> as explained in the Aramaic translation. And this is the image of the skin of the ox <note>original: "משור"</note>, meaning: what is the labor he performed for the **Small Face** that is more than an ox? The explanation is that her **Knowledge** <note>Da'at</note> contained the **Severities** <term>Gevurot: divine judgments or constraints</term> which he raised upward. This is "shining from within," meaning because the **Wisdom and Understanding** <note>Chokhmah and Binah</note> are with her, they are like oil that is hidden within, and it is explained within the Female. For the Sabbath is a crown of holiness, and all the "backwards" parts act there to shine specifically through the "spread" <note>Parsa</note> to the whole "established horn" <note>Keren Kayemet</note> within her, which is the **Foundation of the Father** <note>Yesod of Abba</note> called the "World within her." For the **Foundation of the Small Face** caused her **Knowledge** to ascend. Therefore, the essence of the labor and the primary rectification is the union of the **Foundation of the Small Face** with her, and also the **Foundation of the Female** which is called a "Horn." The reason he draws this portion of the Horn is not for the sake of a remainder from it, which is her Knowledge in the Female, for it is hidden and not broad, and it must be raised by means of the Horn. And the Horn appears as a sign; see there the Sages of the generation, for it also became a single horn in its placement through the "inner parts" of the Father and Mother and the Small Face. And the majority of its Foundation is from the Horn as it is written, meaning because of her Knowledge from which she broadened, and he was not forced to draw to her the **Horn of the Jubilee** <term>Keren HaYovel: associated with the Sephirah of Binah/Understanding</term> which is the Foundation, in order to raise the Horn from the sign—meaning to raise her Knowledge in the Female also as a broadened Horn. And so he draws to her a connection to receive the **Kingdom** <note>Malkhut</note> within the **Foundation of the Small Face**, so that it should be in the "wings" in breadth like the inner parts given to him. And also "the acquisition of His strength," meaning the inner parts which are the two Foundations of Wisdom and the Small Face from His hand, because of the strength of the desire of the **Knowledge of the Female** which she bears between the shoulders, where the five [Severities] are mixed.

<column-break/>

The shoulders above are broad, and this is "it shall please the Lord more than an ox," meaning: what is it that improves the **Kingdom** (called an "ox") for the Lord (the **Small Face**)? This is the secret of the "face from your wing," which are the five Severities of her Knowledge that were raised upward in breadth. This is the meaning of the Sages' statement regarding the **Ox that Adam the First Man sacrificed**: it had **one horn in its forehead**. This means the Kingdom, which he sacrificed as a union called "Adam" on the first Sabbath of the Work of Creation. It was possible to sacrifice it to the Lord because her Knowledge was below between the shoulders, and therefore it required elevation and the broadening of her Knowledge. And it said "it had one horn in its forehead," which is the **Foundation of the Female** that spreads from its essence within the **Foundation of the Small Face**. This is the placement of the "Head Tefillin" <note>original: "דוקר הרס"</note> on page 33; therefore it had one horn in its forehead. And that is the **Horn of the Jubilee** which draws a second horn downward, for "downward" refers to the two Foundations of the external Wisdom and Understanding, totaling 180, and the inner Foundation of Understanding is 160. These three together [are significant]. Likewise, the square of the name *SAG* is 160, and the square of *TV* is 180. He brought the numerical value of "The Horn of Moses," for in it are the "horns of majesty" of Moses. Therefore, the word "Horn" is written three times in the portion "Carve for yourself these words," corresponding to the **three Foundations of Wisdom, Understanding, and the Small Face** as mentioned below. This is the power of the second holy [compartment] of the Tefillin: the Foundations of Wisdom. And this is his [power], the Severities, which is the second [aspect] of her Knowledge [raised] upward in breadth, as mentioned in the discourse on the Menorah: "Toward the face of the Menorah shall the seven lamps cast light"—these are the five Severities of theirs. And this "one horn," which is the **Foundation of the Small Face**, was in his forehead because it was clothed within her "offering," and this was in the secret of the Inner Light. Likewise, in the secret of the **Surrounding Light**, there was a "guarding" for Understanding from the Crown—the "two thousand" that hang down at the back of the Small Face, from whose "five" <note>Gevurot</note> the **two straps** [of the Tefillin] are made. So too, from the **Crown of her Foundation** a red strap is made at the head, as mentioned here in the discourse on the Laws of the Sukkah. And the "guarding" for Understanding is also a "Horn," just as Wisdom and its light are "shining" and "horns are fixed." So too the Foundation is called "Kayan" <note>Foundation</note>. And so "Kayan" is the daughter of "Yah," as mentioned in the Zohar, portion *Lech Lecha*. Through this, one can understand what is written in the **Targum Yonatan ben Uziel** on the verse "And you shall see My back"—to him and not to [another]. And the resurrection...

And behold, it is known that when there was a deficiency in this, the two aspects of the "Head" <note>Hebrew: Gimel Rishonot (G"R), the three highest emanations</note> of Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note> descended below the Foundation <note>Yesod</note> at its back. When the aspect of the Point—which is comprised of ten—departed from there, those seventy upper emanations <note>Sefirot</note> within her did not return to ascend, depart, and hide their essence as they did during the "diminishing of the moon" on the fourth day. Because the sin of Adam caused these seventy emanations of Sovereignty to descend below into the "shells" <note>Kelipot; the forces of impurity</note>, she was in the ultimate state of final diminishment. Through this, we can understand why Adam sacrificed a bull whose horns preceded its hooves, as stated in the Talmud <note>Tractate Chullin, page 60b</note>: Rabbi Joshua ben Levi said, "All creatures of the Creation were created in their full stature, created with their full knowledge, and created in their full beauty." In my humble opinion, I will offer a partial explanation of their intent regarding "knowledge" and "stature." The meaning is that all creatures' hooves are visible with them at birth, while their horns grow later; however, the creatures of the Beginning were created in their full stature and with their horns. When it emerged from the womb with its head first, its horns preceded its hooves. So it is found in the Midrash. The meaning is that when Adam repented, he spent that entire Sabbath weeping and occupied with the Divine. He caused the "silencing" of Sovereignty—which is her Crown that remained on the outside—to ascend first in the secret of Repair <note>Tikkun</note> and return to the back. This is the meaning of "it rose from the earth," which was the head of the World of Creation <note>Olam HaBeriyah</note>. There, her Crown stood beneath the Foundation of the Small Face at his back, at the head of Creation. This is a deep matter. He sacrificed a bull whose horns preceded its hooves because her seventy emanations were still below in the Crown <note>Keter</note> until he elevated them through his prayers, just as we repair this every day, as will be written later, God willing. "And it shall please the Lord better than a horned and hooved bull" <note>Psalm 69:32</note> means that the persona of Sovereignty should ascend to the back of the "Beauty" <note>Tiferet</note> of the Small Face, and he also elevated her Knowledge from between the shoulders.

<column-break/>

...the upper ones. And one who does not repair this Knowledge, they shall distance him from the World to Come, and he will be cut off amidst the "shells" <note>Kelipot</note> which have no Knowledge. For it is known that the shells lack the "Third Brain," which is Knowledge, as it is written: "Also, a soul without knowledge is not good" <note>Proverbs 19:2</note>. Regarding this it is written: "For those who honor Me, I will honor" <note>I Samuel 2:30</note>. The explanation is: "He who honors" <note>Hebrew: Mekhabdi</note> equals the numerical value of the Hand-Tefillin <note>Yud with the Tefillah</note>; "I will honor" <note>Hebrew: Akhabed</note> equals 26 <note>The value of the Tetragrammaton</note>, meaning he will be elevated in the World to Come. "But those who despise Me shall be lightly esteemed": this refers to one who is not careful to bind the letter *Yud* with the Tefillah, and the "covering of the covered" in his eyes. This causes the Knowledge—which is for the cleaving of Israel—to remain "between the shoulders" <note>meaning it stays in a lower, displaced state</note> and it does not ascend or connect with the two brains. Therefore, measure for measure, he is "lightly esteemed" and falls among the "External Ones" <note>forces of impurity</note>. All the abundance and blessing that was fit to flow upon him is withheld, and he becomes "light" <note>Hebrew: Kal</note>, meaning seed <note>Zera</note> but not for blessing. Therefore, one must be very, very careful to connect and tie the *Yud* with the Hand-Tefillin.

### The Secret of the Hand-Strap
#### What is its meaning?
Our teacher <note>Isaac Luria, the Arizal</note>, of blessed memory, did not explain anything regarding this. However, I found in the *Tikunei Zohar* (page 9) the following: "There are three straps in the Assembly of Israel: Majesty <note>Hod</note>, and Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, etc. And the Foundation of All takes them all and gives them to the Assembly of Israel." This refers to the Assembly of Israel, the "Lower Shekhinah," which is a "Single Horn." Regarding this, the Sages established that the bull sacrificed by Adam the First Man had a single horn in its forehead, as it says: "And it shall please the Lord better than a bull... having a horn <note>Hebrew: Makrin</note> and hooves." The word "having a horn" <note>Makrin</note> is written without the letter *Yud*, and this refers to the strap of the Hand-Tefillin which gives life to the world. Thus far his words. In the *Ra'aya Mehemna* <note>The Faithful Shepherd; a section of the Zohar</note>, this passage is explained. But first, let us explain the passage in the first chapter of *Avodah Zarah* (page 8): The Sages taught: On the day Adam the First Man was created, when the sun set upon him, he said, "Woe is me! Because I have sinned, the world is darkening around me and returning to chaos and void. This is the death decreed upon me from Heaven." He sat and wept all night, and Eve wept opposite him. When the dawn broke, he said, "This is the way of the world!" He stood and sacrificed a bull whose horns preceded its hooves, as it says: "Better than a bull... having a horn and hooves." And Rabbi Judah said in the name of Samuel: The bull sacrificed by Adam the First Man had a single horn in its forehead, as it says: "Better than a bull... having a horn <note>Makrin</note> and hooves." "Having a horn" is written deficiently, lacking the letter *Yud*.

### Come and I will tell you

The Holy Spirit was not entirely removed, except to strengthen the holiness upon them. And that hair needs to be brought into our holiness, and I will deepen it with merit so that he does not prosecute us in our holiness. And it must be understood why our Sages were obligated to subdue specifically one hair of a calf in the Tefillin and not in any other commandment. All this is according to the introduction laid down by the **Ari** <note>Rabbi Isaac Luria, the preeminent 16th-century Kabbalist</note> in the discourse on "Be'alotecha," where it is his way to take the "external spirits," etc. (see there). The essence of the matter is this: the secret of this sin of the Calf is high up in the secret of the letter *Dalet* of the word *Echad* ("One"). "I have seen this people, and behold, it is a stiff-necked people" (Exodus 32:9), for their sin reached until that higher *Lamed* of *Echad* which is the Knot of the Tefillin, like a *Vav*. This is "stiff-necked," and this caused them to become a small, light point. Thus far his words; see there.

# Laws of Tefillin

The Cherubim <note>The angelic figures atop the Ark, here representing spiritual forces</note> are awakened above, surrounding the secret of the "Head." They subdue the "Mastic" <note>A reference to a harsh spiritual force or "clogging" agent</note> of the Interior and humble the "Voice." This corresponds to the two straps of the Head which are like horns fixed to a wall; opposite them, a great light is awakened above through the secret of the "Double Horn" <note>Hebrew: *Keren Pi Shenayim*</note>, for there is a double portion in his spirit. From there, all the "horns of pride" of the sons of man are broken, provided their intention is toward Heaven.

And behold, the wraps that we perform, making seven circuits with the strap upon the arm, represent the secret of the seven perfections. This is to indicate the three foundations <note>The Sefirot of Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet</note> that she <note>The Shekhinah/Malchut</note> has in her rest, which is the secret of the "Surrounding Light" made from the Horn. For her, there are seven sanctifications, as is known; therefore, there are seven sanctifications for every bride, which is the secret of the Surrounding Light that encompasses the bride, and then she is sanctified.

Afterward, when she enters within, she bestows power through the secret of the "First Foundation," which is the twenty-two letters of the foundation, as she is already within it. Sometimes the secret is in the "Beast" <note>Hebrew: *Behemah*</note> or at all times. For when we bind them with seven sanctifications, we then tie the "Hand-Tefillin," which is the secret of the binding of the Bride. Afterward, in the secret of "Falling upon the Face" <note>The Tachanun prayer</note>, which is the secret of the falling of the "Watcher" <note>An angel</note> upon his face, they are equal to the ground, which is *Malchut* (Kingship). These holy ones are engraved in union, and he bestows upon her all the abundance, as the Merciful One desires.

Now it is necessary to explain why *Malchut* is called "Square" <note>Referring to the square shape of the Tefillin boxes</note>. It is because she has the wisdom of the "Square." The name of God (*Elohim*) in a square expansion equals the numerical value of "Wisdom" (*Chokhmah*), and the name *Adonai* in a square equals "Understanding" (*Binah*). This is the power of "Knowledge" (*Da'at*). It is also the numerical value of the "Continual Burnt Offering" (*Olat Tamid*). Because she is a continual offering and does not descend—as our Sages of blessed memory said: "She rises with him and does not descend."

So too in the Chariot above: the "Lion" is on the right, which is the Higher Wisdom. The "Eagle" is the secret of the verse: "As an eagle stirs up its nest, hovers over its young." The "Man" is the secret of the Divine Name *Mah* (45). *Malchut* is the "Ox" (*Shor*), and the face of the Ox is on the left.

There are six steps to the Throne, which are the six extremities of the "Long Face" (*Arich Anpin*). The four straps are Wisdom, Understanding, Mercy, and Strength within itself. Upon the likeness of the Throne, which is long, there is a "likeness as the appearance of a Man upon it from above," which is the *Ancient of Days* who sits upon the Throne. This is the "Likeness of the Appearance of Adam" who is above all the lights.

Similarly, the Tefillin of the "Ox" (*Shor*) indicate the restoration that Ezekiel performed in *Malchut*, which is called "Ox." For when you write "Ox" (*Shor*) in its full spelling <note>Shin-Vav-Resh</note>, the filler letters equal the numerical value of "Your Covering" (*Sechach*).
