# Laws of Phylacteries

When the **Kindnesses** <note>Hebrew: *Chasadim*; the expansive, giving forces of the divine</note> spreading within reach the point of exit, they are able to pass from the mouth of the **Foundation** <note>Hebrew: *Yesod*; the procreative or channeling sephirah</note> to the outside. They can emerge through the thin veil and the secret of the Voice. Essentially, before they spread inside, since they can pass through the veil, they do not exit through the mouth of the Foundation, for then everything would exit at once. Now, the Kindnesses desire to descend to the Navel, which is the Foundation of the **Mother** <note>Hebrew: *Imma*; the sephirah of Understanding/Binah</note>, and they also desire to be with the **Severities** <note>Hebrew: *Gevurot*; the restrictive, judging forces</note> that are in the Foundation. They are able to stand opposite the "lamps of the place." Therefore, they ascend higher and higher from the **Crown** <note>Hebrew: *Atarah*; the tip of the Yesod</note> upward and encompass the Foundation of the **Father** <note>Hebrew: *Abba*; the sephirah of Wisdom/Chokhmah</note> on the outside. 

It is also written that it is "lacking and compelled" because Severity is in a state of mourning, for there is the level of "clashing," and thus it is lacking and compelled. To this, the Kindnesses respond by surrounding your Foundation. In His mercy—for in the Foundation of the **Shells** <note>Hebrew: *Kelipot*; the forces of evil/impurity</note> there is a drawn sword—the Kindnesses of the Father are also present. Everything is in the Foundation of the Father on the outside, but the Severities began to act alone.

For this reason, in the "baldness" <note>A reference to the dispute of Korah</note> of the Foundation of **Understanding** <note>Hebrew: *Binah*</note> there is also a [mark]. The reason is that within it are the 70 Kindnesses and Severities which are the 18 buildings. And so, in the foreign tongue <note>Latin/Vernacular: *massa*?</note> <note>original: "בלע"ד מחס' סנדרסט"</note> at the time in the Foundation of the Father, nothing emerged from the Kindnesses except the "smoke" alone. Therefore, there is no power in these Kindnesses to reveal themselves in the form of **Phylacteries** <note>Tefillin</note> until they enter a second time to spread from the Foundation, and also join with "friends" <note>other lights</note> a second time with "garments," and then they can act with garments in the form of the Phylacteries. 

And if you should ask and learn: since the "Navel" of the Kindnesses remained in the mouth of the Foundation, how could they be revealed properly before the Kindnesses, seeing as they block the mouth of the Foundation's receptacle? One might say that since some of the Kindnesses have already exited to the outside, the place of the Kindnesses has already been vacated. Then the Severities began to act and took it upon themselves to be revealed before the Kindnesses, and through their portion, the Kindnesses emerged.

Behold, when the **Intellects** <note>Hebrew: *Mohin*; divine consciousness</note> enter the aspect of the Father to give life, they enter with the nine branches first to the gates of the head and the palate, and then the Phylacteries can exist in the aforementioned order: **Wisdom** <note>*Chokhmah*</note>, then **Understanding** <note>*Binah*</note>, and then the **Severities** <note>*Gevurot*</note> inside the Foundation. This is the reason for the existence of the bread <note>original: "בלחמס"</note> to hang Understanding and Severity. After the Severities emerged to make a place for the Kindnesses to enter the Foundation, those which were initially encompassing on the outside now enter the place they left, into the inner Crown of the Foundation, and ascend upward.

<column-break/>

They enter the Foundation a second time, and then they return and are able—a second time in an open place—to protrude outward as mentioned. After the Severities emerged, therefore the section of **"Hear, O Israel"** <note>The *Shema* prayer</note> comes after the section of **"And it shall come to pass if you surely listen"** <note>*Vehaya Im Shamoa*</note>. 

And if you should ask and learn: why were the Kindnesses not able to rest before the Severities? Behold, they also preceded the aspect of the Foundation of the Father and were encompassing the Foundation. Why were they forced to enter the Foundation a second time? This was caused by the fact that the Severities preceded them in being revealed. The matter is that it is impossible to be revealed outside in a resting state unless they are clothed in their "garment." <note>The spiritual "clothing" allows the light to be channeled without consuming the recipient.</note> This is the aspect of their "seals" upon the Phylacteries on the outside. Therefore, they had to enter inside so they could exit with garments. 

The reason for this is that one could say this is the time of the beginning of their entry. But after the aspect of the Phylacteries has already emerged to the outside, it is not so. However, when they descend and spread into the "Legs" <note>Hebrew: *Netzach, Hod, Yesod*</note> of the Father further down, those same Intellects are constantly spreading. As is known, in every moment the flow of the Intellects is drawn from the Father and Mother to the **Small Face** <note>Hebrew: *Zeir Anpin*; the emotional sephirot</note>. Through the special, constant "smoke-column" <note>connection</note>, they spread to provide. For first the Severities enter and exit to the outside, and afterward the Kindnesses enter inside the Foundation, reversing what was at the beginning.

Thus has been explained the difference between the opinion of **Rashi** and the opinion of **Rabbeinu Tam** regarding the Phylacteries. <note>A famous legal and mystical dispute regarding the order of the parchment scrolls inside the Tefillin boxes.</note> In all other details they are equal, as noted in the legal decisors and the *Beit Yosef* (Chapter 34). Through this, you will understand what is written in all of the *Zohar* and the *Tikunim*: that the Phylacteries of the Living God Himself are from the "Side of the World to Come." Because they come from the Intellects of the "Great Mother," their level is higher than the Understanding called the "World to Come." These are His Phylacteries, for they are above her. 

And this is what is meant by: "The righteous sit with their crowns on their heads." For as you know, the "Crown of Kindness" includes both the "Weight" and the "Smallness." Likewise, there are the five Severities of the Foundation, and they are called "Righteous" <note>Hebrew: *Tzadikim*; associated with the sephirah of Yesod</note>, and they are the section of *Shema*. There are "Foundational Righteous" who have no [light] in their crown, yet "their crowns are on their heads," for the **Kingdom** <note>Hebrew: *Malkhut*</note> is also called "Crown," as is known. She ascends to the river, which is the aspect of *Malkhut*. Thus also the Crown is established above their heads in the section of "And it shall come to pass if..."

# Laws of Tefillin

It is necessary to generalize the matter.
**The matter** is as follows: it has been explained by us that there are "Brains" <note>Hebrew: *Mohin*; refers to divine intellectual energies or consciousness</note> for the Head of the Lesser Countenance <note>Hebrew: *Zeir Anpin*; the aspect of the Divine that interacts with our world</note> from the side of the Father <note>Aramaic: *Abba*; the Sephirah of Wisdom/Chokhmah</note> and from the side of the Mother <note>Aramaic: *Imma*; the Sephirah of Understanding/Binah</note>. Behold, the Brains of the Mother constitute the Tefillin according to the opinion of Rashi <note>original: "R.S." referring to Rabbi Shlomo Yitzchaki</note>, of blessed memory, and the Brains of the Father constitute the Tefillin according to the opinion of Rabbeinu Tam <note>original: "R.T." referring to Rabbi Jacob Tam</note>, of blessed memory. Now, what is the difference between them? Know that the Foundation <note>Hebrew: *Yesod*; the channel of transmission</note> of the Mother is wide, and therefore there is room within it to receive the essence of the Two Crowns: Kindness and Strength <note>Hebrew: *Chesed* and *Gevurah*</note>. In this manner, the law of Kindness is from all the *Pasis* <note>A technical kabbalistic term for a specific divine name or configuration</note> and the law of Strength is from all the *Laor*. Behold, the Foundation of the Father separates between the two and decides between them, for it is placed within the Foundation of the Mother. The Head-Tefillin are as mentioned above, where the [energies] of the Mother enter first... and afterward the Foundation within it splits, which is Strength. These emerge in the Brains during the Afternoon Prayer <note>Hebrew: *Mincha*</note> of the Lesser Countenance. From the portion emerges Wisdom and the worlds of Creation, Formation, and Action of Understanding. Afterward, the Kindness is exempt from the *Pasis* and the Strength is exempt from the *Laor*. These are all the sections according to the order of Rashi's opinion.

**However**, in the Tefillin of the Brains of the Father, the Kindnesses and Strengths that enter are able to stand together within the Foundation, which is very narrow. Therefore, at the beginning of the entry, the Crown of Kindnesses is within it first, as it is larger than the Crown of Strengths. When the Crown of Strengths enters, it pushes the law of Kindnesses outward through the mouth of the Foundation. However, the matter is not quite so, for the length of the Foundation of the Father ends exactly at the end of the Foundation of the Lesser Countenance. If so, it is impossible for the Kindnesses to exit outside but rather within the Lesser Countenance itself. The matter is that now, like the five intentions of the Father, the Foundation of the Father is within the Head of the Lesser Countenance. These begin to emerge outward in the level of the Tefillin. But afterward, when the entire Foundation has entered, the matter is no longer as defined.

**Also another matter**: behold, there they spread out and touch until the Crown of the Foundation of the Father. Behold, in that place, there are two skins of the Foundation. But in its Crown, there is only one alone, and this is the secret mentioned above, where the outer skin is already cut away on a weekday... and therefore when it reaches.

<column-break/>

And the [Evil Inclination] has no dominion to turn aside at all... and therefore there is no permission to place a blemish in it—until Death is swallowed up forever and all the "Husks" <note>Hebrew: *Kelipot*; forces of impurity or concealment</note> are nullified from the world. Then, on that day, "The Lord shall be one and His name one." This is the secret of this great thing.
**The four sections in the Tefillin are mutually dependent** <note>Meaning if one is missing or invalid, the whole set is invalid</note>.
The explanation is that even if one letter [is missing], the intention is because the four sections in the Tefillin are the four Brains of the Lesser Countenance. If one Brain is missing, it is impossible to create the aspect of Tefillin for the Lesser Countenance. Also, the four sections correspond to the Brains of the Mother, which also have four fillings [of the Divine Name]. These are: one filled with the letter *Yod*, one filled with *Aleph*, and one filled with *Heh*. These four correspond to the four [sections of] Tefillin. If one section is missing, it is like a bald spot in the aspect of Tefillin, for the number of the Tefillin would not be complete. Therefore, they are mutually dependent, and this is their order:

-> Aleph Heh Yod | Aleph Heh Yod <-
-> Aleph Ha Yod | Aleph Heh Yod <-

-> And they equal the numerical value of "Tefillin": <-

### The Tefillin of Rabbeinu Tam
**And of Rashi, and what is the difference between them? One must wear two pairs together according to both of their opinions, for both are the words of the Living God and they do not truly disagree.**

**Know** that both opinions are true, as it is written in the chapter *HaMotzi Tefillin* [of the Talmud], page 24b: Rabbi Samuel bar Isaac said, "There is room on the head to place two [pairs of] Tefillin." Here too, there is room on the arm fit to place two Tefillin. So it is mentioned in the *Book of Tikunim* <note>Tikunei HaZohar</note>, page 100b and page 78, that the place is wide. So it is mentioned in several places, including the Section of Phinehas, page 238b: He said, "Woe to the world to come where the Divine Names are in abundance," etc. And therefore...

# Laws of Phylacteries

The primary location [for the Tefillin] is placed upon the site of His awesome glory itself, known to the Sages of Rectification <note>Kabbalists who focus on "Tikkun" or spiritual restoration</note> who sanctify it above all else. This is the fitting place for its awesomeness, as seen in the portion of *Mishpatim* <note>Exodus 21-24</note>. So too wrote Rabbi Menahem Azariah of Fano <note>A prominent 16th-century Italian Kabbalist</note>, may his memory be a blessing for the life of the world to come, in his work *Yonat Elem* and in his Responsa, section 100. Likewise, in a German Responsa, it is written and supported that it is good to don both pairs at once. The Rosh <note>Rabbi Asher ben Jehiel, c. 1250–1327</note> also wrote to make two pairs of Tefillin, as did the *Sefer Mitzvot Gadol* (SMaG), the *Beit Yosef*, and the *Terumah*. The SMaG and the *Terumah* further noted that if one does not know how to precisely align the location to wear both together, he should follow the words of the Rama of Fano: first the hand-tefillin and then the head-tefillin, then remove them immediately and don the other pair based on the first blessing, etc. (see Section 34). This is a strict requirement since the Rav <note>likely Isaac Luria, the Ari</note> and the Maharshal explained to us the secret of wearing two pairs together as mentioned later. Therefore, according to the aforementioned decisors like the Rosh, one is directed to wear two pairs together, and not one after the other as the *Beit Yosef* wrote in Section 34 in the name of a German Responsa. The Rama of Fano wrote similarly in Section 110. Based on these words, there is a straight path before him to satisfy any doubt. This is achieved by writing two [sections] in one script, and he can wear them without doubt. One should place two *Totafot* <note>Biblical term for Tefillin</note> one on top of the other on the head, wearing them beneath [the hair/covering]. One should not fear the appearance of "haughtiness" <note>Hebrew: *Yuhara*; acting with visible piety that exceeds one's spiritual level</note>, for there is no concern regarding Rabbinic decrees here, similar to the law of a towel in a Sukka, and it is not a mockery; rather, a person is simply seeking to satisfy the doubt regarding the blessing. Thus far his words. According to the Zohar, portion *Vayeira*, page 30: "Father and Mother <note>Aramaic: *Abba* and *Imma*; Kabbalistic emanations (Sefirot) of Wisdom and Understanding</note> are in unity, in a joy that is never separated. These are the hidden thoughts that emerge in the call and rest in the word. Whoever creates a separation between this one and that one, it would be better for him had he not been created, for he has no portion in the Holy Faith." <note>original: "דאבא ואימא אינון באחדותא... ולית ליה חולקא במהימנותא קדישא"</note> Until here is the discourse. The Tefillin of Rabbenu Tam (R"T) correspond to the "Father" (*Abba*) and the Tefillin of Rashi correspond to the "Mother" (*Imma*). Therefore, one must be very careful not to create a separation between them by wearing them one after the other, for certainly a person who does this "cuts the shoots" <note>a metaphor for heresy or spiritual damage</note> and causes a great blemish between Father and Mother. From here we are disciplined: Rashi's alone are the Tefillin of the Mother, and [wearing only them] would be a terrible blemish, as explained in the *Discourse on the Wings*. The essence of the matter is that when the "Mentalities" (*Mohin*) of the Small Face <note>Zeir Anpin; the emotional attributes of the Divine</note> depart from the side of the Father during the descent, they are included in the Small Face, causing the determination of the "Horse to Life"...

<column-break/>

...the aspects of the Events and the Strengths (*Gevurot*) below are Goodness and Kindness, specifically between Father and Mother. All the Sages are like the Tefillin of Rabbenu Tam. It appears that the Strengths of the union of Wisdom (*Chokhmah*) and the inheritance of the Kingdom (*Malkhut*) via the path of unification for Wisdom and the Kindness of the place... as the way of the firstborn mentioned here: "And to Joseph is your hope." Therefore, it does not diminish below, but rather they ascend and soothe the union with good fortune. "Open rebuke" refers to the revealed Strengths, which come from "hidden love," which are the Events that are hidden within and are not recognized except at the end of the union... when he finds a resting place... not the way for the sickness of the Small Face within the body of the Small Face. There he encounters the union of Wisdom and brings out the Events of the union to take them outside the body. First, the Strengths must emerge from within, which are the coverings of the union, and she requires the knot of Understanding (*Binah*). Afterward, he brings the Events into her through the "wheels" of the body, and they all enter into Jacob in the aspect of Rabbenu Tam's Tefillin from the lower Wisdom, then on the head, then the revealed ones, and then the Events. It turns out that Jacob also has the aspect of Tefillin on his forehead, and they use the prayer of the hand of Rabbenu Tam on the arm... And if the Lord places there all the "Perfect" (*Tam*) which are the Tefillin of Rabbenu Tam belonging to Jacob... one also needs to tie the connection on your second hand, which are the hand-Tefillin of Rashi. From here it is hinted that it is correct to wear two pairs on the hand as well.

# Laws of Tefillin

Below in the world of Formation <note>Hebrew: *Yetzirah*</note>, she has a portion through her clothing at night in the secret of the <insert>garment</insert>... in the Discourse on the Nesting and the Curtain, see there. And therefore they sent to bless <note>A reference to a Talmudic phrase regarding the transmission of mystical secrets</note>. A woman of valor was always crowned with nine for each side... and they are not always crowned and rising to the man, but rather a portion of the foundations to nourish him, for she was crowned by her husband.

Furthermore, as mentioned above, power was given as known in the Discourse of the *Lamed-Aleph* <note>Referring to the Name of God, *El*</note>, for the **Wisdom** of *Mah* <note>The Divine Name associated with the number 45</note> precedes the **Understanding** of *Ban* <note>The Divine Name associated with the number 52</note>, and these are the five cycles for the **Crown** of *Ban*. And it is known that the Crown of *Ban* is more significant than the Wisdom of *Mah*, as we find regarding the verse: *A woman of valor is the crown of her husband* <note>Proverbs 12:4</note>, because she is the Crown of *Ban*. And this is the intent of the Zohar on Portion *Phinehas*, page 248, see there. However, in the "World to Come" <note>Hebrew: *Alma d'Atei*, referring to the higher realm of Understanding/Binah</note>, which is the Wisdom of *Mah* that exists above, for there the righteous sit with the crowns of the Wisdom of *Mah* on their heads, which are the Crown of *Ban*. And therefore, in the world of Wisdom itself, it is called the "World to Come" in the secret of another sphere.

And one must understand the reason why Wisdom is called the "World to Come," which is also explained in the Discourse of *A"K* <note>Adam Kadmon, the Primordial Man</note>. For Wisdom and Understanding each took their male counterpart; Understanding of *Mah*—meaning that Wisdom took the five upper spheres of Understanding of *Mah*, and Understanding took the five lower spheres of Understanding of *Mah*. As we find, Wisdom was worthy of taking its own portion and also the five upper parts of Understanding of *Mah*, and therefore Wisdom is called the "World to Come" regarding the Understanding of *Ban*.

And we can also say what is written in the Zohar: "But in the World to Come, the radiance is above." This refers to the secret of the sphere of Kindness <note>Hebrew: *Chesed*</note>, for when these five spheres stand above at the head, then she is a crown for him in the aspect of the **Tefillin**, which are specifically the feminine "surroundings" <note>Hebrew: *Makkifin*</note> that precede his own Kindness. And this is "in the World to Come the radiance is above," meaning specifically at the time when the Foundation and Wisdom are still clothed within the World to Come; there specifically the radiance is above, and those Severities <note>Hebrew: *Gevurot*</note> emerge in the strength of the Tefillin before the Kindnesses. But after the expansion into the body of the Small Face <note>Hebrew: *Zeir Anpin*</note> and the Foundation of *Ban*, it is revealed outside to the Foundation of the Mother <note>Hebrew: *Imma*</note>; then the qualities are reversed, for the Kindnesses are exchanged and sweetened with the Severities, and afterward the Severities and those details are like those of the Mother. And now, according to this thought, one must understand how it is possible to make Tefillin for the Head and the Hand below in the Female of the Small Face...

<column-break/>

If "to hear" <note>Hebrew: *Shemua*</note> was above the "hearing," as written in the *Tikunim* <note>Tikunei HaZohar</note>, for the crown for the Female was below the navel in this world, which is the world of the Small Face, and the Intellects <note>Hebrew: *Chabad* - Wisdom, Understanding, Knowledge</note> enter... and these will be clarified. It turns out that the Tefillin of the Intellects of the Father <note>Hebrew: *Abba*</note> hint at the existences which are the permutations of the Name *Y-H-H-V*, and the Tefillin of the Intellects of the Mother are the permutations of the Name *Y-H-V-H*, as mentioned in the Zohar and the *Tikunim*.

**He gave strength** to the Mother... it was said there that in the World to Come, the radiance is above. But the Tefillin of the Head are the Intellects of the Father; how can they be called "Tefillin of the World to Come"? One can say that since in the Tefillin of the Head, the Crown of Severity is more significant than the Crown of Kindness, and the "lower ones" are crowns for their masters, therefore even though the Tefillin are from Wisdom (which are greater in their level), they are nevertheless called by the name "Tefillin of the World to Come" because the Female rules over the Male. But in this world, the masculine aspects rule over the feminine, for the Crown of Kindnesses is a crown for the females, and she is crowned by her husband.

And this is what is said at the beginning of the portion on Manna: *A woman of valor is the crown of her husband.* Rabbi Judah said: "The husband is crowned by her, and she is crowned by the husband," etc. The intention is that she is the Severities of the Understanding of the World to Come, and the males are the Kindnesses of the Small Face. And those who merit to take the Tefillin of the Head are crowned with the surroundings which are the "crown on their heads." And this is "the husband is crowned by her." But nevertheless, one can understand that specifically at the time when she was in the secret of his head, she was in the power of the Severities of Understanding, and she was in his power of the Kindnesses of Wisdom; then it was appropriate for the husband to be crowned by her. But after the five Kindnesses and five Severities expanded below into the Small Face... as it says in the portion *Behalotecha*, she was intended to be crowned by her husband. Nevertheless, since the Foundation of the Father sucks from the garment of the Kingdom of Understanding which covers the Foundation of the Father, therefore she was not crowned by her husband. And this is the secret of what the Rabbis said: "A person should always be careful of his wife's honor," for the action in her is from Understanding, and therefore the Foundation of the Father is revealed...

And the cycle of eighteen <note>numerical value of the Hebrew word 'Chai' (Life)</note> leads to life. However, there are three "Lives" corresponding to them: the good ones which originate from the Wisdom-Understanding-Knowledge <note>Chabad</note> of Understanding <note>Binah</note>. For the numerical value of Chabad is "Life" <note>Chai/חיים</note> when calculated in its back-filling form. Likewise, in the Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, there are ten sefirot and three "Lives." It spreads forth from the voice of Knowledge, which is the Foundation of Understanding. Then, "everyone written for life in Jerusalem" <note>Isaiah 4:3</note> refers to the attribute of the Foundation of the Kingdom.

### The Early Pious Ones Did Not Neglect the M commandment of
### Phylacteries <note>Tefillin</note>
all day long. Therefore, every person must be careful with them and intend to wear them all day. Regarding the intention of the secret: know that in every single prayer, the "Mentalities" <note>Mochin/Divine Intellect</note> depart from the Small Face and Feminine <note>Zun/The lower sefirot</note>, and they return and are diminished. It is for this reason that the prayers were established, for those very same Mentalities are what return to the Holy Presence <note>the Shekhinah</note> in the aspect of Mentalities during the next prayer, and so it continues always in every single prayer. There are those who say the matter is not so, but rather in every single prayer, entirely new Mentalities are cycled through. There is no prayer that does not have a new light and new illuminations that were never present before. You must know that there is a great difference between a weekday prayer and the prayer of the New Moon <note>Rosh Chodesh</note>, or between the prayers of the Festivals, the Intermediate Days of the Festival, and the Sabbath. Greater still, even within the same day there is a difference; the prayer of Passover is not like the prayer of Shavuot or Sukkot, etc. Greater still, even on weekdays themselves, the prayer of one day is not like the prayer of the next day or the day before. Greatest of all are the three daily prayers; there is a great difference between them, and the Morning Prayer <note>Shacharit</note> is not like the Afternoon Prayer <note>Mincha</note> or the Evening Prayer <note>Arvit</note>. For there is no prayer from the day the world was created until the future to come that is identical

<column-break/>

to its fellow at all. The reason for this is that we have already explained that all prayers are intended to refine the "Refinements" <note>Berurim/sparks of holiness</note> that were within those Ten Kings who died <note>a reference to the kabbalistic "Breaking of the Vessels"</note>, as will be explained later. Behold, every day and in every prayer, new refinements and sparks are refined that have never been refined until now. Just as the refinements refined in each prayer are not like the refinements that ascended in the morning—for those first refinements were already refined in the first prayer—so in the next prayer, other holy refinements are refined and rectified, and they are not the first ones themselves. Consequently, according to the value of the sparks refined in that prayer, such will be the value of the Mentalities drawn down into them from that which is above them. The same applies to the drawing down of lights during the Recitation of the Shema <note>Kriat Shema</note>, for no Shema is identical to another for the aforementioned reason. This is the reason we were commanded to pray constantly three times a day, and they are called "the times of the day." If one neglects one of them, it is said of him: "That which is crooked cannot be made straight" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:15</note>. This is because in every prayer and every Shema, new refinements are made and new Mentalities are bestowed from above, the likes of which were never made in any other prayer or Shema. However, regarding the general aspects, we have already explained in their place that all Morning Prayers of all weekdays are equal in their general intention. All weekday Afternoon Prayers are equal, and all weekday Evening Prayers are equal. All Sabbath prayers are equal, and all Sabbath Morning Prayers are equal, and so too with all other prayers. The same applies to the Shema; all weekday morning Shemas are equal, and all weekday evening Shemas are equal, etc. However, in their specific details, the aspect of these Mentalities is not like those, and these refinements are not like any Morning Prayer since the day the world was created. In truth, in every prayer, new Mentalities and new refinements come, and after the prayer, they return and are adorned by them. With this, understand and be enlightened, my son.

# Laws of Tefillin

The "Mentalities" <note>Hebrew: *Moachin*; refers to the divine intellectual energies or "brains" that animate the spiritual worlds</note> are the secrets of the faith. They are compared to the blue thread of the fringes <note>tzitzit</note>, which represents the completion of the garment. For when the Supernal Mentalities depart, God forbid, it causes death. This is the meaning of the verse: *“They die, but not in wisdom”* <note>Job 4:21</note>, for the power of death exists where there is a lack of Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note>, which are the Mentalities. As it is written: *“Wisdom gives life to those who possess it”* <note>Ecclesiastes 7:12</note>. When it departs, death is present, which is the opposite of the "Torah of Life." Since sleep is also a state where the Mentalities of Wisdom depart, it is therefore mixed with a taste of death. These are the words of the Sage. One can also explain the verse at the beginning of page 84a.

---

## Anyone who dons Tefillin prolongs their days, as it is said:
## "O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit; 
## so wilt Thou recover me, and make me to live" <note>Isaiah 38:16</note>;

The interpretation of "recover me" is "strengthen me." The intention is that one who dons the Head-Tefillin, which represent the aspect of the "Six Directions" <note>the emotional attributes of the divine personification known as Zeir Anpin</note>, also merits length of days. For it is said of them, "by these they shall live." It is known what the Rabbi <note>likely Isaac Luria, the Ari</note>, of blessed memory, wrote on the verse *“If You, Lord, should mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?”* <note>Psalm 130:3</note>. The secret of the word "Who" <note>Hebrew: Mi</note> refers to the two qualities of mercy found in the "Beard" of the *Arich Anpin* <note>The "Long Face" or Infinitely Patient aspect of God</note>. It is known that the Beard does not cover the "Wisdom and Understanding" <note>Chokhmah and Binah</note> because it clothes the "Arms" of the Long Face. From there, life and sustenance are inherited for all worlds, as it is said: "Children, life, and sustenance do not depend on merit, but on the Constellation <note>Hebrew: Mazla; referring to the flows of the Divine Beard</note>."

It is known from the Rabbi that the "Strap" of the Tefillin and the internal Mentalities of the Tefillin come from the union of the two "Constellations" of the Beard. This is the meaning of the verse "By these they shall live"—meaning through the Tefillin. The numerical value of "The Lord" <note>Adonai</note> filled out with its letters, plus the collective, equals the value of "Life" <note>Chaim</note>. All vitality comes from these two Constellations. Wisdom is called "Life," and the word "From-them" <note>Mekhem</note> has the numerical value of "Life" <note>72</note>, as it is written, "Wisdom gives life to its possessor." Understanding <note>Binah</note> is called the "Living God." Therefore, the Tefillin are called the "Life of the King" because they come from the Constellation upon which life depends. This is why "anyone who dons Tefillin prolongs his days," because they derive from the Beard of the Long Face, which represents "Length of Days." The verse "and in all these things is the life of my spirit" refers to the souls within the Tefillin...

<column-break/>

...the secret of the "Life of the King." Through the Mentalities given to the "Small Face" <note>Zeir Anpin</note> via the Tefillin, strength and delightful honor are granted to him from God. "And Thou wilt recover me" means You shall reward me and strengthen me, and "make me to live" means my heart will be influenced by long life. Therefore, he is "long of days." This is why it says "By these they shall live"—the plural "these" refers to the two main sources of vitality: the Mentalities of Wisdom and Understanding. Without these in the Tefillin, there would be a great lack in the Small Face. Therefore, every day at the morning prayer, one should intend to merit the "Length of Days" from the Long Face.

### An Additional Heap <note>A supplementary teaching</note>

<margin>
It is known that there are three fillings of the name *Ehyeh* <note>I Will Be</note> in the aspect of "Life."
</margin>
The filling of the name with the letter *Yod* in Understanding is for life. The filling with *Aleph* in Majesty <note>Hod</note> is for life. The filling with *Heh* in Foundation <note>Yesod</note> is the secret of the "Assembly." When you calculate the square of the name *Ehyeh* <note>A kabbalistic method of expanding a name</note>... <note>The text here follows complex Gematria/numerology involving the names of God and their squared values to reach the numerical value of "Life" (18 or 68 depending on the system)</note>... subtract 166 and "Life" <note>Chaim</note> remains. Similarly, with the other fillings, after subtractions, the remainder is always the numerical value of "Life."

It is known that all these names come from the secret of the "Backwards" <note>the hidden or diminished light</note>. Therefore, these three names that emerge from the "Life" of the square are their "Backs." This was hinted at in the Talmudic chapter *Arvei Pesachim* <note>The last chapter of Tractate Pesachim</note> regarding the "Life of the Archangels" and the "Life of the Sages." The "Merciful Ones" receive their life from the Crown of Life, which is Wisdom, called "Complete Mercy." The "Angry Ones" receive their life from the Majesty of Life, which is the Understanding of the Small Face, where judgments are awakened. The "Sages" receive life from the Foundation of Understanding, called "Knowledge" <note>Da'at</note>. Thus, these are the three types of life. Their life is "Life" because the flow reaches them through the "Backwards" as mentioned above.

# Laws of Tefillin

The lights that belong to the "Endurance, Victory, and Foundation" <note>Hebrew: *Netzach, Hod, Yesod* (NHY)—the lower three emotional attributes of the divine structure</note> of her Wisdom <note>The feminine aspect of the divine, often associated with the Shekhinah</note> are drawn through our actions. The "Intellects of Nursing" <note>*Mohin de-Yenikah*—a stage of spiritual development likened to infancy/nursing</note> for the entire "Impression" <note>*Reshimu*—the spiritual trace or residue left behind after a light departs</note> of those lower attributes do not remain within the *Zeir Anpin* <note>Literally "Small Face"—the central masculine aspect of the divine in Kabbalah, representing the emotional attributes</note> except through our efforts. Even after the introduction of the "Sweetening," the Impression of "Greatness" <note>*Gadlut*—the mature state of consciousness</note> remains for the Wisdom and Understanding and the Intellects of Nursing. Then, only the Impression of the Intellects of Nursing remains during the Evening Prayer. After the Evening Prayer, even that Impression of the Intellects of Nursing departs, and nothing remains in the *Zeir Anpin* except the inner essence of the "Smallness" <note>*Katnut*—the immature or diminished state of consciousness</note> of the Wisdom and Understanding. These never depart from the *Zeir Anpin*, whether by day or by night, so that he may be found blessed <note>original: *la-ishtakhacha berich*</note> and have vitality within the Intellects in order to exist. For the Intellects are the vitality and existence of man, as mentioned in the introduction to the 160 Gates. The sum of the inner Intellects of "Smallness" remains, but its "Surrounding Lights" <note>*Makifim*—transcendent lights that hover over a person rather than entering them</note> and the Surrounding Lights of the "Smallness" of their Wisdom and Understanding depart from the *Zeir Anpin* at night, just as the Intellects of "Greatness" depart during the day. However, everything follows the specific times. These five [lights] always remain because the *Zeir Anpin* needs them; they are the Intellects of "Smallness" which are at the level of the "Soul" <note>*Nefesh*—the lowest level of the soul</note> called *Malchut* (Kingship). He is always called by this name alone. They were in the "Endurance and Victory" <note>*Netzach* and *Hod*</note> in a hidden way within the interior of the *Zeir Anpin* called "Heaven," and they never depart from him. Even the Intellects that follow the inner ones after the completion of the prayer depart from her and ascend on high, and all her [stature] is in the aspect of Surrounding Lights; nothing remains in her but their Impression. Through that Impression, she also remains in her state of "Greatness" throughout the entire day. Thus, we find that after every prayer, when the Intellects depart from the Holy Name and are diminished as mentioned, it does not mean a total diminution where it returns to the state of the letters *Yod-He* <note>A partial form of the Divine Name</note> as it was before the prayer. For it is known that the Divine Presence (*Shekhinah*) is in her state of "Greatness" all day, only that their Intellects are in the name *Yah-Kahu* <note>A specific mystical permutation</note> and their Impression remains within her, with the Surrounding Lights in their state of Greatness. This departure of the essence of the Intellects is what we meant above by saying they are diminished after every prayer—and all of this applies during the day. However, once the day sets and it becomes night, then even that aforementioned Impression departs and returns after the Evening Prayer to its place. The Impression of the Intellects of *Zeir Anpin* returns to the level of Surrounding Lights. These were the inner Intellects for his vitality that ascended during the Morning Prayer and completed her stature as Surrounding Lights for the rest of the day; they

<column-break/>

now ascend even higher and surround his vitality. Those that were in the aspect of Surrounding Lights during the prayer itself have now ascended even higher. All the levels above them continue to ascend, level by level, as mentioned. Then the Impression of the "Female" <note>*Nukva*—the feminine counterpart to *Zeir Anpin*</note> departs in the manner mentioned. Thus, she is diminished to her true measure, and this is what is meant by "diminished and becomes like the letters *Yod-He* alone," returning to the secret of the "Holy Point." This is the difference between the diminution of the day and the diminution of the night. Through this, it will be explained why the time for Tefillin is the entire day in general: since throughout the day there is an Impression of the Intellects within the "Father" <note>*Abba*—the attribute of Wisdom</note> and the "Son and Daughter" <note>*Zon*—the union of *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*</note>, therefore the Tefillin are linked to them. From the power of that Impression, the Tefillin draw their nourishment, as will be explained later. But at night, when the Impression of the Intellects for the "Son and Daughter" departs, it is no longer the time for Tefillin, neither for the masculine nor the feminine aspect. There is, however, a difference between the time of prayer and the rest of the day: during the time of prayer, there are actual, complete Intellects in the "Head" and the "Son and Daughter," therefore the primary commandment of Tefillin is then. But during the rest of the day, when the Tefillin only function through the power of the Impression, the Tefillin are not as strong or "good" as they are during the time of prayer.

->Nathan <note>Likely the scribe or a student, Nathan Adler or similar</note>: It seems to me that this is the secret of what the Sages said in the Talmud, Tractate Menachot, page 36a:<-

>Until when may one wear them? Until the sun sets. Rabbi Jacob says: Until people stop walking in the marketplace. And the Sages say: Until the time of sleep.

One should examine what they are arguing about. We can say that each Master said one thing and they do not actually disagree. The first Tanna <note>A teacher from the Mishnaic period</note> holds that as long as the Impression of the Intellects is within the "Son and Daughter," it is the time for putting on Tefillin. When even their Impression departs—which is the secret of the "Setting of the Sun"—the Intellects of *Zeir Anpin* are gathered in. The "Sun" refers to the Intellects surrounding her, which is called "Sun" in the aspect of the Talmudic statement (Berakhot 17) regarding the Sun and Moon, referring to the Higher and Lower Worlds. But according to the Rashal <note>Rabbi Solomon Luria</note>, any evening hour from when the day fades is called "Sunset," meaning the Impression of *Zeir Anpin* departs and enters into the "Foundation of Understanding" <note>*Yesod de-Binah*</note> which is called "Sunken," for the Foundation is the carrier for all...

For when there are the "Brains of Greatness" <note>Hebrew: *mochin de-gadlut*, referring to expanded states of consciousness or divine intellect</note> which are the conclusion of the commandments, they are aligned with the aforementioned in the secret of the "Brains of Suckling" <note>Hebrew: *mochin de-yanika*, referring to immature or diminished divine states</note> in the order of *Zun* <note>An acronym for *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*, the male and female divine personas in Kabbalah</note> all day long, as mentioned in the mystical intentions of the *Kaddish* over the Torah scroll. And "Great and sanctified be His great name" <note>The opening of the Kaddish prayer</note> which contains the numerical value of 156 <note>The value of the name *Yosef*, associated with the sefirah of *Yesod* (Foundation)</note> along with the Foundation. One who wears Tefillin all day causes the "Remnant" <note>Hebrew: *Reshimu*, the lingering impression or trace of light left behind after the main light departs</note> of Greatness and the being of the Brains to be drawn toward Kindness, as our Master <note>Likely referring to Rabbi Isaac Luria, the Ari</note> of blessed memory did (and so he was careful).

## Why the Sages of blessed memory said: Night is not the time for Tefillin

And why between Sukkot and Hanukkah does the Foundation also remain as it is, covered during the time of prayer? The reason is explained in our mystical intentions: for the "Brains of Greatness" that arrive during each and every prayer depart after the conclusion of the prayer. In the subsequent prayer, the Brains return to be sanctified; if so, where did the previous Brains depart to, and what became of them? Know regarding this matter that after the conclusion of prayer, the Brains depart from within *Zun* to the secret places and ascend upward to the Head, and there they become a category of "Surrounding Light" <note>Hebrew: *Makkif*, light that is too intense to be internalized and instead hovers around the vessel</note>. These Surrounding Brains—the first and higher ones—also depart and ascend even higher than their place, because those Internal Brains that just departed have now ascended and taken their place. They were thus forced to make room for them and ascend higher still. In this manner, the other levels ascend higher and higher until it is impossible to explain their details now—where each and every level ascends. However, we have already explained elsewhere that anything holy and merciful, even though it departs from its place, its "Remnant" <note>*Reshimu*</note> always remains in its place. It is found, then, that even these Brains—meaning the internal ones that depart from their place as mentioned and ascend in the secret of Surrounding Lights—nevertheless leave behind "Majesty and Splendor" <note>Hebrew: *Hod ve-Hadar*</note>. Thus, all day long it is in the secret of "Forever, O Lord, Your word stands firm in the heavens" <note>Psalm 119:89</note>. By means of that Remnant of the Brains that remains within, even if they are not [fully] radiant Brains, it nevertheless remains within and does not falter despite our exile all day long. (It appears above in the name of the *Kavannot* <note>Mystical Intentions</note>: and this is so, for during the day after prayer the Brains of the "Nest" depart, and nothing remains in *Zeir* <note>The Microprosopus/Small Face</note> because no Remnant was left).

<column-break/>

## One [hour] after prayer and one hour [before] prayer:

The reason for this is because before the Temple was destroyed, there was no separation between *Zun* <note>The male and female divine aspects</note>; they were always "face to face" and their union never ceased. We almost had no need to pray then, for they lacked nothing and did not require our prayer to draw Brains to *Zun* for a face-to-face union, as the Brains never departed from them—as our Teacher wrote in the appropriate place. However, after the Temple was destroyed due to our sins, the Brains departed from *Zun*. Therefore, we must pray constantly every day to return the Brains to their place so that *Zun* may unite. In truth, after the conclusion of prayer, the Brains return to their state of departure and the matter reverts to how it was. Therefore, the "Early Pious Ones" <note>Hebrew: *Chassidim HaRishonim*, refers to a group of ancient saints mentioned in the Mishnah</note> would not go immediately to their homes after they prayed. Instead, they would tarry there one hour after the prayer so that by singing and adding strength above, the Brains would not depart quickly, and those Brains would linger for a moment for *Zun* one extra time after the prayer. This is also the reason why the Early Pious Ones would pray a "Voluntary Prayer" <note>Hebrew: *Tefillat Nedavah*</note> during the blessing "Who hears the voice," in order to bring back the Brains once more while they were still present, as the Sages of blessed memory said.

## Would that a person could pray all day long

This is also the reason for what the Sages of blessed memory said, that the Early Pious Ones did not remove Tefillin from themselves all day long. The matter is to cause strength above so that the Upper Brains of *Zeir Anpin* <note>The "Small Face" or emotive sefirot</note> would linger all day long. This is what the Sages meant when they said that the hands of our Master <note>Moses</note> were not spread for more than three hours <note>A reference to the battle with Amalek</note>, for it is impossible to do so for more than sixteen hours; all this is explained. For this reason, the *Ram* <note>Likely Rabbi Moshe Cordovero or Rabbi Moshe Zakuto</note> of blessed memory wrote that when it says one who wears Tefillin all day causes the Brains to be "watered" all day, the intention is the "Remnant of Greatness." For regarding the Brains themselves, he already said there is no power to water them for more than sixteen hours, as even with our Teacher <note>Moses</note>, peace be upon him, his hands were only spread for sixteen hours. (And perhaps we can understand through this what the *Remaz* <note>Rabbi Moshe Zakuto</note> of blessed memory said: that one who dons them upon his "Sanctity of Greatness" increases the Remnant of the Brains of Greatness).

Upon entering, etc. And what is written: "Behold, the internal and surrounding lights of the 'Small State' <note>Hebrew: *Katnut*; refers to a diminished spiritual consciousness</note>." Afterwards, those "Brains" depart from *Zeir Anpin* and remain over him as "Children" in the mystery of the Surrounding Light. This is the meaning of their entering into the Female; these are the "Brains" of the "Small State" of the "Great State" of the Mother that enter during the Bedtime Shema, and afterwards at the time of sleep, they depart from him as mentioned. And behold, one who intends to be careful with Tefillin all night in order to guard the "Brains" so they do not flee—meaning they should not depart entirely, but rather remain in the mystery of the Surrounding Light and be in the mystery of the Female—and also the "Impression" of the "Brains" will shine, which was the letter *He*. It is the "Impression" of the four internal "Brains" of the "Small State" of the "Great State." And now at night, the letter *He* shines in her more than during the day. This is why he said "to guard them" (*Le-Shamran*), for the letters of *L-Sh-M-R* <note>לשמר</note> mean the Name (*Shem*) that he intends for the elevation of the *He*, so that it will always be on his head all night until the dawn. As mentioned, he is permitted to wear them. And with this, what our Sages of blessed memory said is answered. These are their words: Rav Joseph said, "I was sitting before Rav Huna; he brought Tefillin and I saw him wearing them. I said to him, 'Does the Master see them as being for guarding?' He said to me, 'Yes.' And I saw his mind was that it was not for guarding he wanted them, but he held: The law is so, but we do not instruct the public accordingly." The reason is that since all aspects of the four "Brains" that were the letter *He* shine in the Female, and also at night more than the day, it is therefore also appropriate to wear Tefillin all night as mentioned. But we do not instruct the public so, because that part is only the aspect of the "Lyre" of the Tefillin, and not like the "Taking" which were the aspect of the four sections of the Tefillin. Therefore, we do not instruct the law to wear Tefillin at night because of the "Brains" in the Female. Rather, night is not the time for Tefillin, since all the "Brains" have departed from *Zeir Anpin*, which is the primary time for Tefillin, as mentioned above.

# Laws of Tefillin

But the light for the afternoon prayer is sunken into the *Nofekh* <note>A precious stone, often associated with the tribe of Judah or specific mystical emanations</note> in the secret of the branches of the depths, etc. Therefore, when the sun sets, one should no longer say the mouth is "crowned" with Tefillin. Thus, it is forbidden to don them <unclear>missing text</unclear> and for the law:

**Rabbi Eliezer says: Anyone who dons Tefillin after sunset violates a positive commandment, and Rabbi Yochanan says: He violates a negative commandment.**

And they do not actually disagree, for "these and those are the words of the Living God," as it is known that in the secret of the 248 <note>The number of positive commandments, corresponding to spiritual "limbs"</note> they are rectified, and all 365 <note>The number of negative commandments, corresponding to spiritual "sinews"</note> are hidden. And it is known that the External Forces <note>The *Chitzonim* or "Other Side," representing forces of impurity or judgment</note> are a tablet for the Torah, for the expansion of Knowledge (*Da'at*) rests upon them. As it is written: "He who increases knowledge increases sorrow" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:18</note>, meaning whoever continues to expand Knowledge during the exile of his people increases the sorrow of the other External Forces within them, for there is no sorrow like this sorrow. Therefore, one who dons Tefillin after sunset causes the expansion of the "Mentalities" (*Mohin*) <note>Divine intellectual energies</note> to return to the hair within the Countenance. It is taught by our Sages of blessed memory that this "awakens the serpents" <note>The External Forces</note> because through Knowledge, the "City" is revealed in the aspect of the life-force of the External Forces. Since he was adding Knowledge to enter the City at an improper time—after everything has already departed and every place is filled with the collection of Judgments—therefore, because he causes the External Forces to be rectified through Knowledge, he violates a **positive commandment**. And because he causes their life-force to be hidden within Knowledge, he violates a **negative commandment**.

And since it is known that one must always fear the hidden External Forces more than those that are revealed, as with the "Fullness of Wisdom," it is therefore written as a negative commandment in the explicit verse: "And you shall keep this statute in its season from year to year" <note>Exodus 13:10</note>—"days" and not "nights." And wherever it is said "Observe," "Lest," or "Do not," it is nothing other than a negative commandment. The Torah warned about the negative commandment more than the positive because the External Forces are nourished more by the "Gevurot" <note>Divine Attributes of Severity/Judgment</note> as is known.

And the law follows the First Tanna <note>The first anonymous teacher in a Mishnaic text</note> as written in the Tosafot <note>Medieval commentaries on the Talmud</note> on page 30b, that Rabbi Jacob believes [one may wear them] "until the foot ceases from the market," which is the point of sunset until an hour into the night. So wrote the Rosh and the Rif, etc. In truth, at the time of the evening, the *Reshimu* <note>The "Impression" or spiritual residue left behind after light departs</note> departs entirely, even after the Evening Prayer (*Arvit*), as mentioned by the Rav. And the phrase "until the foot ceases from the market" uses the language of "habitual sin" (*hergel hapesha*), because the 248 [limbs] are the foundations of the exile in the worlds of Creation, Formation, and Action. As is known, "foot and foot" indicates the Impression of the exile

which is accustomed all day to cast them down, etc. And it is known that there is power in the Holy Side like "legs" that flow <unclear>text</unclear>. And "foot and foot" <note>original: "רגל ורגל"</note>... for this is the son of your thigh and the end of the building. And the phrase "until the foot ceases from the market" means the Impression is completely removed. This occurs after the Evening Prayer; while the Evening Prayer is being said, the Impression still exists as mentioned.

And we can say "until the foot (*Regel*) ceases from the market" means when you subtract the numerical value of *Regel* (233) from the numerical value of *Shuk* ("Market" - 406), there remains the value of *Ekev* ("Heel" - 172) with the collective unit. This is the number of the two names of *Shakai* <note>Divine name associated with protection and boundaries</note> of the "Smallness" (*Katnut*) of the life-force that always remains in him, etc., and never departs. And this is the verse: "I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes always, even unto the end (*Ekev*)" <note>Psalm 119:112</note>. The two names of *Shakai*, which are the internal Mentalities of the "Smallness" of the life-force, remain forever in the "City," and that is the life-force of the External Forces within them in the secret of "and you shall bruise his heel (*Ekev*)" <note>Genesis 3:15</note>.

As long as the number of *Regel* has not ceased—which is the aspect of the Impression—one should not let the Mentalities remain for "impregnation" alone, for then there is no life-force for the External Forces in the secret of Knowledge. Therefore, for one hour into the night, it is permitted to don Tefillin, until after the Evening Prayer. For through the Evening Prayer, the internal and encompassing lights enter into the "Smallness," and there is no fear of causing life-force to the External Forces, for it is still the "Grace of the Night" and the External Forces have not yet taken dominion. They have not yet been prepared to rule, for until then it was "Day," which is Kindness and Mercy.

But after the "foot ceases from the market" and the internal Mentalities of the "Smallness" of the life-force have departed—which are the two names of *Shakai* called *Ekev*—then it is forbidden to don them. Therefore, Rav Chisda and Rabbah bar Rav Huna would remove them at the time of the Evening Prayer for the reason mentioned above. But the law is not so, for one must distance a person from transgression so as not to cause nourishment to the External Forces, Heaven forbid. And the Sages who speak of the time of night do so because they hold that as long as people are still walking about, the Impression still exists, and until that time it is permitted to don Tefillin. And this is [explained] in the intentions of the bedtime Shema, for through the intention of the Shema or by the "Flash" <note>original: "הברקה" - likely referring to a sudden spiritual illumination</note>...

# The Laws of Tefillin

The matter of the Tefillin is that they are formed from the entire aspect of the "Point" of **Rachel** <note>In Kabbalah, Rachel represents the revealed aspect of the Shekhinah or the feminine Divine presence (Malchut)</note>, whose entire being is placed "upon your arm." Furthermore, this Point is like a form of writing on the left arm of Zeir Anpin from the outside. When this Point is there, her impressions emerge from within the heart of Zeir Anpin and enter into that Point while she is in a state of union with him upon his arm. It is through that impression that the Point gains the status of "Mentalities." Then, when that impression enters into that Point, that Point is called the **Tefillin of the Hand** (*Tefillah shel Yad*). For that Point is bound to the left arm of Zeir Anpin at the place of the **bicep** (*Kiboret*), because it is opposite the heart of Zeir Anpin, in order to receive her impression which is contained there in the heart. This is the secret of the impression and the standing in the union of the Tefillin. It is as if, in relation to Zeir Anpin himself, they are Tefillin on his arm and upon his heart, but from the aspect of the Female, they are her Tefillin. In this way, the apparent contradictions in the words of the **Zohar** <note>The foundational work of Jewish mysticism</note> are explained—whether they are Tefillin on the arm of Zeir Anpin or the Tefillin of the Bride. Both are true. It is as if this Tefillin of the Hand is a complete Tefillin, just like the Tefillin of the Head of Zeir Anpin. Through this, you will understand why women are exempt from wearing Tefillin on their heads and are not like the Sage <note>referring to the male obligation</note>. The matter is that these aspects of the Tefillin of the Hand are the aspect of that Point bound to the left arm of Zeir Anpin; she is not yet a full "Personification" (*Partzuf*) and her impressions cannot yet be fully discerned. Therefore, it is appropriate to represent her in the "Houses" <note>the leather boxes of the Tefillin</note> themselves, which represent the binding of that Point with him on the arm through that impression. All of this is because of his love for her. Thus: "Set me as a seal upon your arm," because "love is as strong as death."

# Laws of Tefillin

As explained in the reasons provided by the <term>Holy Master<note>Likely referring to Isaac Luria, the Ari</note></term>, and these are his words: When the back of the neck is upon her in the days with her daughters, he brought [forth], and Rachel is equal in her height to the five <note>referring to the five levels of the soul or dimensions</note> of the height of the <term>Female [Nukva]<note>The feminine aspect of the divine</note></term>. Her <term>Intellects [Mohin]<note>Divine consciousness or mental energies</note></term> she acquired through [him], and furthermore her husband. However, the height of her mother, the <term>Intellects [Mohin]</term> of Kingship [Malchut] are within the Crown [Keter] of the <term>Secret Degrees [D.S.]</term> and honored. And her husband aroused the height of his intellects through the <term>Curtain [Parsa]</term> that is within the Crown of the <term>Female [Nukva]</term>; they divide, and this is called "the two great lights." And where do they break through? This is the general rule. End of quote.

If so, it is found that the connection of Leah is also revealed in the mouth of the <term>Female [Nukva]</term> of Rachel. If so, she also possesses the principle of "the Torah of the Lord in your mouth," and through this, she should have been obligated in Tefillin. 

But the answer is in a different manner: since the primary expression of the <term>Intellects [Mohin]</term> outward in their placement is through the "hollow line" of the <term>Trachea [Koneh de-Tarya]<note>A kabbalistic anatomical term for the channel of divine flow</note></term> and the artery in general. This is the case whether according to the <term>Secret Head [R.L.]</term> or the <term>Internal Head [R.S.]</term> in the <term>Lower Tikkun</term>—from behind and not from within. Therefore, even though she has the Torah in her mouth, she nevertheless does not possess the aspect of the <term>Trachea [Koneh de-Tarya]</term> that can strike her artery so that these <term>Intellects [Mohin]</term> of the <term>Secret Degrees [D.S.]</term> may emerge, which is the intention of the "houses" (boxes) of the Tefillin.

And this distinction exists in the aspect of the Tefillin that she bore at the time she stood behind the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]<note>The masculine divine persona</note></term> through the line of the <term>Trachea [Koneh de-Tarya]</term> of the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]</term>. Even though the Torah is afterwards within the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]</term>, nevertheless, when that "impression" of the Tefillin remains in its place as well, it is not nullified from her until the night, as mentioned above. 

And since she does not have the Tefillin of the "back" aspect there, nor the "front" aspect of Israel striking from within her—because she lacks the <term>Trachea [Koneh de-Tarya]</term>—therefore women are exempt from Tefillin. 

And Michal, daughter of Saul, [wore] Tefillin and would recite the blessing <note>A famous Talmudic reference to King Saul's daughter wearing Tefillin</note>; twice she has the "Torah of the Lord in your mouth" as mentioned above. 

Also, do not challenge me regarding the time when Leah is in the secret of the "back" and grows great at night throughout the length of the city; if so, she also has the "Torah of the Lord in your mouth." And she also has the <term>Trachea [Koneh de-Tarya]</term> for the <term>Secret Degrees [D.S.]</term> that could strike her artery. 

One may say: according to what you were taught above, why is a minor exempt from Tefillin? It is because during the "smallness" [Katnut] of the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]</term>, the line of the <term>Trachea [Koneh de-Tarya]</term> does not reach the artery of the knot. At night as well, the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]</term> returns to the state of "smallness." Even though Leah grows throughout the entire length of the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]</term>, because he is "small," the line of the <term>Trachea [Koneh de-Tarya]</term> does not reach the <term>Secret Degrees [D.S.]</term> in her artery. Furthermore, the night is not the time for Tefillin; therefore, women are exempt from Tefillin.

<column-break/>

After the fact, if one does not have the head-tefillin before him, or the hand-tefillin, etc. Even if he were a wise man who is unable to place both, and therefore prays to place only one—this is forbidden. For it is written in the Torah: "And it shall be for a sign upon your hand and for frontlets between your eyes." And in the tractate Menachot, page 38, it is taught as one. Therefore, women are exempt from Tefillin.

There is a second reason based on the support of the <term>Rabbi [Isaac Luria], of blessed memory</term>, on the verse: "The Torah of Your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver," for she is the foundation for Wisdom [Chokhmah] and the acquisition of Torah. Because the throat is a narrow place and the vertebrae surround it, the lights emerge through the mouth by way of the "breach" which is the foundation for Wisdom, due to the abundance of light within it. This also causes the breaching of the artery from the abundance of lights in a narrow place. Therefore, the exit of the mouth is in this place, which caused the opening of the artery by the aforementioned lights.

And with this, what is written in the Mechilta <note>An ancient legal commentary on Exodus</note> will be answered:

> "And it shall be to you for a sign upon your hand and for a memorial between your eyes, so that the Torah of the Lord may be in your mouth," etc.
> One might think that Tefillin should also be practiced by women as they are by men?
> The Torah teaches: "So that the Torah of the Lord may be in your mouth"—
> I have only said this for one who is obligated in the study of Torah.
> From here they said: Everyone is obligated in Tefillin except for women and slaves.

The intention is that because the essence of the <term>Intellects [Mohin]</term> are revealed within the mouth of the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]</term> and emerge outward in the aspect of Tefillin, and through the abundance of the aforementioned lights they are revealed within the mouth of the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]</term>—which is the foundation for Wisdom and is called "Torah"—therefore males are obligated in Tefillin. 

But the <term>Female [Nukva]</term>, for all her Tefillin, she only receives from the illumination of the Wisdom of the Lord and all the nourishment, and they are not from the essence of the <term>Intellects [Mohin]</term> themselves as they are for the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]</term>. Just as the place itself is weak above, even though the Tefillin of Jacob and Rachel do not come from the <term>Intellects [Mohin]</term> themselves, but only in a general sense that there are such intellects.

And since Leah does not possess the <term>Intellects [Mohin]</term> herself, therefore the Torah is not revealed in her mouth. Thus, she is exempt from engaging in Torah and exempt from Tefillin, since the Torah is only revealed in the mouth of the <term>Small Face [Zeir Anpin]</term>. This is precisely what is meant by "so that the Torah of the Lord may be in **your** mouth" <note>referring to the masculine "your"</note> and not in her mouth. And do not challenge me from what the Rabbi wrote regarding Leah...

# Laws of Tefillin

When we know that a person has only one [box], whether for the head or for the arm, etc., <note>referring to the legal debate on whether one should wear only one if the pair is incomplete</note> it applies to one who is already wearing his ritual fringe garment and fulfilling all the commandments he is obligated in. ## Another Second Reason

Based on what the Master <note>Rabbi Isaac Luria, the "Ari," of blessed memory</note> wrote on the verse: *“The law of Your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver”* <note>Psalm 119:72</note>, which is the foundation for the Wisdom of the Morning <note>Boker/Morning refers to a specific spiritual emanation</note>. And this is the meaning of: *“And the Torah of Truth was in their mouth.”*

> **“And it shall be for a sign upon your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, so that the Torah of the Lord may be in your mouth...”** <note>Exodus 13:9</note>. Therefore, males are obligated in Tefillin. But regarding the female aspect, Rachel, her Tefillin do not receive the "Milk" <note>spiritual nourishment</note> from the lack of the "House of Wisdom," and in order for them to live from the essence of the Brains like the *Zeir*... just as the heart itself is hardened above. Even though the Tefillin of Jacob and Rachel are not vessels from their own essence, nevertheless, in their value they are like the 153 Brains. And since the "Virgin" <note>the feminine aspect in a specific state</note> does not possess the Brains themselves, therefore [the Torah] is not revealed within her mouth. Consequently, she is exempt from engaging in Torah study and exempt from Tefillin, since the Torah is revealed to them in the Mouth of *Zeir*. This is why the text specifies *“so that the Torah of the Lord may be in your mouth”* [masculine] and not in *her* mouth. And do not question me from what the Master, of blessed memory, wrote:

...as the placement of the disturbing [force] of this... when the skin is exposed in women with their difficult feminine aspects. And Heaven forbid, for she only received the aspect of Tefillin when she stood behind the *Zeir Anpin* through the striking power of the *Zeir*. And even though the Torah is [revealed] in the face of *Zeir*, nevertheless in all that remaining time the impression of the Tefillin remains in place as well and is not nullified from her until the night/morning above.

And since today she does not have the Tefillin of the "diminished" aspect, but only the aspect of the Face of Rachel... because she lacks the striking power of the back of the neck, therefore she is exempt from Tefillin. And as for what was said regarding Michal the daughter of King Saul <note>who famously wore Tefillin</note> that she would hear a Heavenly Voice, it was because she recognized that at times she *did* have the Torah of the Lord in her mouth as mentioned. Also, do not question me regarding the time when the secret is revealed through the Voice to the outside and is revealed along the entire length of *Zeir*, for then she also has the Torah of the Lord in her mouth. And she also has the striking power of the back of the neck. One can say that according to what we translated above—why a minor is exempt from Tefillin—it is because during the "Smallness" <note>Katnut</note> of *Zeir*, the striking power does not reach the end of the *Zeir*. And at night, *Zeir* also returns to the state of Smallness. Even though she takes [light] along the whole length of *Zeir*, nevertheless because of the lack at the end of the "Smallness," the striking power does not reach her neck. For this reason, night is not a time for Tefillin, and therefore women are exempt from Tefillin.

# Laws of Tefillin

In the *Tikunim* of the Zohar, page 37, column 2:
"In Hanukkah <note>The text uses Hanukkah as a mnemonic or mystical reference here</note>, this is Wisdom (*Chokhmah*), 'Sanctify to me' [Exodus 13:2]; and this is the letter *Yod*. Understanding (*Binah*) is 'And it shall be when He brings you' [Exodus 13:11]; and this is the letter *Heh*. 'Hear O Israel' [Deuteronomy 6:4] corresponds to Understanding; and this is the letter *Vav*. 'And it shall be if you diligently hearken' [Deuteronomy 11:13] corresponds to Beauty (*Tiferet*); and this is the letter *Heh*." And in the incense of the Tabernacles they are included. And when the Tefillin of the head and the hand are included in Him, they are called "Tefillin," and in Him they are the commandments of the New Moon. One must not separate them, as the Sages established: "What is the law regarding the interval between one Tefillah and the other? It is a transgression in his hand" <note>original: "עבירה היא בידו" - a Talmudic phrase meaning he has committed a sin by speaking between placing the hand-tefillin and the head-tefillin</note>. They called out and read concerning this from the Gemara. And those who treat them as two separate commandments follow the Jerusalem Talmud; from their right and their left, there the faces are divided. Because from the side of the Right and the Left it is closed outside, one needs to recite two blessings over them: "to bind the Tefillin" on the hand, and "concerning the commandment of Tefillin" on the head. But Heaven forbid <note>original: "חס וחס"</note> regarding the houses <note>the compartments of the Tefillin</note>; one blesses two on the head for each side. Regarding the Middle Column <note>The Sefirah of Tiferet, which balances Right and Left</note>, it is said of you "One," male of God, and one needs only a single blessing, for "I called them as one." And Heaven forbid there be an interruption between the Tefillah of the hand and the Tefillah of the head, for like the Middle Column, he would be bringing a "transgression of a carved image" between them. Because of this, "it is a transgression in his hand" and not a commandment. There is no transgression except death, as it is said: "Her feet go down to death" [Proverbs 5:5], of which it is said "for death shall separate between us." ## Commentary
The meaning is that to the Right belongs the "High Priest of Righteousness" <note>original: "כהן צדק עילאה"</note>, which is His Kingdom (*Malkhut*). And it is written "His strength—these are the Tefillin of the head," for the Higher Understanding (*Binah*) is like a crown, the Tefillin on His head. In this, he relies on his life from what is written: "And the Shekhinah of His strength." It was meant to say that the voice and merit in the heights of the heavens—meaning in the arm of His strength—is weighed like Might (*Gevurah*) to your uniqueness. And she is in the city for his head. And from her place, the Tefillah of the hand prevents the head, and the head-tefillin prevents the hand, for each one is a "rest" unto itself. The explanation: the Tefillin of the Master, which are "Existences in a whisper," are called from the side of the World to Come. The intention is "Voice," as the Sages of blessed memory said: "In the World to Come there is no eating or drinking, but the righteous sit with their crowns on their heads" [Berakhot 17a]. The explanation: the "side" of those souls of the righteous that come from the side of Understanding (*Binah*) alone have no power to make the union of Wisdom and Understanding (*Chokhmah* and *Binah*) which stands in the secret of Understanding, as it is said: "Eat, friends" [Song of Songs 5:1]. Likewise, they have no power to make the union for the Holy One Blessed be He in the secret of Beauty (*Tiferet*), as it is said: "Drink and be drunk, beloveds" below. As known in the secret of the portion *Vayikra* (page 73), since there is an advantage to the Female, they have no created power to make the union. Rather, the righteous sit in the secret of the "Spirit of the Right" which is called "sitting righteous," according to their prior state. And they merit, as it were, those "crowns on their heads," which are the crowns of the Foundations (*Yesodot*) of the Right, which are like a binding to the Female. As he merited, so is the crown he merited. So these Foundations of the crowns of the righteous—Understanding is recognizable in them from their crowns. For there is no "arousal" in them that is recognizable... and on Yom Kippur they merit "use" <note>likely referring to marital intimacy/union in a mystical sense</note> almost in the secret of the "Building" for the union... it is not accepted there.
