# Laws of the Mezuzah

The following appeared <note>original: "Sela," likely a reference to a specific authority or mnemonic</note> and in the section regarding the handful of meal-offering <note>Talmudic reference: Menachot, Chapter "Ha-Kometz"</note>:
**The Exilarch <note>The political head of the Jewish community in Babylon</note> built a house and said to**
**Rav Nachman: "Affix a mezuzah for me." He replied: "Hang it**
->**like a bolt first."**<-
The explanation is that the "help from below" is within his domain, and it is written "like a satyr."
**And so wrote Maimonides:** for the primary reason is missing there.
The name *Shaddai* <note>Almighty</note> is revealed outward through the back of the *Zeir Anpin* <note>The "Small Face" or emotive attributes of God in Kabbalah</note> in order to guard the "Image" and the "Bride" <note>The Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note> so that the "External Forces" <note>Evil or chaotic spiritual forces</note> do not gaze upon them too much, but only enough for their basic vitality.
And it is known regarding the intention of the letter *Dalet* in the word *Echad* <note>"One" from the Shema</note> that it is large and contains "death" <note>or "extension"</note> for the Head and for the Bride. For *Echad* is called "Seven" because it emerges corresponding to the four brains of *Zeir Anpin* itself. It is "Man" and "Thickness" which rise as a distinct persona like Rachel. Similarly, Rachel is called *Dalet* because she has nothing of her own <note>The letter Dalet is associated with the word "Dal" meaning poor/empty</note> except through her husband, *Zeir Anpin*.
She also stands against the seven lower emanations. This is hinted at in the name *Shaddai* as an acronym for "Guardian of the Doors of Israel." This refers to the two doors that cover the "Splendor" <note>The Sephirah of Hod</note> called Israel, which are Leah and Rachel. For Leah covers him from his head to the navel, and Rachel covers him from the navel to the end of his feet—then he is the "Guardian of the Doors of Israel." Understand this.
And it is known, as written above, that between the legs of Leah and the Crown of Rachel is the place of the female "External Forces," as mentioned above, which are Balaam and Balak. Therefore, the two "Foundations" <note>Yesodot</note> of Father and Mother are revealed there to drive them away. We have already said that when Rachel rises behind the *Aleph*, she knocks on the doors of "Beauty" <note>Tiferet</note> of *Zeir Anpin*. Then it is said of her: "And Rachel entered the mouth of the abyss," which are the "minority of many," namely two. These correspond to the two Foundations of Father and Mother, which are called *Antipsistos* <note>original: "אנטיפסיסטוס," a Greek-derived term likely meaning "opposite" or "placed against"</note> in the sense of "one facing the other." Then she is girded in the hundred, like one who gazes at the stroll of the "Daughter of the Priest," as if looking at her nakedness.
Because there, the face of the "Mother" <note>Binah</note> is revealed in the heels of "Man." This is the Mezuzah in *Zeir Anpin*: the *Dalet* in the lower back, as written in the secret of the names *Mah* and *Kuv*. The grace of the Lord is in the filling of *Shaddai*, as there are three "heels" to indicate the essence of the "He." The foundation of the Mezuzah is to guard the heels of Leah which clothe the head of Rachel from the power of the female External Forces, according to the teachings of the Rabbi <note>Isaac Luria, the Arizal</note> of blessed memory. This is the meaning of "And you shall write them upon the doorposts (*mezuzot*)," being written as *mezuzat* in the full spelling...

<column-break/>

Our Rabbis taught before us: because of the secret of the Kingship <note>Malchut</note>, they are the secret of the two Foundations of Father and Mother. They are called "of the bone." Since the foundation of the Father is within the foundation of the Mother and is not seen except as a blemish of Kindness <note>Chesed</note>, therefore they hinted in the vision before him at Kindness alone.

# The Mezuzah must be placed lying down
## Its length across the width of the doorpost

**The hint** for this is that the word *Mezuzat* in the *Atbash* cipher <note>A substitution cipher where A=Z, B=Y, etc.</note> is *Ya'af-Ayin*, which relates to the secret of "lying down."
And its "standing" is "lying down"—meaning the Mezuzah, in whatever manner it is, should have a "lying" aspect. This refers to one who places the Mezuzah's length across the width of the doorpost, which is the opinion of **Rabbeinu Tam** and his hint.
And "its standing" refers to if it is upright and erect, meaning the length of the Mezuzah follows the length of the doorpost, as is the opinion of **Rashi** and **Maimonides**. See the gloss: "I see all of them and their intentions are good," but those who are meticulous will act according to **Nachmanides**, who wrote in the book *Shoshan Sodot* <note>"Rose of Secrets"</note>: If the Mezuzah were standing—that is, along the length of the doorpost—all the people of the house would be obligated to stand on their feet all day.
Therefore, one must place the Mezuzah lying down, as is also the opinion of **Rabbeinu Tam**. One should intend that the "drop" of the word *Echad* <note>One</note> in it should face the public domain, and the last "drop" of *Shema Yisrael* should face the inside of the house; so wrote **Rabbeinu Tam**.
It appears that the Rash <note>Rabbi Samson of Sens</note> and Nachmanides aimed for the depth of the vitality... as seen in the Talmud regarding the Mezuzah... one within the measure until the end of his foot. And see there the first two... within the three heads of the *Zeir Anpin*. And the three middle joints... within the three of *Zeir*. And the three lower joints... and this is "lying down" while "standing upright."
The secret of "our lying down" is in the secret of a dream. As written here, she stands on her feet, as it is said of her soul: the secret of her lying down is her length across the width of the doorpost. Then the face of the Foundation of Mother is inward, and the "standing" is as mentioned above. What was said regarding the Foundation of Mother corresponds to the back of *Zeir*.
And it is known regarding what the Rabbi <note>the Arizal</note> of blessed memory wrote concerning the intention of the Tefillin... the knots stand on the side of the face of the Foundation of Mother **and the Severities** <note>Gevurot</note>.

# Laws of the Mezuzah

### The reason why one should not add more than two portions to the Mezuzah, which are "Hear [O Israel]" and "And it shall come to pass if you surely listen":

Behold, it is known that the two portions contained in the Mezuzah are the portion of *Shema* <note>Deuteronomy 6:4-9</note>, which corresponds to the *Chesed* (Loving-kindness) of *Da'at* (Knowledge); and the portion of *Ve-hayah im shamoa* <note>Deuteronomy 11:13-21</note>, which corresponds to the *Gevurah* (Might/Severity) of *Da'at* of *Zeir Anpin* <term>Zeir Anpin: The "Small Face" or Microprosopus, representing the six emotional attributes of the divine</term>, the secret of the *Yesod* (Foundation) of *Binah* (Understanding), which contains these two portions. Furthermore, from what the Rabbi <note>Referring to Isaac Luria, the Ari</note>, of blessed memory, wrote in the *Gate of Principles* (*Sha'ar Ha-Kelalim*), and these are his words: "The letter *Shin* of *Yesod* is composed of *Chasadim* (Kindnesses) and *Gevurot* (Severities) in this manner: the letter *Yod* represents the Kindnesses of *Da'at* itself. The letter *Heh* represents the five Kindnesses that spread through the body of *Zeir Anpin*. The letter *Vav* is the *Yesod* of *Zeir* called *Yod*, and the essence of its name is established by the five Severities in the body..." <note>The text here uses complex letter-permutations to explain how the Divine Name Tetragrammaton (Y-H-V-H) distributes divine energy</note> "...to show that they are for the need of the *Malchut* (Kingship/Sovereignty) and are deposited within it, in the *Yesod*. The final letter *Heh* of the Name *Havayah* <note>The Tetragrammaton</note> represents the five Severities... the first *Heh* are the five Kindnesses spreading in the body of *Zeir*. The second *Vav* are the Severities sent to the *Da'at* above and spread after the Kindnesses in order to sweeten them. And the final *Heh* is the *Yesod* as mentioned, where the five Kindnesses and five Severities descend together." Thus far his words. And from this introduction, one can understand what is written: "The Name *Havayah* is within," the secret of the *Aleph*. This means that the two portions, *Shema* and *Ve-hayah im shamoa*, contain the Kindnesses and Severities and are the aspect of a single Name *Havayah* when written inside the Mezuzah. However, the name *Shaddai* <note>Almighty</note> is "from without." The intention is as written above: that the letter *Shin* of *Shaddai* is the form of three *Vavs* which correspond to *Binah*... representing Fear, Might, and Kindness... thus the letter *Shin* hints at the Kindnesses and Severities written inside within the two portions. And these Kindnesses and Severities themselves are the 22 letters <note>The Hebrew Alphabet</note> which are the "Final Letters" (*Mantze-pach*), the form of the embryo... and since these three Names together equal the numerical value of 22, therefore one must make:

<column-break/>

<margin>Exactly 22 lines in the Mezuzah and no more; and so wrote the Perisha, of blessed memory, and the Rif, and the SeMag, according to this order.</margin>

### To write 22 lines in the Mezuzah

We find that the early commentators wrote to write 22 lines in the Mezuzah, and their intention was the secret mentioned above. This is the meaning of "*Shaddai* from without"—meaning everything hinted at in the portions from within is hinted at by the name *Shaddai* which is on the outside. This is the secret in the *Tikunim* <note>The Tikunei Zohar</note>... the secret of the *Yesod* of *Binah*, for *Malchut* is within the *Yesod* of *Binah*. There, too, are the Names from within and *Shaddai* from without, and both are revealed together when they emerge outside the wall. This is because the *Yesod* of the male has within it Kindnesses and Severities... and *Shaddai* from without, which are three letters, the three *Vavs* of the letter *Shin*, which contains the 22 letters mentioned... for the shape of the *Shin* is three *Vavs* and a *Yod*, totaling 22. And the *Yesod* of the female is clothed within the *Yesod* of *Binah*... <note>The text continues with highly technical anatomical-spiritual metaphors regarding the union of divine attributes</note> ...explained as Kindness and Severities called "two arms," and the *Da'at* which decides between them in the aspect of *Tiferet* (Beauty), which unites Kindness and Severity together in the body... and this is the Queen together... the "D" is the *Shechinah* (Divine Presence), meaning the "Doorposts" (*Mezuzot*) of your house... and it is called *Malchut-Shechinah*... the *Yesod* of the female which is in Jacob, the secret of the "Door" of the soul and the *Yesod* of *Binah*, and from the right it is placed outward and clothed within the *Yesod* of *Zeir*. Thus, the name *Shaddai* hints at the two Foundations revealed in the secret of the Mezuzah. And this is the secret of "And you shall write them upon the doorposts (*Mezuzot*) of your house," meaning that the writing of the two portions indicates the three Foundations of the "Father and Mother" (*Abba v'Imma*) which are also called *Mezuzot*. And from the right, these portions are revealed...

# Laws of the Mezuzah
## 16a

The reason for the standing and writing of the Mezuzah <note>The scroll containing the Shema placed on doorposts</note> according to the secret of the Torah in the chest of the **Holy of Holies** <note>original: קעס/קד"ס - referring to the inner sanctum of the Divine structure</note> and the males, etc., as explained in Book 70, Gate 9. In my humble opinion, the **Sages** <note>original: ארמ"ס - likely referring to the great masters</note> aimed at the secret of **Wisdom** (*Chokhmah*) which is within the **Holy of Holies** of the **Supernal Mother** (*Imma*). Thus the Mezuzah stands upright like the length of the body. As mentioned above, it also contains **Kindness and Severity** (*Chesed and Gevurah*), which are the 102 <note>numerical value of the word 'קב' (Kav)</note> sections, and its secret is so simple. Therefore they said the Mezuzah must be placed along the length of the doorpost, like a "gateway above."

And therefore **Nachmanides** <note>Rabbi Moshe ben Nachman, 13th-century scholar</note> explained that if the Mezuzah were standing <note>vertically</note>, all the sages of the house would maintain that they should stand all day, because the foundation of **Wisdom** is called a "Torah Scroll." According to the intentions of the Torah Scroll, when the scroll is upright, all the people must stand. Even though the primary foundation of **Wisdom** elevates a bit of holiness through the "back of the neck" <note>original: קו"ל/קולא</note>, its excellence is only revealed through the story of the Covenant. Also the Torah itself was given to those who sing from the Wisdom within the laws of the **Foundation of the Mother** (*Yesod d'Imma*), as is known regarding the Ark and the Cover.

Therefore, the essence of the Mezuzah is the **Foundation of Understanding** (*Yesod d'Binah*), which "lies down" in the secret of the "Covering World" <note>the hidden realm</note>, ascending in the blessing of the Creator <note>Yotzer prayer</note> under the throne. Furthermore, the "Male Generations" are only revealed through the measure of the *Kav*. This is the transformation from **Tefillin** <note>phylacteries</note> to the Mezuzah. According to **Rabbeinu Tam**, the initials represent the "Brains of Wisdom," while according to **Rashi**, they are the "Brains of the Mother." But the writing of the Mezuzah follows **Rashi** in the straightness of Wisdom, and the Mezuzah follows **Rabbeinu Tam** in the straightness of the Mother.

The law follows **Rabbeinu Tam** and **Nachmanides** according to the True Wisdom <note>Kabbalah</note>. And when the Angel returned the aforementioned "Ivy Branch"... (And regarding this, it is permitted to say to Tamar: "And I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob" <note>Exodus 6:3</note>, meaning the secret of the "Living God" and "Strength." But "My name **YHWH** I did not make known to them" — He taught him by a miracle to say that like the attribute of Wisdom, of which it is said "This is the gate to the Lord," I was not known by that Name). Its explanation is like the knot of the arm... a Sukkah exists at the conclusion... his intention... and **Jacob**, who is the chosen of the Patriarchs... and the opening reveals... and the reason why the Mezuzah was thus... there are 72 branches in them. But the main parts are the 72 names... as explained regarding the "Back of the Knowledge" (*Da'at*) behind the "Small Face" (*Zeir Anpin*). For this reason, the splendor and the elders are in the feminine form in the wings, in the **Crown** (*Keter*) of the stream, a great rectification.

<column-break/>

And we have already established regarding the "Diminution of the Filling" <note>a Kabbalistic method of calculating letter values</note> that the Rabbi wrote to collect: whenever the "Palm of Intent" rests on the upper "Forehead" in the secret of the "Offering of the Morning." For him, the **Kindnesses** (*Chasadim*) of the **Knowledge of the Small Face** are not revealed until they are etched into the body of the **Small Face** (*Zeir Anpin*), to a place where the "Husks of Radiance" (*Kelipat Nogah*) <note>forces of mixed good and evil</note> cannot take hold of them. But the three sections <note>of the scroll</note> which are the Kindnesses and Severities... from within were not revealed, for the Kindnesses and Severities had not yet spread into the body of the **Small Face**.

As we said above, the Kindnesses, Severities, and the Hidden Knowledge are the Divinity itself; therefore, only the Name **Shaddai** was revealed to them, hinting at the three Patriarchs in the three letters of **Shaddai**... against the three visions: "The Lord our God," "The Lord is One," and "The Lord of Wisdom." Then he began to subjugate Pharaoh, who was sucking from the "Back of the Neck," and he held on until he was completely exhausted. And they began to place this on the back of the Mezuzahs.

# Laws of the Mezuzah

The **Gevurot** <note>Divine attributes of Judgment or Severity</note> stand on the left side of the **Foundation of Understanding** <note>Yesod of Binah</note>, and the **Foundation of Wisdom** <note>Yesod of Chokhmah</note> moves between them both and decides between them, for it is placed within the Foundation of the Mother <note>Imma/Understanding</note>, etc. Thus ends his words. Therefore, since the two passages of the Mezuzah <note>The "Shema" and "Vehaya Im Shamoa" sections</note> correspond to the **Chasadim** <note>Kindnesses</note> and the **Gevurot** <note>Severities</note>—which are "Hear [O Israel]" and "And it shall come to pass if you surely listen"—the Mezuzah must be placed according to the width of the doorpost. The lower plastering should rest toward the ground, but not toward the public domain.

The intention here is as written above: that the "five" are the husks <note>Kelipot/impure forces</note> that are behind the Lesser Countenance <note>Zeir Anpin</note>, corresponding to the stature of the Lesser Countenance from below. In mystical intention, these are called "windows" in the upper realms. Therefore, the passage "And it shall come to pass if you surely listen," which represents the Severities of the Foundation of Understanding, is needed to face the public domain. This is literally "upon the earth," meaning the lower realm called the "Land of the Living." However, the "holy plastering" where "Hear O Israel" is written must face the house—facing inward—meaning the passage of "Hear," which represents the Kindnesses, must face the Countenance of God, etc.

### The custom of writing "Shaddai" on the outside in the space between the passages

The Rabbi, the **Beit Yosef** <note>Joseph Karo, 16th-century legalist</note>, of blessed memory, wrote: "I have not found a hint for this in any place." Yet it is found clearly in the **Zohar**, portion *Va'etchanan*, page 260, that it must be written opposite the word *Vehaya* <note>"And it shall be"</note> which is written at the end of the second passage, and this is the text:

> Come and see: *Vehaya* <note>Vav-He-Yod-He</note> is the Holy Name from below to above. Therefore, the name **Shaddai** <note>Almighty</note> is inscribed on the outside corresponding to this name *Vehaya*. *Vehaya* is on the inside and **Shaddai** is on the outside, so that a person may be guarded on all sides, from without and from within.

Thus ends the quote. The meaning is as we explained: the Foundation of Wisdom separates between the two passages and decides between them, because it is deep within the Foundation of Understanding. Therefore, one must write **Shaddai** on the outside corresponding to *Vehaya* on the inside, for the name **Shaddai** also indicates the Foundation of Wisdom. As mentioned, it stands there between the two passages and protrudes slightly to the left side to flow to the head... and therefore it is attached to the passage of "And it shall come to pass if you surely listen." The word *Vehaya* indicates this, for the letter *Vav* is the Foundation of the Mother itself, which is called by this name.

<column-break/>

...as is known, the five Kindnesses stand within the "Story" <note>likely a reference to the structure of the Sefirot</note>... and the Foundation of Wisdom, which is called the letter *Yod*, also contains five Kindnesses... it separates between the two "edges" of the "Story"... as we explained above, the letter *Shin* of **Shaddai** also holds the Kindnesses and Severities. Therefore, it is inscribed on the outside to correspond to the name *Vehaya* on the inside. The Foundation of Wisdom is called **Shaddai**, doubled over the "Life within the Garden" which is a journey of 500 years. For the appointment of **Shaddai** is the Palace of Wisdom spreading through the whole body until the end of the Foundation of the Lesser Countenance, which is a journey of 500 years, where the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note> also resides. The essence of the Foundation of Wisdom is clothed within the Foundation of the Lesser Countenance.

Now, the opinion of **Rabbeinu Tam** and **Nachmanides** is that they say the Mezuzah must be laid horizontally across the width of the doorpost, as was said.

### Rav Yehuda said in the name of Shmuel: If one placed it like a bolt <note>vertical like a bar</note>, it is invalid. The final legal conclusion: this refers to when it is made like a stake.

**Rabbeinu Tam** explained that when one hangs it... vertically, it is invalid. **But if it is made like a "stira"** <note>horizontal</note> (Rabbeinu Tam's explanation: written at the end, placed width-wise), it is valid. The intention is as we explained above: the Mezuzah represents the Foundation of Understanding, which always "lies" across the width of the doorpost, and thus the matter is supported.

**However**, according to the opinion of **Rashi** and **Maimonides**, they said that "made like a stake" means like a peg driven into a wall, which is invalid because it is not a respectful way to perform the commandment—to fix it other than its natural orientation, like a Torah scroll which is respectful in its height. They hold that if it is made "astolara" <note>vertical</note>, meaning it descends from the top to the heel, it is valid. The **Rosh** <note>Asher ben Jehiel</note> challenged this in the "Minor Laws," arguing that standing is not the way of respect. The Talmud in the chapter "One who sells a ship" notes that the Torah scroll and the one in the Ark were lying down, not standing, as is found in the first chapter of *Berakhot*... even though they could have been standing... and the language of "width" seems to support this...

The five Names... and seven Names set straight... <note>The author is likely referring to the various spellings and expansions of the Tetragrammaton (YHVH)</note> and in the Foundation (*Yesod*) <note>The ninth Sephirot, representing the generative organ or the channel of flow</note>... and seven... through the revelation of this, the secret of the Torah, which subdues those 22 husks <note>Kelippot; the forces of impurity</note> which are called "the death of the world" <note>original: "Mavet HaOlam"</note>... for one stands against the other, as God has made them. ## The Way

The fourth [explanation] on the verse: **"And you shall write them upon the doorposts (*Mezuzot*) of your house and upon your gates."** The reason they are placed at the back <note>on the doorframe</note> is so that the Holy One, Blessed be He, shall protect the Lesser Countenance (*Zeir Anpin*) <note>The emotional attributes of the Divine</note> so that the "External Ones" <note>demonic forces</note> do not take hold of Him. For the External Ones cannot look upon the face of the King, for "in the light of the King's face is life." Every house that holds the Supernal Light, the External Ones seek to suckle from it... because the External Ones are the necessity of Severity (*Gevurah*) and "God made them to be feared before Him." But the return of the Supernal Life is for help, and through the sins of Israel, the External Ones prevail above and desire to suckle nourishment as well, and if—Heaven forbid—this were to happen, the blemish would be very great. Therefore, He made the Supernal Return to close the 22... like a Mezuzah, in order to guard the nourishment so the External Ones do not suckle from there. And so it says in the Zohar, portion *Pinhas*, page 253b:

## And this is the 11th Commandment

For a person to fix a Mezuzah to his doorway, to place every person under the guardianship of the Holy One, Blessed be He, when he goes out and when he comes in. And the secret is: "The Lord shall guard your going out and your coming in from this time forth and forevermore." Because the secret of the Divine Names will be constantly before him at the opening, and not to unite...

...with strength and life as a guard. And this is the explanation of our Rabbis of blessed memory on the word "Upon" (*Al*) the Mezuzah: the word "Upon" implies "for the sake of," as in "Upon my bed at night I sought him," meaning *because* of my bed. So too here, the main revelation of the Mezuzah's illumination is for the sake of the "Mezuzah of your house," which are the strength and secret to take the good into them. Within them are two names of *Shaddai* <note>Almighty</note>... and through the revelation of the hidden ancient things of our Sages, the External Ones have no power to suckle from them more than their basic life force. Therefore, the main purpose of the Mezuzah is to drive away the External Ones who hinder the "Mezuzah of your house"—and there is no "house" but a man's wife. As our Sages said in tractate Ketubot (104), there are three things a man owes his wife: beauty, protection, and children. And there is no "house" except for the Shekhinah <note>The Divine Presence, often personified as feminine</note>... and therefore a certain man said, "In all my days I never called my wife 'my wife,' but rather 'my house,'" to show that the woman is the vessel for the three aforementioned things. And the answer is through the revelation of the three Foundations...

<meta>This page continues the discussion of the laws of the Mezuzah, specifically focusing on the mystical and kabbalistic requirements for its placement on the doorpost. # Laws of the Mezuzah

...is obligated in a Mezuzah and not with another side <note>original: "panim" - literally "face" or "surface," referring here to the doorpost</note>. And behold, both these and those are **the words of the Living God**, for according to the thinkers who follow the view that the doorposts must be opposite one another—which is the secret of the "Surrounding Mother" <note>The kabbalistic concept of Binah as an encompassing light</note>—there must be two posts. But according to Rabbi Meir, who holds that the obligation of the Mezuzah is "at the entrance"—which is the secret of the "Internal Mother"—even if it has only one side, it is obligated in a Mezuzah. Therefore, the **Remaz** <note>Rabbi Moses Zacuto, a 17th-century Kabbalist</note> ruled the law according to the Sages; thus, whoever acts like the Master has acted [correctly], and whoever acts like the Master has acted [correctly], for the law is like both of them. For the **Rasham** <note>Rabbi Shmuel Vital</note> rules like Rabbi Meir, and the **Sidis** like the Sages.

Regarding the verse: *And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates*, there is a hidden secret there: a person should always enter the distance of two doorways and then come in. These correspond to **Kindness** <note>Chesed</note> and **Might** <note>Gevurah</note>, as mentioned in the Zohar, portion *Vayikra*, see there. And if "in your house and in your gates" refers to the Kindnesses and Mights which are the sections of the Mezuzah, look at the tractate. And this was not heard: what is it that you write on the doorposts of your house and your gates? This means you shall write the "Mights" <note>Gevurahs</note>... <note>The text here enters a complex numerical and symbolic discussion of the Hebrew letters and divine names</note> ...and the letters *M-K-K-P* which are the aspect of Mights. And behold, this is for you... with the crown of letters...

And now, specifically, one must understand the verse *And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates*. The explanation is based on the *Tikkunim* <note>The Tikkuney Zohar</note>... when we give to Understanding <note>Binah</note> the name... the heels of Kindness are clothed within the Crown <note>Keter</note> of Rachel. And Rachel, her "heel" <note>Ekiv</note> has the name *Elohim*... and the name *Elohim* has the numerical value of "Heel" <note>151/172 variant calculations</note>... but "Heels" <note>Akavim</note> is for the sake of being clothed, while "Heel" <note>Ekev</note> is a term of "preciousness" or "remnant," to show that the clarifications are all because they clothe another Crown called "Heel."

And it is known that *Elohim* is in Might <note>Gevurah</note> according to everyone... and it is the same number as "In your life." Therefore, the word "Doorposts" <note>Mezuzot</note> is written in the first portion <note>the Shema</note> missing a letter <note>Hebrew: מזוזת</note>. The reason is as it is written: the "foundation" of a man, even though they are two, they are called "Doorposts," the two thighs of truth. Nevertheless, through their clothing in the Crown of Rachel, it is called by a singular/precious term. Therefore, "Doorposts" is written deficiently to show they are included as one. But in the second portion <note>Vehaya Im Shamoa</note>, it is written full <note>Hebrew: מזוזות</note> to indicate... that they are two in the mundane... in the house.

<column-break/>

...it is beneficial to go backward. If so, when it rises to Understanding <note>Binah</note> and they enter within the "Wing," this entry is forced to turn its face in order to enter in the manner of attachment within the Wing. And if he stands opposite Understanding, opposite the voice of the *Zeir Anpin* <note>The "Small Face" or emotive sefirot</note>... and does not go by way of the right... that is to say, at the time the "Foundation of Understanding" was within the Wing, this entry is called *Yachaleif* <note>changing/passing</note>... for the entry is not specifically of a hero...

And now one must understand: why indeed do we place the Mezuzah on the right of the *Zeir Anpin* and not on the right of the *Nukva* <note>The Feminine Divine principle</note>? The intention is that when the "Foundations of Understanding" stand within the *Zeir Anpin*, the Mezuzah must be revealed through the back of the *Zeir Anpin* in order to guard the place of Rachel. But when the "Foundations of Understanding" themselves are clothed in the *Nukva*, the Mezuzah is not revealed there, for there is no need... since the Foundation itself with the "Wing" and "Majesty" of Understanding enters within the *Nukva*. If so, why does she need the Mezuzah if she has the "Majesty" itself?

And since the aspect of the Mezuzah is only revealed in the *Zeir Anpin* through the "oversight of the tradition" via the right of Understanding... and not via the right of *Yachaleif*. Therefore, even if there is only one side without a left, one must place the Mezuzah on the wall that is on the right of the doorway. And this is what the **Remaz** wrote in the portion of *Karmi*, since the tradition and Rabbi Akiva stand with him.

**And the Sages exempt [it]. What is the reason of the Rabbis? "Doorposts"**
**is written full, the reason being that one who has**

# Laws of the Mezuzah

**Amemar said: A doorway built on a corner requires a Mezuzah.**
The explanation is: a house where the doorway is near the corner, such as when the opening replaces the actual corner and reaches both the south and north sides.
**Rav Ashi said to Amemar: But it has no doorposts!** (Explanation: It has no distinct doorposts, only the walls of the house themselves). **He replied to him: The walls serve as the doorposts.**
The explanation is: "The walls serve as doorposts" means that one should treat the house walls that surround the opening as a pair of doorposts, even if they are just the ends of the walls.
**Rav Mari happened to visit the house of Mar Samuel. He saw that there was only one doorpost on the left, and he [Samuel] had placed a Mezuzah on it. He said to him: According to whom is this? According to Rabbi Meir?**
The explanation is: The wall of the house on the right side of the opening passed far away from the entrance, so that there was no "face" <note>surface</note> except on the left, and he fixed the Mezuzah on that left surface.
**Amemar said: The school of Rabbi Meir says [the Mezuzah must be] on the right.**
**On the left? Who says so? For it was taught: "Your house" [means] the way you enter, which is from the right, etc. What then is the view of Rabbi Meir? For it was taught: A house that has only one doorpost—Rabbi Meir deems it obligated in a Mezuzah, but the Sages exempt it.**
And by way of a deeper explanation, the reason of Rabbi Meir is that he holds everything should be done at the entrance <note>original: "sam b'petach"</note>. For the one who stands there to obligate it there, it is like the One Hundred Mercies <note>original: "K' Meah Chasadim," referring to the 100 daily blessings</note>, and this is the essence of the Mezuzah. For the secret of the Mezuzah is that the two portions <note>the two biblical paragraphs inside the scroll</note> are the holiness within the sphere. With all this, I have set aside the scripture as a decree and wisdom <insert>a small secret for the children of the skull</insert> within his own; for every face, however small, because of this—like the precedence of the "Dogs" <note>likely a reference to the "husks" or external forces in Kabbalah</note> to Wisdom—it also rolled within the "Wing" until the Kingdom <term>Malchut: the final emanation representing the physical world</term> like a river. Therefore, Rabbi Meir obligates a Mezuzah for a house that has only one doorpost, which represents the expansion and the pipes <note>channels of divine flow</note>, and everything is according to the dust <note>the physical</note> that has no expansion of the Right toward the side of Mercies. Corresponding to the time of the expansion of the Wing with the end of the covering, every voice is considered the wall of the house on the right side; there he shall place the Mezuzah on the right, for your entry is from the right. For the essence of the placement is the "legs" <note>the lower supports</note>. Therefore, "your entry" is the path of your walking. The explanation is: that in the entry of the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: the feminine indwelling presence of God</term> to enter the Small Face <term>Ze'ir Anpin: the masculine aspect of the divine emanations</term>, she would uproot her leg so that the entry could expand downward until the end of the Small Face. Therefore, to her right, the entry is uprooted in order to influence the expansion

<column-break/>

of the Small Face to such an extent. Afterward, the profane—which is the "leg"—expands from this into the Mezuzahs upon the altar. And since the Understanding <term>Binah: the mother emanation</term> is rooted at the head, and there the decree is joined with the Mezuzah, one must always fix the Mezuzah on the right. This is the reason for Rabbi Meir, who said that even if it has only one doorpost, it is liable for a Mezuzah. (As it was taught: "Mezuzot" <note>plural</note>—I might hear this as a minimum of two; why then does the Torah say "Mezuzot"? Since the second "Mezuzot" is an inclusion after an inclusion, and an inclusion after an inclusion serves only to exclude, the text comes to require only one Mezuzah; these are the words of Rabbi Ishmael. Rabbi Akiva says: The text comes to speak of the lintel and the two doorposts... <note>This parenthetical section debates the plural vs. singular grammar of the commandment</note>). This is the end of the quote. The general rule of the matter: what the scripture says, "And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house," refers to the dust of the division of the face of the entrance. For example, a doorway at a corner is obligated in a Mezuzah on the wall corresponding to the right of the entrance, and not on the "face" that is inside the thickness of the doorway. And he explains "And you shall write them upon the doorposts" to mean *near* it. Just as "Mezuzim" <note>original: "mazuzim al pis"</note> means near it. And so too, "And he stood over them under the tree" <note>Genesis 18:8</note> means near it. And so it is written as a hint to this decree: "And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house" <note>original: "B.H. B.H." likely abbreviation for "Beit Hashem" or "Baruch Hu"</note>. Even though the doorposts are changed, nevertheless, he should not put the Mezuzah inside, but near the division, near to it, which is on the wall of the house where the entrance is straight, and not inside the doorway. For we require the "way of the right" for the entry, and not the "way of the right" for the exit. For at the time of exiting, everything enters for the sake of the entry of the Bride, in order to enter as a female in the secret of "And the Lord God built the side" <note>Genesis 2:22</note>. See how the Presence turns her legs, for she stands with the Small Face back-to-back, her right at his left, and her left at his right. If so, at the time of the entry of the Presence into the Small Face—because the Small Face established the house of the Presence, as it is said, "He established the heavens with understanding"—the entry of the Presence into the Small Face is called "coming into the house." And the covered power of the heat is clothed within the wing of the Small Face, and the voice of the Presence is within the voice of the Small Face. For all the countenances—the Ancient One, the Long Face, the Small Face—all stand in the secret of the expansion of each one, except for the stature of the Small Face, which stands in turning.

# Laws of the Mezuzah

The *Kol Bo* <note>A 13th-14th century legal compendium</note> writes to place within it a measure of forty [parts] wine and to judge the Mezuzah as a guard. Some matters have become confused; regarding the explanation of "And he drew near," they question our understanding because there is no letter *He* at the end of the Name. Yet, in our understanding, the letter *He* is present with the numerical value of 463 at the end of the *Zuta* <note>Small/Minor</note> law. This is the secret of the Sanhedrin [page] 38: the change of encampments according to the Scripture. They were under the water, a foundation of walking and striking by the hand of the *Kelipot* <note>term: Kelipot (literally "shells" or "husks"); the representation of evil or impure spiritual forces in Kabbalah</note> in order to drive them away. The Mezuzah is like a spider of fire; from its blood they shall not suck at all, not even enough for its sustenance. It is included with the people, as in the intention of being placed on the eve of the Sabbath. He is able to [protect] from those who have wrath and the constellations of the Sabbath, and it is forgiven. The Sabbath is a king who calls the spirit to the Mezuzah; it is "bread for you" and gathers. Therefore they said in the Tractate of *Kiddushin*:

### The two sections within the Mezuzah are mutually dependent
### on one another

Let him call to a place for him, and so they shall be. See, and be pure; there is fear for the house. There is the Sabbath night, which is the Name *Mah* and *Sa* <note>Mystical permutations of the Divine Name</note>. And for it, he paused and took hold. They are similar in the Mezuzah itself... its constellation judges for all and receives his house. The two sections are mutually dependent; the explanation is that even the perfection of the bride is hinted at here <note>original: "as hinted in the Zohar, Portion Va'etchanan, page 263, side a."</note>.

# Laws of the Mezuzah

And know that the three "thorns" <note>The decorative flourishes or 'tagin' on Hebrew letters</note> around the letter *Tzadi* <note>original: ציון, likely referring to the shape of the letter or a specific scribal tradition</note> all equal the numerical value of 88. This is the secret of the word *He* <note>The letter H</note>, and it is like the Nazirite, three *Yods*, a *He*, and two *Vavs*.
And it has ten secrets: three thorns, and each thorn ends in a *Yod*, and beneath the line of the *Het* is a *Zayin* itself, and three thorns which are three *Yods* to raise the line. The total sum is 100. With the vocalization of *Mem*, 88, 70, 100, the numerical value is 554.
79 is the numerical value of "Dew" <note>Tal</note> doubled, and from the power of the Kindness of the World of Creation <note>Beriah</note>, so it is derived. Therefore, the four elements of this world are hinted at in the number 554, which is the World of Creation called *El Shaddai* <note>God Almighty</note>.
And behold, just as the foundation of Understanding <note>Binah</note> is revealed in Creation, which is the aspect of the Mezuzah—and Creation is called "Kindness" as mentioned—so too, correspondingly below, one must also place the Mezuzah at the **gates of the courtyard**, corresponding to the Mezuzah that exists at the Gate of the Heavenly Courtyard to protect the World of Creation from the "External Ones" <note>Klipot/Forces of impurity</note>.

### And similarly, the gates of provinces

This corresponds to the World of Formation <note>Yetzirah</note>, which is called a "province" because it is outside the courtyard. Now, the courtyard, which is Creation, from whom does it receive? From the Understanding of Emanation <note>Binah of Atzilut</note>, from which judgments are awakened for every house itself for the "Nessis" of life, which is embroidered with Judgment and blossoms with Mercy, as is known.
But in the World of Formation, where the "Small Face" <note>Zeir Anpin</note> of Emanation receives... <note>The text describes complex numerical permutations of the names of God, specifically the name *Elohim* which represents Judgment</note> ...because it is all Judgments, which are *Elohim*, for the "Lights of Greatness" <note>Mohin de-Gadlut</note>, which are the Names of Being <note>Havayah/YHWH</note>, depart from it. And not by the power of the Creator are they complete judgments.
Therefore, the World of Formation is called "Province" <note>Medinah</note>, which is a term of Judgment <note>from the root 'Din'</note>. Likewise, "Provinces" <note>Medinot</note> has the numerical value of "Dew" <note>Tal</note> doubled plus the four provinces... this hints at the "Brains of Smallness" <note>Mohin de-Katnut</note> which are the *Elohim* judgments. And since the "External Ones" have a grasp in these lesser lights, the husks <note>Klipot</note> are mixed with good and evil.
Behold, there in Formation, the foundation of Understanding is also revealed within the Upper House, just as in Emanation, in order to protect it. And therefore, also below:

<column-break/>

At the **gates of provinces**, one must place a Mezuzah, because Israel is mixed among them in peace. But where there is a "danger of the authorities" <note>original: הוקלא/קוקלא, referring to a legal exemption in the Talmud (Yoma 11a) where placing a mezuzah might provoke government suspicion or danger</note>, as stated there in the Tractate. Rashi explains: "where accusations are constantly prepared." In such a case, they are exempt from the commandment of Mezuzah.
For this is the spiritual parallel: above in the World of Formation, the "husks" bark so loudly that the protection of the Mezuzah does not avail. On the contrary, if one places a Mezuzah, it might cause harm when the "External Ones" are present. There was an incident involving a certain investigator <note>original: קסדור - Quaestor/Officer</note> in the upper part of Sepphoris who found a Mezuzah and penalized the owner.
This is also a hint to the upper realms: that the husks are recognizable in the World of Formation. Since good and evil are balanced in Formation, the husk can sometimes prevail. If the aspect of the Mezuzah were revealed to them then, they would have the power to take the divine flow from the foundation of Understanding called *El Shaddai*. Therefore, they are exempt from the Mezuzah in such dangerous circumstances.

### And similarly, the gates of cities

This corresponds to the World of Action <note>Asiyah</note>. And behold, it is not as one might say regarding the World of Emanation—where it is mostly good and only a minority is evil, thus requiring a Mezuzah so the minority of evil does not mix with the good. Rather, in the World of Action, where all the husks are mixed directly with the good, the Mezuzah is certainly effective and necessary.
And it is not only in the World of Creation, where the "External Ones" are below and the light is not revealed to all, but it receives in Creation and there too good and evil are mixed; even so, the Mezuzah still helps because there the majority is good and the minority is evil.
But in the World of Formation, where good and evil are equal in the balance, and the light of Understanding is not revealed... one might think the Mezuzah does not help. Therefore, it must be said that even in Formation, it is effective as long as the husk does not prevail; then one is obligated in Mezuzah. Through the commandments that Israel performs below, holiness can overcome the husk.

# Laws of the Mezuzah

This side is like the plague in the portion of *Mishpatim* <note>Exodus 21-24</note> where all the classes of damaging spirits are found.
The numerical value of "Good" (17) is attributed to it from one aspect, which overcomes the damaging spirits for the sake of
merit. However, in the World of Action <note>Asiyah, the lowest of the four spiritual worlds</note>, its majority is evil and its minority is good, and they are
arranged together. Even there, the light of the Small Face <note>Zeir Anpin, the emotive sephirot</note> is not
revealed, but rather the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note> receives in such a way that after
our intention in the writing of the Mezuzah, there is no benefit. Yet
it implies to us that even in Action, although its majority is evil, nevertheless through the
small amount that Israel performs below, they write with the power of Understanding <note>Binah</note>.
For in the Mother <note>Binah</note> there is the power in the "Vault" <note>the protective arch</note> to bind the house
from the External Ones <note>Klipot/demonic forces</note>, as it is written: "Ascribe strength unto God" <note>Psalm 68:35</note>, which is
the Living God of Understanding. Over Israel is His majesty, and His strength is in the skies <note>Shachakim</note>,
which is above. This aspect is effective, and these people write the name *Shaddai* <note>Almighty</note>
with its power, which is revealed over the External Ones and brings it
with power into the Small Face to bind it, and this is what is meant by "His strength is in the skies."
And behold, the World of Action is called by the likeness of
the Kingdom of Emanation <note>Atzilut</note>, receiving in the manner of the "L-rd's Language" <note>Lashon Hakodesh</note>,
which has the numerical value of 274, like the number of "Your Refiner." And there descend
all the "Backsides" <note>the hidden/harsh aspects of Divine names</note> which are the "Backsides" of the names of 72, 63, and 45.
The name of 63 has the value of 146, and the name of 45 has the value of 130.
Therefore, the three equal 135. And the "Backsides" of the simple name equal 515.
Thus, there are three "Brides" from which all sufferings descend
and come upon Israel at the time when the External Ones take hold of these
"Backsides." And all these "Backsides" descend and influence
the World of Action, their number being equal to the number of "Cities."
But "The blessing of the Lord makes one rich, and He adds no sorrow with it" <note>Proverbs 10:22</note>,

"I will walk before the Lord in the lands of the living" <note>Psalm 116:9</note>, for the "Brides" are transformed
into the "Blessing of the Lord" and "The Lands of the Living."
And let us return to the statement of the Zohar as it is written: <note>original: "וקיה כל כה עינוי חזי ליס לרות וסתל דמזוה ולזכר ליס ולהזכיר ליס לחובחתס"</note>
The explanation of the matter is that the External Ones have no power to look

reveals the External Ones at the time they mention it according to the "Peel."

# Laws of the Mezuzah

To judge <note>original: *Lishpot*</note>... and to gaze, and all the more so to derive nourishment from it. And if so, how can they <note>the external forces</note> derive nourishment from that place which is exceedingly high? However, the matter is this: because the hidden <term>Yesod</term> <note>The sefirah of Foundation, representing the procreative or channeling force</note> is revealed in the <term>Netzach-Hod-Yesod</term> <note>The lower triad of sefirot: Victory, Splendor, and Foundation</note> of <term>Binah</term> <note>The sefirah of Understanding</note>. And so too is revealed there the secret of the "Holy Foundation" which subdues the "waste products" as mentioned above. Therefore, the name *Shaddai* <note>Almighty</note> is revealed there from the Foundation of the Father in order to drive away those external forces. And they are sent away from there, and it is forbidden to distance them with a knife <note>referring to ritual or physical interference</note>, for they leave of their own accord; and this is the essence of the matter. Therefore, corresponding to this writing <note>the Mezuzah</note> which is directed toward the "Crown of the Other Side" <term>Keter d'Achur</term> and against the "Small Face" <term>Z'eir Anpin</term>—the Moon that clothes itself within the Crown—the external forces have the ability to derive nourishment from there, and this protection is very effective.

Therefore it is said: "And for this reason, a person must not perform any filth or dirtiness at the doorway," so as not to give a place for the external forces to derive nourishment from the <term>Netzach-Hod-Yesod</term> of *Binah*. And one should not pour out murky water, so as not to give a place for the external forces to derive nourishment from that "waste" of the *Netzach-Hod-Yesod* of *Binah*. One must not do anything that is disrespectful toward the "Heavens of the Master," because they would then have the power to also derive nourishment from the flow of the right-hand channel of her Foundation, which is the sign of the name *Shaddai*. And this is the matter of the "Cloud at the Gate" from the beginning, which has the authority to prohibit or permit. Meaning: since it is revealed in the brain through the pouring of murky water, they strike him at the beginning and harm him. (And as mentioned above, the Zohar warns every person: just as we said, one should not pour murky water at the doorway because it is the "Doorway of the House.")

And every person should be careful not to neglect the doorway of his house, which belongs to the Master. Meaning: he must always have a Mezuzah in his house to drive away the external forces from the doorway of his house. (And any person who fixes a Mezuzah at his entrances, that "Evil Inclination" and that "Other Side" and that "Angel of Death" are nullified before him. And this is "The gate of the Lord; the righteous shall enter through it.") The explanation is: through a person's good deeds, he subdues his Evil Inclination, which is the "Prosecutor," and it becomes a "Good Angel." So too, by being careful with the Mezuzah, he subdues the "Prosecutor" of the *Kelipat Nogah* <note>The "Glow," a shell containing both good and evil</note>, and the Prosecutor and the Destroyer themselves become angels and protect him. And this is the meaning of "For He will give His angels charge over you, to guard you"—the Evil Inclination and the Prosecutor both become angels and guard this "Gate of the Lord," which is the Foundation of *Binah* called "Gate," as mentioned. And it is the "Gate of the Lord" where the secret of the Male and Female are found, as in the secret of...

# The Laws of the Mezuzah

We shall now enter the secret of the opinion that the <term>Mezuzah</term><note>The parchment scroll placed on doorposts.</note> is worthy of being ten handbreadths high, etc. This refers to the <term>Zeir Anpin</term><note>The "Small Face" or masculine aspect of the divine.</note> and the <term>Nukva</term><note>The feminine aspect or Shekhinah.</note> of <term>Binah</term><note>Understanding; the third Sefirah.</note>. For the aspect of the Upper Mezuzah is the Sovereignty within, and the Zeir Anpin is in the secret of the Left—for her Left is the Right of the world above. This is the secret of the fifty steps of the depth, plus the divider. Peace is granted against <term>Samael</term><note>The primary figure of evil/prosecution in Kabbalah.</note> at her beginning, which is the Right of the <term>Shekhinah</term><note>The Divine Presence</note> in Binah, where the <term>Kelipah</term><note>Literally "shell" or "husk"; the forces of impurity.</note> is like the "flank" of the Right of the souls and the <term>Mochin</term><note>Intellectual faculties</note> that are below. And the eighteen [faculties] strike from her great strength. He calls to them on their right, for they are always chasing after the Right of Holiness, because they already have permission to suckle from the Left, and it belongs to them. However, they have no power to suckle from the Right; therefore, they always pursue it to cling to the Right. And Heaven forbid... now that the secrets of the Kelipah of Binah stand below, they surround her to snatch those souls that emerge from there. Therefore, the upper intellectual faculties are hidden. After the soul is forgotten, the <term>Demons</term><note>original: "Mazzikin"</note> enter there, mixed with the screens of the "Inner Light" and the "Reflected Light," which are the intellects and the <term>Gevurot</term><note>Strengths/Judgments</note> that take their return. From them come the lights of the soul. Therefore, now, at the time of their emergence from there, passing through the female [opening], the demons are weakened and are sought out against the "Satan" of the souls, for there are the Gevurot of Samael. And the aspect of the Angels clings to the light of her Right, which are the aspect of the <term>Chasadim</term><note>Kindnesses</note> of her Right, the aspect of <term>Shaddai</term><note>A Divine Name often associated with the Mezuzah and protection.</note>. Outside of these Kindnesses, they are able to strike in order to suckle from their Kindnesses, for every single living being can approach and cling, but only through the blessing. And behold, this is what is written in the <term>Zohar</term><note>The foundational work of Jewish mysticism.</note>: "Two levels always stand as overseers, one on the right and one on the left. The one on the right is called the 'Good Inclination' and the one on the left is called the 'Evil Inclination.'" This means they are in the aspect of the Judgments that Wisdom takes at the time of its emergence and entry into the Female. They are like the surrounding lights... (when the soul enters the house, that secret is there, and he closes his eyes and delivers it from the Evil Inclination that surrounds the left, to be drawn from that evening, and they are awakened from the right). The explanation is: in the rest of its placement from the Foundation to Binah, mixed with the Mezuzah... it is her voice, which is the Kelipah of Binah. After it flees from the Judgments, the voice also goes and clings to the mother of Wisdom, which is the aspect of the Judgments of Samael, and the "Eighteen" in the secret of the Right, without fear, in Kindness. (And in that guard, the light is hidden...)

<column-break/>

The sign of the "Shin" [ש] has three hearts, and "Luck" <note>original: "Mazzal"</note> has the numerical value of 36, and the letters of 36 handbreadths... for the rectification of the four Names of the Lord [YHVH] and Adonai... the secret of the twenty-two letters and the Name in the pleasantness of the upper hands in the secret of the "Covenant," as it is with the "Peace" of the union of Zeir Anpin, as mentioned above. And the letters of the four... in the pleasantness of the secret of the Law and the light of Samael for this. Seven... in the secret of the son, like a spark and like luck. And behold, from this, the "Kings" of the Kelipah of Binah suckle, because they too are vessels from the preceding "Broken Vessels." However, the demons suckle from the light and the "Thirty-Six" produced from the twenty-two for the rectification of her Judgments in pleasantness. They are the aspect of the "Hearts." The letter "Dalet" [ד] is the "Door" <note>original: "Delet"</note> itself, and it is the voice... that the "Crowns" suckle from, for she herself is the aspect of demons and flames of the female, and they suckle from her "Dragon" and the "Two Breasts," which is twice the name "Shaddai" [שדי]. This is the aspect of the numerical value of... and this is the secret of "He shall lie on his breast." The intention, as it were, is that Zeir Anpin is currently in exile and has no union with the "Matriarch of the House," who is Rachel, except on the Sabbath. But on weekdays, he only has a union with Leah, as is known. The reason is that as long as the sin is not rectified... which doubled in the Kelipah of Binah, becoming demons and angels, suckling from the Dragon and the two breasts... he cannot unite with her. "And from His holy dwelling He shall give His voice."

"He shall lie" has the numerical value of... upon his breast, which is the Foundation of the Female, where he is always present... "Between my breasts he shall lie," which is the secret of the union that was constant during the time the Holy Temple stood. But now, the demons and the angels of the Kelipah distance themselves, suckling all six days of the week from his "Breasts." And this is the secret of the "Good Heart," which is Rachel, the "Younger Daughter." And she has no public presence... the acronym for "The left pushes away and the right draws near." For all the Kindness of Samael is similar, from which the demons of the Kelipah of Binah suckle, and the three lower Kelipot overpower this. But the secret of "The right draws near" is where the Kings of the Kelipah of Binah suckle in its time, because the three Kelipot have no power to suckle from the Kindnesses, except for a very tiny amount.

# Laws of the Mezuzah
### 18 I

The male and female of the "Shell" <note>original: *Klipah*, the forces of impurity</note> are black and green, while the male and female of Holiness are simply the "Later Ones" and the "Mighty Deeds" <note>original: *Gevurot*</note>. The Mezuzah is arranged in a square, with the filling of the name *Y-H-V-H* and two names of *K-O-Z-U* <note>A common mystical cipher for the name of God used on the back of a Mezuzah</note>. There are various letter combinations: *L-V-N*, *Z-V-N*, and sequences of *V-V-N*. In total, these equal the numerical value of "Two" for Holiness, from which the Accuser <note>original: *S-M*</note> and Lilith used to nurse. Through the missing parts of the Mezuzah, Jacob overcame the Accuser and stood firm. He guarded himself against the house of Laban, and the divine "Becomings" <note>original: *Havayot*</note> brought everything forth. With this, we come to the explanation of the passage in the Zohar, Portion *Va'etchanan*, page 266, side 3, which reads:

->**Come and see: An evil spirit**<-

<margin>To the master because the gates etc.</margin>
attaches to a person who does not know how to be on guard against it and does not place upon the entrance of his house the Holy Supreme Name. For he has three hundred and sixty-five evil appointed accusers, each with his own name, and all of them are found with him all the days of the year, accusing him above and below. They are found with him by day and by night: by day to accuse him, and by night to cause him harm when he rises. When he goes out, they accuse him; when he enters, they are ready with their hands upon his shoulders and they say: "Woe to so-and-so in this world and in the world to come." Because of this, a person needs the Mezuzah to be marked in all things—to be marked with the mark of faith so that he is careful on all sides, and all evil types will be guarded against in this world and in the world to come. End of quote.

->**Gloss**<-

Before we explain this passage, we must provide one introduction regarding what was mentioned by "Amari" and "Lahas" in the *Chariot of Joshua* <note>A mystical text</note>, as follows: Know that the "Glowing Shell" <note>original: *Klipah Nogah*</note> from the East and upwards is good, and there are 248 positive commandments and 248 angels, all of whom are male. From the middle and downwards it is evil, and there are 365 negative commandments and 365 demons, all of whom are female. They are included in the 365 days of the solar year, and each day one rules along with 25 armies under it. They all stand at the Upper Gate. When the time comes, a foul spirit of impurity is sent forth, the "Wormwood" <note>bitterness/curse</note> to which the 365 demons are attached. They desire to enter the gate of the Palace to dwell in the Sapphire, if they are able.

<column-break/>

The twenty sections of the Mezuzah <note>referring to specific mystical divisions of the text</note> were used by the children of Jacob. From here, the name *Kozu B'mochsaz Kozu* <note>The divine name *Y-H-V-H E-L-O-H-E-I-N-U Y-H-V-H* shifted by one letter in the alphabet</note> has the numerical value of "Heart." Jacob recognized the 240 letters, which represent the male strength of Jacob, which is the revelation of the "Foundation" <note>original: *Yesod*</note> for all. From them, the community of Israel was made, which is the "Female" of the Small Face <note>original: *Zeir Anpin*</note>. The revelation of the Mezuzah was the shepherd and sustainer of the world. Because the path of the one written in it is the "Holy of Holies," its placement is in "Understanding" <note>original: *Binah*</note> in the arms of the Female. But Jacob called it—in my humble opinion—through the light revealed there, the letters of the squares of the "Hear O Israel" <note>original: *Shema*</note> and the Name. This creates a barrier between Holiness and the "External Forces" <note>original: *Chitzonim*</note> so they cannot pass. He counts everything to say they cannot receive from the revelation shown there, which are the "Hidden Lights" received by the "Dalet" <note>the fourth letter, often symbolizing the Shekhinah</note>. They only receive from the division of the whole of Jacob and no more. Now, regarding the 613 commandments: the 248 positive commandments are the "Kindnesses" <note>original: *Chasadim*</note>, and the 365 negative commandments are the "Mighty Deeds" <note>original: *Gevurot*</note> in Understanding, on the Throne. He wishes to expand on this here. Behold, the two paragraphs of the Mezuzah contain the Kindnesses and Mighty Deeds as mentioned above, and in them all 613 commandments are included. Therefore, Jacob said to Esau: "I have sojourned with Laban and kept the 613 commandments." He hinted to Esau that his desire was for everything to be holy. Laban was involved in the concept of the Mezuzah, which is the name of the 613 commandments. Nevertheless, I overcame him through "I have kept," and I removed his power from his mouth and did not allow him to be, except in the division of the three names as mentioned. And behold, the three names in the *Atbash* cipher <note>A substitution cipher where the first letter is replaced by the last, etc.</note> equal the names of God. Jacob, through the divisions of power, has the numerical value of the names of God, and not Esau. Jacob said, "I have plenty," and "everything is mine." This is all hinted at in the Mezuzah, which refers to Jacob. The three names on the outside of the Mezuzah protect against the Aramean [Laban] who tried to destroy everything. Jacob used the power of the Mezuzah sections, which include the 248 Kindnesses and 365 Mighty Deeds, and all the abundance was in it through the name of God, protecting against Lilith.

## Laws of the Mezuzah

From the inside, and even more so from the outside, the righteous shall enter through it <note>A play on Psalm 118:20</note>, for as our Sages of blessed memory said, there are ten instances of the Divine Name [Havayah] there, which is the numerical value of "The Portions of the Righteous." They are made of letters because the "Angel of the Countenance" <note>Metatron</note> is the numerical equivalent of them all... based on the secret of the "Foundation" [Yesod], for "The Righteous is the foundation of the world" <note>Proverbs 10:25</note>. And regarding the "Righteous," for the Mezuzah contains two portions... <note>The two paragraphs of the Shema</note> and these are established through the word [Shaddai], for they are the secret of the name **Shaddai** (Almighty), which is the "Guardian of the Doors of Israel" <note>A traditional acronym for the name Shaddai written on the Mezuzah</note>. Above, in general, this protects and saves... and they prevail over the Holy side. (And those who placed their hands on their heads... they opened and said, "I have found a portion from the Matronita" <note>A reference to the Shekhinah/Divine Presence in Zohar literature</note>... he who fulfills the commandment of the Mezuzah, it is as if he is watched over so that no harm or "evil eye" shall have power over him, and all the accusers are turned into good advocates for him, and there is no one to cancel his merit.) This means that even a "good angel" is transformed to plead his case—may the Merciful One save us. Therefore, one must be very careful with the commandment of the Mezuzah in all its rectifications and all its laws. And do not wonder at this, for it was the secret of the three Patriarchs. Therefore, the Torah says: "You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together." 

Thus, "Moab said to the elders of Midian: Now this assembly will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field." Balak is the "ox" in whom the power was nullified, and Balaam is the "donkey" and the female donkey. Therefore, he sent messengers to Balaam to pair them together so he might prevail. But the Holy One, blessed be He, did this: "And God’s anger was kindled because he went," for he went with this intention to break the ox and the donkey together. Therefore, the Holy One killed Balaam’s donkey, as it is written, "I would have killed you," to prevent the suckling of the Lilith-husk from above so they could not pair together. By nullifying the power of his Husk which prosecuted against Israel to curse them, the curses were turned into blessings. Balaam’s power to curse came from his desire to awaken the curses that existed after the sin of the Golden Calf, but "the Lord your God turned the curse into a blessing for you."

Therefore, one must focus on the proper intention <term>Kavanah: meditative intention</term> when kissing the Mezuzah, so that the "Damaging Sack" <note>a play on the word *Shakk*, referring to harmful spiritual forces</note> is nullified, as it says there: the name *Shaddai*. One should direct the eyes to the heart, for there is power to bring down the seal of His Kingdom...

"Your dwellings, O Israel"—this refers to Leah, who stands opposite Israel from the chest upwards. These were rectified by Jacob. 

All of Jacob's rectification involved two wives from the outside, but Moses was from the inside; his entire rectification was separate for his wife, who was the "Crown of Splendor" to her husband. 

Now, regarding Balak and Balaam, the Rabbi <note>likely Isaac Luria, the Ari</note> wrote: Balak was struck by the side of the "Foundation of Chayot." Correspondingly, he sucked from the heels of Leah that flash and protrude into the Crown of Rachel.

He is called Balaam because he receives his vitality from a "swallowed" <note>Hebrew: *balua*</note> and sunken place. # Laws of the Mezuzah

Laban intended to deceive, etc. All of this was so that Jacob could rectify, from the beginning, the "lesser" aspect and afterwards the Mezuzah <note>The author is linking the physical scroll on the doorpost to the spiritual structures of the Matriarchs</note>, not pausing for even a moment. You might think he should have taken Rachel first, but then the <term>Kelipah</term> <note>The "shell" or "husk" of evil/impurity in Kabbalah</note> of Laban would have overcome him, and afterwards he would not have been able to rectify anything. Therefore, it was necessary at first to rectify Leah, who represents the "lesser" or concealed world, and afterwards Rachel.

Now, according to Jacob’s own reasoning, he intended to take Rachel alone. Therefore, it says "and he gave him to eat" <note>Genesis 29:22</note>. This means the letters *Nun* and *Zayin* at the end of the word are sufficient for the Name there. Regarding Laban’s sisters, see "to his daughter" <note>Genesis 29:24</note>; it was so there would be no merits through which he could rectify the "Seal." See how he suppressed Rachel from being his wife, as it is written: "except the bread which he ate" <note>Genesis 39:6</note>. And the word "to eat" (*l'echol*) is a term for consumption/destruction, as in "the friends have eaten." This was to rectify the fifty letters of the "Tongue" <note>referring to the 50 Gates of Understanding</note>.

Also, I was merited that he gave him strength to enter himself into all the seven <term>Havayot</term> <note>The four-letter Name of God, Y-H-W-H</note> of the two sections of the Mezuzah. This is hinted at in the word *Kand* <note>Numerical value 74</note> for clothing, which refers to the letter *Kaf* of *Kand* for the two sections in the Mezuzah. And this is the three *Havayot* in the first section, and also the merit of the four *Havayot* in the second section. The sign for this is that I had the power to draw them down, as they equal the numerical value of my name, **Jacob** <note>Jacob/Yaakov = 182; 7 x 26 (Y-H-W-H) = 182</note>.

"And I prayed to the house of my father and the Lord shall be my God" <note>Genesis 28:21</note>. This means that through taking Rachel, I will rectify the three letters *Y-H-W* to return in peace and to be a pure, holy, and worthy vessel, containing the seven *Havayot* which are the numerical value of my name. This is specifically "the Lord shall be mine." This also rectifies the four other letters of "One" (*Echad*) and the four *Havayot*, so that the name *Elohim* <note>God/Judgment</note> shall also be in holiness, in the secret of "He is the One God" (*Hu Ha-Elohim*).

The Supernal Angel acted to strengthen the seed of Rachel, but provided him with Leah first so that Jacob could rectify the entire name of *Elohim* in the house of Laban. And then Jacob and his wife came into these, for "he changed my wages ten times" <note>Genesis 31:7</note>. As the **Zohar** says, he came against him with ten types of sorcery, but through his faith in God, he also had a hold on the *Havayot*. But because I have already rectified the letters of *Shin*, I brought them once again into holiness. Therefore, it is not written "to do me evil" specifically, so that Laban would have no grasp on the five *Havayot* of the Mezuzah.

Rachel and Leah were given, and he was blessed further. They said, "Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?" <note>Genesis 31:14</note>. This means: do we still have a portion in the *Kelipah* (the husk), in the matter where our father’s impurity is prominent and has a grasp?

<column-break/>

In our *Elohim*, you have already rectified all seven letters whose number is "a portion of *Elohim*" among the created beings. For their blessing is made foolish, as every union of the *Kelipot* (husks) is through the flow they receive from our "Countenance" (*Partzuf*), which spreads into our two supernal Countenances, which are the Upper Leah and Rachel. Afterwards, in all the "Mights" (*Gevurot*), they also "consumed our money" <note>Genesis 31:15</note>, which are the "lesser kindnesses" (*Chasadim*), for "money" (*Kesef*) spreads from the Foundation (*Yesod*) to Understanding (*Binah*) in our Countenances.

For all the wealth that God took from our father <note>Genesis 31:16</note>—meaning now that it is rectified to enter into holiness—they brought out with him all the "clarifications" of the holy world which were gathered and included, as is known, in the "Head of the Primordial Man" (*Adam Kadmon*), from those that were given to the husks. All this flow is "ours"—meaning from what reached his portion for the rectification of our Countenances and to bring into them the souls that emerged from us.

"And now, all that God has said to you, do" <note>Genesis 31:16</note>. This means you should return us to holiness as before, where the name of your God was, and all this flow was within holiness. "Leave this land and return to the land of your birth" <note>Genesis 31:13</note>, which is the level of "Standing," for there was the birth of Jacob, Rachel, Leah, and all the Tribes, as is known.

Let us return to our subject from above: that the *Havayot* in "One" (*Echad*), the seven *Havayot*, equal *Elohim* three times. <note>Calculation: 7 x 26 = 182; 3 x 86 (Elohim) = 258. The text explores complex Gematria/numerical relationships here</note>. There is another perspective on the explanation of "seventh," as it says "and you shall pass over," so that there will be others. These are the 55 of *Elohim* in hint and 8 in simple form.

The two names that were there are the "two legs of Leah," which are her two heels (*Akavyim*). Everything is absorbed, the two heels in the Crown (*Keter*) and Rachel, etc. Therefore they divide and become one "Heel" (*Akev*), and this is the meaning of **Jacob** (*Yaakov*). It is not written "Yaakovi." And behold, two times *Elohim* equals the numerical value of **Akev** (Heel) <note>Akev = 172; Elohim = 86; 86 x 2 = 172</note>.

Similarly, there are 170 words in the Mezuzah, and with the inclusion of the three sections, it equals **Akev** (172/173). This teaches that the main essence of the Mezuzah is to guard the "Heel of Leah" which is clothed in the Crown and Rachel. Behold, the letters of "Heels of Leah" form the name **Jacob** (*Yaakov*). Therefore, it was necessary for Jacob to take Leah first to rectify the "Heels of Leah," and afterwards Rachel to rectify her "Crown." For through the sin of Adam, as mentioned in the name of the **Arizal** <note>Rabbi Isaac Luria, the father of modern Kabbalah</note> and in the **Zohar**, the forces of evil always have a grasp in this place—Samael in the Crown of Rachel, and Lilith in the "Heel" of Leah, which is the first strength and was opposite Leah...
