<meta>This page continues the mystical exploration of the Patriarchs' journeys, specifically focusing on the descent of Jacob’s sons to Egypt and the spiritual mechanics of the Mezuzah. It utilizes extensive Gematria (numerical values of letters) to link the biblical narrative with the structure of the Mezuzah and the Divine Presence.</meta>

# Laws of the Mezuzah

He makes heard through it the aspect of *Mazal* <note>literally "luck" or "destiny," but here referring to the celestial flow of influence</note> which are the 336 <note>numerical value of the word "Mazal" is 77, but the author is referencing a specific kabbalistic configuration totaling 336</note> aspects of the Nazirite vows. This is an elevation like the aspect of *YaKeNHaZ* <note>An acronym for the order of blessings when a Holiday falls on Saturday night: Wine, Sanctification, Candle, Separation, Time</note>. Others say there is a connection to the New Moon because of the aspect of "to him" <note>Hebrew: *Lo*</note> which rises to the number of 365 words, corresponding to the total days of the solar year. And this is what is meant by "He placed a medicine for the wrath" <note>A play on words regarding the incense or the protective nature of the Mezuzah</note>, for the word "Shekel" <note>currency/weight</note> has this numerical value. This is to teach that within the 365 words, the entire Psalm is included, in the aspect of the 64 and 33 <note>kabbalistic divisions of divine names</note>. And behold, at this time, the simple ones are brought down to Egypt with the *Shekhinah* <note>The Divine Presence, often personified as feminine</note>.

The *Shekhinah* led with her 60 from the 336. The seventy led with them the 60 waters of the pits belonging to Joseph. And if all the kin of the 336, all the important ones who rise to the numerical value of **Mercy** and **Peace**. "So that He may grant you mercy before the man" <note>Genesis 43:14</note> is weighed as in the place of the dream story. Joseph the Righteous is the "Foundation of the World" <note>The Sefirah of *Yesod*</note>, as it is written there regarding the splendor. And the 336 will "grant you mercy": the "to me" <note>Hebrew: *Li*</note> of Abraham, the "to him" <note>Hebrew: *Lo*</note> of Isaac. "Grant you mercy" is the "to me" of Isaac. "Before the man" refers to Joseph, that all dreams shall be joined for the children. And since Jacob blessed them with 365, therefore after the verse "And they approached the man who was over Joseph’s house" <note>Genesis 43:19</note>, they remembered his dream at the entrance of the house and waited for the sprinkling and the counting. They entered inside the entrance to speak with him. Why specifically inside the entrance of the house? To fulfill the verse, so that upon their entering the entrance of Joseph's house, a hint was placed there of the "Additional Offering" <note>Musaf</note>, remembering the blessing of their house. Therefore they remembered there with him the 365 that were upon them.

Jacob also hinted in his prayer for the future, that the 365 were the "Faithful Shepherds." "May He grant you mercy before the man"—this refers to the Strength of the Completion, that they shall pray before you, before the Holy One, Blessed be He, who is called "Man." And this is what is meant by "to you" <note>Hebrew: *Lakhem*</note> which has the numerical value of 70, like David and his people. It also intends to refer to the cutting off of the ten tribes in the exile, like Benjamin or those who are related. And we intend that in the revealed world they are separated and scattered, but the Holy One, Blessed be He, will gather them together in holiness. At that time, there will be no more exile. This is the "bringing of a gift" <note>Mincha</note> to be fulfilled, as it says: "And they shall bring all your brethren out of all the nations as a gift to the Lord" <note>Isaiah 66:20</note>. May this be a complete redemption speedily in our days, Amen.

->**End of the work, praise to God the Creator**<-

<column-break/>

To those branches and from them to the world that enters, etc. See there. And in the "Gift Offering" <note>Mincha</note> there are six sides included, a little of this and a little of that. One should not be weary with these matters of weights, for if you change the arrangement, everything is nullified in the secret of the Gift Offering. The sages said: the sale of Joseph to Egypt caused the "Upper Righteous One" <note>The Sefirah of Yesod</note> to be divided above, as it is said "to remove the crown from his head." And then on Passover, the "Hallel" prayer and the "Haggadah" are recited. It is known what the Rabbi <note>Isaac Luria, the Arizal</note>, of blessed memory, explained regarding the secret of the 65, the purification of all the leaven. And from there comes the "Dew of Lights," and he filled with blessings the 70 languages. If one clarifies from the father to the power of the secret of *Mazal*. And there they are clothed within three garments of the "Living One" <note>Chaya</note> for the *Yud* and the *Heh*.

Behold, the Name of 72 and the Name of 63 <note>Divine names expanded by different spellings</note> with the Name of 45 and 52 rise to the numerical value of **Mezuzah**. And "Israel their father said to them" <note>Genesis 43:11</note>—this is the aspect of "Israel Above." But according to the secret of the wisdom of the hidden, he shall be joined in righteousness with the Kingdom <note>Malkhut</note> of Rachel. Therefore, "do this"—meaning one must repair and gather the "Lower Degrees" called "This" <note>Zot</note>. All judgment is directed toward the Holy, and her repair is at this time so that you may awaken her. My son, draw down the secret of the "Small Face" <note>Zeir Anpin</note> so that he can provide flow to the Kingdom. "Take of the choice fruits of the land in your vessels"—for the "vessels" of bitterness and the "Heh" are clothed in them. This is the secret of the intentions in the secret of the "Small Face" and the "Foundation of the Female." And "bring down a gift to the man"—a gift to her husband, meaning that they shall be the nourishment of the Strength and placed within the Foundations. These shall be joined in a complete union. And this "Gift" <note>Mincha</note> which is Rachel, was included from the "Honey" <note>Devash</note> which are the aspects of the 336. And Joseph is the numerical value of the secret of the *Yud* and the *Heh* in their fillings. And the "Pistachios and Almonds" <note>Genesis 43:11</note> are the letters of the fillings of the Name. These are included in the aspect of the 336 of the fillings. Therefore, you will find the secret of the 365 words in the Torah, and the "Weights" rise to the number of the eight aspects of the 65. And in the remaining two words "a little, a little" <note>referring to "a little balm and a little honey"</note>, they rise to the numerical value of **Rachel**, to show that at the time of the measurement, she is with Rachel.
